scripts.text:
[Wounded]
Wow! Thanks a lot!
I don't know how this happened to our ship
but we should go to see the captain.
scripts.translation:
[伤员]
哇！太感谢了！
我不知道我们的船是怎么变成这样的，
但我们得去找船长看看。

scripts.text:
[Wounded]
... ohh, it seems my body is too injured.
Maybe you can go without me?
scripts.translation:
[伤员]
...噢，看来我伤得太重了。
也许你可以先走，不用管我？

scripts.text:
^4d4dff!- Information -!^000000
NPC Quest Received.
^4d4dffQuestinfo Shortcut is Alt + U^000000
You can check your quest status there anytime.
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff!- 资讯 -!^000000
已接受NPC任务。
^4d4dff任务资讯快捷键是 Alt + U^000000
您可以随时在那里查看任务状态。

scripts.text:
[Wounded]
Luckily the water has not entered the ship.
I will wait here, you should go see the captain.
scripts.translation:
[伤员]
幸好海水没有灌进船舱。
我会在这里等着，您应该去见见船长。

scripts.text:
[Wounded]
I'm fine! I'm fine!
Don't worry about me, you should really go to the captain!
scripts.translation:
[伤员]
我没事！我没事！
别担心我，您真的应该去找船长！

scripts.text:
^4d4dff!- Information -!^000000
^4d4dffQuestinfo Shortcut is Alt + U^000000
You can check your quest status there anytime.
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff!- 资讯 -!^000000
^4d4dff任务资讯快捷键是 Alt + U^000000
您可以随时在那里查看任务状态。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
There are still people in the cabins?!
At least you are safe.
Are you alright?
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
船舱里还有人吗？！
至少你们还安全。
你们没事吧？

scripts.text: I'm alright, but others need help.
scripts.translation: 我没事，但其他人需要帮助。

scripts.text: I think I am the last?
scripts.translation: 我想我是最后一个？

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
There are more people left?
I will send a rescue team to them.
Thank you for your report.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
还有其他人没出来？
我会派救援队去接他们。
谢谢你的报告。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Alright, that's good.
The storm came unexpectedly but I never thought it would hit us that hard.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
很好，那就好。
这场风暴来得很突然，但我没想到它会这么猛烈地袭击我们。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
At least most people made it to safety.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
至少大多数人已经安全了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Look at the trees there, ^4d4dfffollow them to the southwest^000000 to find a new ship.
The ship will take you to ^4d4dffIzlude^000000, our original destination.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
看看那边的树，^4d4dff沿着它们向西南方向走^000000就能找到一艘新船。
那艘船会带你去^4d4dff依斯鲁得岛^000000，也就是我们原本的目的地。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Ah! Speaking of it, those ^4d4dffPorings^000000 on this island drop several materials we could use for repairs.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
啊！说到这个，岛上的那些^4d4dff波利^000000会掉落一些我们可以用来修船的材料。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
^4d4dffKill the Porings and bring 2 Lumbers to the southern crew^000000.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
^4d4dff击败波利，并带2根木材给南边的船员^000000。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
It is a hard task, but you look tough enough.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
这是个艰巨的任务，但看起来你足够强壮。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Speaking of Porings, you have to equip your gears.
You should have a ^4d4dffweapon and an armor^000000 equipped.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
说到波利，你得装备好你的武器。
你应该已经^4d4dff装备了武器和防具^000000。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffYou can equip gear or use items by simply double clicking them.
The item window can be opened by pressing Alt + E or using the menu button.^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 资讯 -!
^4d4dff只需双击物品即可装备或使用。
按 Alt + E 或使用菜单按钮可以打开物品窗口。^000000

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffEquipped Items can be seen by pressing Alt + Q.
Either double click or drag & drop to equip or unequip them.^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 资讯 -!
^4d4dff按 Alt + Q 可以查看已装备的物品。
双击或拖放即可装备或卸下物品。^000000

scripts.text:
[Captain Carlock]
Did you check all your equipment?
^4d4dffSkill distribution^000000 should be done.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
你检查好所有装备了吗？
^4d4dff技能分配^000000应该已经完成了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carlock]
For a smooth battle, you have to distribute your abilities properly.
^4d4dffIf you want to increase your strength, you need to raise Str^000000. ^4d4dffIf you want to increase your hit, you must raise Dex^000000.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
为了战斗顺利，你需要合理分配能力值。
^4d4dff如果想提升力量，你需要增加Str^000000。^4d4dff如果想提升命中率，你需要增加Dex^000000。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
^4d4dffThe Ship^000000 is anchored in the southwest. It will take you to Izlude.
Don't forget to ^4d4dffget some Lumber^000000 for the ship.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
^4d4dff船^000000停泊在西南方，它将带你前往依斯鲁得岛。
别忘了为船准备一些^4d4dff木材^000000。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Don't forget to raise your ^4d4dffskills^000000.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
别忘了提升你的^4d4dff技能^000000。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Everything is ready to sail over to Izlude.
The ship is located at the south-western part of the island.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
前往依斯鲁得岛的一切准备都就绪了。
船位于岛屿的西南部。

scripts.text:
! - Information -!
^4d4dffYou get a stats bonus for every level you raise.
The status window can be opened and closed with the shortcut Alt + A^000000.
scripts.translation:
! - 资讯 -!
^4d4dff每提升一级，你都会获得属性加成。
按 Alt + A 可以打开或关闭属性窗口。^000000

scripts.text:
! - Information -!
^4d4dffPlease properly allocate the stats you need to battle^000000.
scripts.translation:
! - 资讯 -!
^4d4dff请合理分配战斗所需的属性值^000000。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Kill Porings and bring the Lumber to the crew.
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
击败波利，并将木材交给船员。
祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Had a good dream?
Soon, we will get to Izlude. And you can talk to other people like you just talked to me.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
做了个好梦？
很快我们就会到达依斯鲁得岛。到时候你可以像刚才和我说话一样，和其他人交谈。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
I think that guy over there lost his memory. I gave him a new name.
Lumin.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
我觉得那边那位先生失去了记忆。我给他起了个新名字。
卢敏。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Many youngsters visit the ^4d4dffRune-Midgarts Kingdom^000000 to chase their dreams.
Izlude is a satellite city of Prontera, the capital of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
许多年轻人来到^4d4dff卢恩·米德加兹王国^000000追寻梦想。
依斯鲁得岛是卢恩·米德加兹王国首都普隆德拉的卫星城。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Izlude always welcomes young adventurers like you who have just started their journey through the world.
You are one of them, of course.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
依斯鲁得岛永远欢迎像你这样刚刚踏上世界旅程的年轻冒险者。
你也是其中之一，当然。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
I would like to tell you more stories, but it's time to get ready for arrival.
There is an academy in Izlude for newcomers like yourself.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
我想给你讲更多故事，但现在是准备靠岸的时候了。
依斯鲁得岛有一所学院，专门接待像你这样的新人。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Let me give you more details later. See you back at the harbor deck.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
稍后我再给你详细介绍。在甲板见。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
To get off this ship, you should enter the ^4d4dffShining Portal^000000 over there.
All transportation is made through the portals.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
要下船，你应该进入那边的^4d4dff闪耀传送门^000000。
所有的交通都是通过传送门进行的。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Yes.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
是的。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Oh boy.
What a cute reaction.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
哎呀。
真是可爱的反应。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.....
Should I introduce myself?
scripts.translation: 我要自我介绍吗？

scripts.text: My name is ~!
scripts.translation: 我的名字是~！

scripts.text: - Lu just walked away with a cynical look on his face.
scripts.translation: - 卢一脸不屑地走开了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Looks like... he has a shy personality.
When you go to Izlude, will you check on him?
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
看来...他是个害羞的性格。
你去依斯鲁得岛的时候，能顺便去看看他吗？

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
From now on I'll be sailing the ship around the island.
Let's go, shall we?
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
从现在开始，我要驾船绕岛航行了。
我们出发吧？

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
These Porings stole my materials to repair the ship. Can you help me to get them back?
There are plenty of Porings on this island.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
这些波利偷走了我修船的材料。你能帮我拿回来吗？
岛上有很多波利。

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
I would really appreciate it if you help me.
I am not allowed to set foot on this island.
That's why I ask for your help~
scripts.translation:
[水手]
如果你能帮我就太好了。
我不被允许踏上这座岛。
所以才拜托你帮忙~

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
Unbelievable, perfect! Any chance you want to join my crew?
Enough talking!!
Come on, we're ready to set sail!
Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[水手]
难以置信，太完美了！有没有兴趣加入我的船员？
别废话了！！
快上船，我们要出发了！
非常感谢！

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
If you want to sail with us to Izlude, jump on board!
scripts.translation:
[水手]
如果你想和我们一起去依斯鲁得岛，就跳上船吧！

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
Oh, and take these ^4d4dffMagnifiers^000000.
When you hunt monsters you can find ^4d4dffunidentified items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
哦，还有这些^4d4dff放大镜^000000。
打怪的时候可以捡到^4d4dff未鉴定物品^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
Using a Magnifier will identify the item.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
使用放大镜可以鉴定物品。

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
Maybe you already have some unidentified items from your fights with those Porings?
scripts.translation:
[水手]
也许你在和那些波利战斗时已经捡到了一些未鉴定物品？

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
The ship is heading to Izlude soon~!
I'll let you know when we set sail~!
scripts.translation:
[水手]
船很快就要开往依斯鲁得岛了~！
出发的时候我会通知你的~！

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Oh, {0}!
Why are you here at the wharf?
I guess you are doing well at the academy.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
哦，{0}！
你怎么在码头？
看来你在学院过得不错嘛。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I'm going to be docking and reparing the ship here for a while.
I will be taking the same route I tried before.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我要在这里停靠一段时间，修理船只。
我会走之前尝试过的那条航线。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Hmm? You must be a student of the Criatura Academy?
Were you on my ship?
Hmm I can't remember.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
嗯？你是克里阿图拉学院的学生吗？
你在我船上吗？
嗯，我想不起来了。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Well, anything is fine.
Shall I go easy on you since you said you were a student of the Academy?
I am still the captain of the ship, regardless.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
好吧，没关系。
既然你说你是学院的学生，我就对你客气点吧？
不过，我依然是这艘船的船长。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I plan on taking off as soon as the repairs are complete.
The route will open with ^4d4dffPharos Lighthouse^000000 by then.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
修好后我就立刻出发。
到时候航线会通往^4d4dff发乐斯灯塔岛^000000。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
This is Izlude.
The best city for you to take wings to your dreams.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
这里是依斯鲁得岛。
这里是让你梦想展翅高飞的最佳城市。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Although I don't have any particular feelings for you,
I've seen a lot of young people like you, while operating the ship.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
虽然我对您并没有特别的感情，
但在经营这条航线期间，我见过很多像您这样的年轻人。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
There were those among them who succeeded and failed and went back after being unable to adjust.
I want you to have a successful start with this place.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
他们中有人成功，有人失败，也有人因为无法适应而离开了。
我希望您能在这里有一个好的开始。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Did you know this?
Izlude has a new Institute for budding adventurers like you!
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
您知道吗？
依斯鲁得岛为像您这样刚起步的冒险者设立了一所新的学院！

scripts.text: You mean the Academy?
scripts.translation: 您是指学院吗？

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Yes! It's called the ^4d4dffRoyal Criatura Academy^000000.
Founded by the Rune-Midgarts lineage to help out new adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
没错！它叫^4d4dff皇家克里阿图拉学院^000000。
由卢恩·米德加兹王室创立，旨在帮助新晋冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
A friend of mine works there, so I'll give you the introduction to him.
He could make a lot of things easier for you.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我的一位朋友在那里工作，我会为您引荐给他。
他能让很多事情变得更简单。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
He usually talks to new adventurers near the entrance of the academy.
Go and meet him there.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
他通常会在学院入口附近与新冒险者交谈。
请去那里见他。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
His name is ^4d4dffHun^000000
I will mark his spot on the map so go to see him.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
他的名字是^4d4dff洪^000000
我会在地图上标记他的位置，请去见他。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
The ^4d4dffMini map can be seen on the right top of the screen.
You can zoom in with +, zoom out with -. The waypoint from the NPC will be marked on it. ^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 资讯 -!
^4d4dff小地图位于屏幕右上角。
您可以使用+放大，-缩小。NPC标记的路点会显示在地图上。^000000

scripts.output:
!- 资讯 -!
您已接受来自 ^4d4dff船长 卡洛克^000000 的任务。
您可以在任务窗口中查看任务内容。
scripts.text:
!- Information -!
Received a Quest from ^4d4dffCaptain Carocc.
The quest content can be checked from the quest window.

!- Information -!
Quest window can be opened by pressing ^4d4dffAlt + u^000000 keys together.
scripts.translation:
!- 资讯 -!
同时按下^4d4dffAlt + u^000000键即可打开任务窗口。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If you need more help with the map, press <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> here
Yes, the part that says 'Hun'.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果您需要更多地图帮助，请按<NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI>这里
是的，就是写着“洪”的那部分。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffThe icon during talk <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> means a link to navigation directions.
scripts.translation:
!- 资讯 -!
^4d4dff对话中的图标<NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI>表示导航指引链接。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
If you press info after selecting a task in the objectives^4d4dff,
an arrow pointing to the location of the objective will pop up along with the navigation help.
scripts.translation:
!- 资讯 -!
如果您在目标中选择任务后按下信息^4d4dff，
将会弹出一个指向目标位置的箭头，并附带导航帮助。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Anyway, my friend will help you register with the academy
I hope it can help you for your future.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
总之，我的朋友会帮您办理学院的注册手续。
希望这能对您的未来有所帮助。

scripts.text: I know who you're talking about.
scripts.translation: 我知道您说的是谁。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Then there's no worry.
He'll introduce you to the academy.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
那就放心了。
他会向您介绍学院的情况。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
OK. I will show you the direction. You try it again.
By the way, did I tell you his name? His name is ^4d4dffHun^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
好的。我会为您指引方向。您再试一次。
顺便问一下，我告诉过您他的名字吗？他的名字是^4d4dff洪^000000

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dff Mini map can be seen on the right top of the screen.
You can zoom in with +, zoom out with -. The waypoint from the NPC will be marked on it. ^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 资讯 -!
^4d4dff小地图位于屏幕右上角。
您可以使用+放大，-缩小。NPC标记的路点会显示在地图上。^000000

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If you need more help with the map, press <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> here
Yes, the part that says [Hun].
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果您需要更多地图帮助，请按<NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI>这里
是的，就是写着[洪]的那部分。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dff the icon during talk <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> means
a link to navigation directions.
scripts.translation:
!- 资讯 -!
^4d4dff对话中出现的图标 <NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> 代表
导航指引链接。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
If you press info after selecting a task in the objectives^4d4dff,
an arrow pointing to the location of the objective will pop up along with navigation help
scripts.translation:
!- 资讯 -!
在目标^4d4dff中选择任务后按下“资讯”，
将显示指向目标位置的箭头及导航辅助

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Anyway, my friend will help you register with the academy
I hope it will help you out in your journey
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
总之，我的朋友会帮你办理学院注册。
希望这能对你的旅程有所帮助。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If you want, you can step forward to the world right away.
However, I recommend you visit the Academy first.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果你愿意，现在就可以踏入世界了。
不过，我建议你先去一趟学院。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
The world is a lonely place to be alone.
The Academy has people you can make as lifetime companions.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
独自一人在世界上会很孤独。
学院里有可以成为你终身伙伴的人。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
My friend Hun will be around the academy entrance.
If you don't know the way I'll point it out to you again.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我的朋友洪会在学院入口附近。
如果你找不到路，我会再给你指一次。

scripts.translation:

希望这能对你的旅程有所帮助。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Oh, {0}!
Still being dilligent?
I've been busy, also.
I was reparing the ship.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
哦，{0}！
还在这么勤勉吗？
我也很忙。
我在修船。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I'll be taking off as soon as the repairs are complete.
At that time, the sailing route to ^4d4dffPharos lighthouse ^000000will be opened.
Be excited for it.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
修好后我就出发了。
届时，前往 ^4d4dff发乐斯灯塔岛^000000 的航线将会开放。
敬请期待吧。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Hello?
Is it your first time on Izlude?
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
你好？
你是第一次来依斯鲁得岛吗？

scripts.text: Hello?
scripts.translation: 你好？

scripts.text: Let me get on the ship!
scripts.translation: 让我上船！

scripts.text: I don't know what to do.
scripts.translation: 我不知道该做什么。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
You look strong and able!
I like able people like you!
Always be healthy and strong as you are now.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
你看起来很强壮能干！
我喜欢像你这样能干的人！
请一直保持现在的健康与强壮。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I usually travel to ^4d4dffPharos Lighthouse^000000.
But I'm resting up due to some problems.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我通常前往 ^4d4dff发乐斯灯塔岛^000000。
但因为一些问题，我正在休整。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If it's Alberta or Byalan Island, talk to the next sailor.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果是去艾尔贝塔或拜兰岛，请找下一位水手。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Hmm? You said you didn't know what to do.
Since you're at Izlude, why don't you visit ^4d4dffCriatura Academy^000000?
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
嗯？你说你不知道该做什么。
既然你在依斯鲁得岛，为什么不去看看 ^4d4dff克里阿图拉学院^000000 呢？

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Izlude has the Institute for budding adventurers like you
A friend of mine works there, so I'll give you the introduction to him.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
依斯鲁得岛有针对像你这样初出茅庐的冒险者的学院。
我的一位朋友在那里工作，我会把你介绍给他。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
He ususally talks to new adventurers near the entrance of an academy.
Go and meet him personally.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
他通常在学院入口附近与新的冒险者交谈。
去亲自见见他吧。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
His name is ^4d4dffHun^000000
I will mark his location on the map so go to see him.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
他的名字是 ^4d4dff洪^000000
我会在地图上标记他的位置，所以去见见他吧。

Then there's no worry.

好的。我会为您指引方向。您再试一次。

Anyway, my friend will help you register with the academy

scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
总之，我的朋友会帮你办理学院注册。
希望这能对你的旅程有所帮助。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Ah, it's you.
This guy has also decided to register at Criatura Academy.
This might be a good destiny for you. Hope you and him can be good friends.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
啊，是你啊。
这家伙也决定在克里阿图拉学院注册了。
这或许是你命中注定的缘分。希望你们能成为好朋友。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If you want, you can step forward to the world right away.
However, I recommend you visit the Academy first.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果你愿意，现在就可以踏入世界了。
不过，我建议你先去一趟学院。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
The world is a lonely place to be alone.
The Academy has people you could make into lifetime companions.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
独自一人在这个世界上是很孤独的。
学院里有可以成为你终身伙伴的人。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
My friend <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> will be around the academy entrance.
If you don't know the way I'll point it out to you again.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我的朋友 <NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> 会在学院入口附近。
如果你不知道路，我会再给你指一次路。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
then, Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
那么，祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Oh, We meet again.
Do you by any chance need a ship?
I usually travel to the port in Paros.
If you need to go to Paros later, come see me.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
哦，我们又见面了。
你难道需要船吗？
我通常前往帕罗斯的港口。
如果你之后需要去帕罗斯，来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
It's been a while!
Looking at your expression, you must be doing well.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
好久不见！
看你的表情，你过得一定很好。

scripts.text: Take me to Pharos Lighthouse
scripts.translation: 去发乐斯灯塔岛

scripts.text: To Alberta
scripts.translation: 去艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Do you want to go to Pharos Lighthouse on the southern coast of Morocc?
The fee is 2800 zeny. I have a crew that needs payment so this fee is non-negotiable.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
你想去摩洛克南海岸的发乐斯灯塔岛吗？
费用是2800 Zeny。我有一支需要支付工资的船员，所以这个费用不能商量。

scripts.text: To Pharos Lighthouse!
scripts.translation: 去发乐斯灯塔岛！

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Let us travel with the wing in our hair.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
让我们带着翅膀在发间飞舞，一起航行吧。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Sorry but you are short of the boarding fee.
I need 2800z to operate.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
抱歉，你的登船费不足。
我需要2800 Zeny来运营。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
OK.
Do you know this, by the way?
^4d4dffThere's a Rogue hideout at Pharos Lighthouse^000000.
You already knew this?
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
好的。
顺便问一下，你知道这个吗？
^4d4dff发乐斯灯塔岛有一个流氓据点^000000。
你已经知道了？

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I thought you knew that I only go to Pharos?
Ask the sailor over there, he's the one that goes there frequently.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我以为你知道我只去发乐斯吗？
问问那边的水手，他经常去那里。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
There are plenty of other ships that travel to Alberta and Byalan Islands.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
有很多其他船只往返于艾尔贝塔和拜兰岛。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Hmm. I'm content with the well being of you and other adventurers who passed me by.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
嗯。看到你和其他冒险者安然无恙地从我身边经过，我很欣慰。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Lumin must be doing well too.
I wonder why you feel like my own child even though we've only met from the sea.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
卢敏应该也过得很不错吧。
虽然我们只在海上见过一面，但我总觉得你像我的孩子一样。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I am Carocc, the caption of this ship.
Do you need a ship?
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我是卡洛克，这艘船的船长。
你需要搭船吗？

scripts.text: Pharos Lighthouse - 2800z
scripts.translation: 发乐斯灯塔岛 - 2800z

scripts.text: Don't need it.
scripts.translation: 不需要

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Let us travel with the wind in our hair.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
让我们迎着风，扬帆起航吧。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Sorry but you are short of the boarding fee.
I need 2800z to operate.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
抱歉，你的登船费不足。
我需要2800 Zeny来运营。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Then use it next time.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
那下次再来吧。

scripts.text:
Quest cannot be continued due to the overfilled inventory.
Continue the quest after organizing the inventory.
scripts.translation:
由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。
请整理物品栏后继续任务。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Oh.. you must be the adventurer Carocc was talking about.
I don't know where your homeland is but Midgard is a good place to start your life's journey.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
哦...你就是卡洛克提到的那位冒险者吧。
我不知道你的故乡在哪里，但米德加尔特是开始人生旅程的好地方。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
It's a good sight to see new adventurers start their journey.
You must be tired. Need a drink?
scripts.translation:
[洪]
看到新冒险者开始旅程，真是令人高兴的景象。
你一定累了吧。需要喝点什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Hun]
You can open the Item window by clicking on the 'item' icon on top left portion of the screen.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
点击屏幕左上角的“物品”图标，即可打开物品窗口。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
The items are automatically catagorized by 'consumables' 'equipment' 'etcetera' and 'personal' suitable for each use.
It will do the automatic sorting per indiviaul useage to
scripts.translation:
[洪]
物品会自动分类为“消耗品”、“装备”、“其他”和“个人物品”，以便于使用。
系统会根据用途自动排序...

[Hun]
Either ^4d4dffdouble click on the item^000000 you intend to use
or drag it onto^4d4dff the equipment window and use it^000000
scripts.translation:
[洪]
^4d4dff双击^000000你想使用的物品，
或者将其^4d4dff拖拽到装备窗口^000000进行装备。

^4d4dffItems can be used or equipped with simply double-clicking.
Item window can be opened with shortcut key Alt+E
scripts.translation:
!- 资讯 -!
^4d4dff双击物品即可使用或装备。
快捷键 Alt+E 可打开物品窗口。

scripts.translation:

^4d4dff按 Alt+Q 可查看已装备的物品。
也可以将物品拖拽到想要装备的位置。

[Hun]
For detailed info on individual items^4d4dff, right click ^000000on that item.
You can check the detailed info on the item.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
若需查看单个物品的详细信息，^4d4dff右键点击^000000该物品即可。
你可以查看物品的详细信息。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffRight-clicking on the item icon^4d4dff  brings up detailed info on the item.
scripts.translation:
!- 资讯 -!
^4d4dff右键点击物品图标^4d4dff 可查看该物品的详细信息。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffWhen you select other players, you can trade, party up with them with the community window that pops up.
scripts.translation:
!- 资讯 -!
^4d4dff选中其他玩家时，会弹出社区窗口，你可以与他们交易或组队。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Ok now ^4d4dffdrink the apple juice that I gave you^000000.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
好了，现在^4d4dff喝掉我给你的苹果汁^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Hey there.
Rest up for a bit.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
嘿。
休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
It's joyous to see new adventurers starting out.
You want something to drink while you are resting?
scripts.translation:
[洪]
看到新冒险者开始旅程，真是令人高兴。
休息的时候，想喝点什么吗？

scripts.output:
[洪]
在左上角的基础物品窗口中，^4d4dff右键点击物品图标^000000即可查看该物品的详细信息。

[Hun]
Ok now ^4d4dffdrink the apple juice that I gave you^000000.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
好了，现在^4d4dff喝掉我给你的苹果汁^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Consume the apple juice that I gave you in your inventory.
Then we'll talk.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
喝掉我给你的苹果汁。
然后我们再聊。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
How's the taste?
Pretty good-taste of sweet and sour, right? It might not be much but it also has healing properties.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
味道如何？
挺不错的吧，酸甜可口。虽然分量不多，但也有恢复效果。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
I want to give you more but that was the last of it
Anyways here's some potions. They'll come in handy when you start fighting.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
我想多给你一些，但那是最后一瓶了。
总之，这里有一些药水。等你开始战斗时会有用的。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Criatura Academy is a good place to build up experience for the future.
And I'm not just saying this because I work here.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
克里阿图拉学院是积累未来经验的好地方。
我可不是因为在这里工作才这么说的。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
I'm for real... haha
scripts.translation:
[洪]
我是认真的...哈哈

scripts.text:
[Hun]
How's the taste?
Pretty good-taste of sweet and sour, right? It might not be much but it also has healing properties.

[洪]
味道如何？
挺不错的吧，酸甜可口。虽然分量不多，但也有恢复效果。

[Hun]
I want to give you more but that was the last of it

[Information Staff]
Hi, how are you?
I am in charge of navigation directions for Izlude's key locations
I wish to propose a simple game along with the navigation, would that be ok?
scripts.translation:
[咨询人员]
你好，最近怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
First of all, how to check the mini-map.
You can check your location through the mini-map at the top right of the screen
scripts.translation:
[咨询人员]
首先，如何查看小地图。
您可以通过屏幕右上角的小地图查看您的位置。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
If you receive information on a town or a city, a waypoint ^4d4dff+^000000 can be marked on the map.
scripts.translation:
[咨询人员]
如果您获得城镇或城市的信息，可以在地图上标记^4d4dff+^000000。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Press ^4d4dff[Ctrl] and [ ~ ] on your keyboard and you can see the world map^000000.
scripts.translation:
[咨询人员]
按下键盘上的^4d4dff[Ctrl]和[ ~ ]，您就可以看到世界地图^000000。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Through the ^4d4dffworld map you can check the location of you, your party members and the level of monsters in the area.^000000
scripts.translation:
[咨询人员]
通过^4d4dff世界地图，您可以查看您、队伍成员的位置以及该区域魔物的等级。^000000

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
This is useful info to remember.
Now then, should we play a simple game?
scripts.translation:
[咨询人员]
这是值得记住的有用信息。
那么，我们要不要玩一个简单的游戏？

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
I will ^4d4dffmark three specific locations on the mini-map.^000000
Please ^4d4dffvisit those locations ^000000using the waypoints as reference.
scripts.translation:
[咨询人员]
我会在小地图上标记^4d4dff三个特定位置^000000。
请以这些标记为参考，^4d4dff前往这些地点^000000。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Think of it as a treasure hunt and go.
I've hidden some useful items there.
scripts.translation:
[咨询人员]
把它当作一场寻宝游戏去吧。
我在那里藏了一些有用的物品。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Vist me again after going by all three locations.
I will check up on it.
scripts.translation:
[咨询人员]
在访问完所有三个地点后，请再次来找我。
我会检查你的进度。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Ah, there' somebody who started out right before you!
If you don't hurry that person will take all the items!
So, run!
scripts.translation:
[咨询人员]
啊，有个人在你之前刚刚出发！
如果你不快点，那个人会把所有物品都拿走的！
所以，快跑！

与伙伴组队进行PvE战斗！
这一切都在竞技场！！

scripts.text:
==== Information ====
Prontera Field.
The city of Prontera is located to the north.
scripts.translation:
==== 资讯 ====
普隆德拉野外。
普隆德拉城市位于北方。

scripts.text: Except for the simple signboard, nothing can be found here.
scripts.translation: 除了简单的指示牌外，什么特别的东西也没找到。

scripts.text: Where's the treasure?
scripts.translation: 宝物在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Yo.
Sorry but I am quicker than you.
There were Fly Wings here..
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
哟。
抱歉，我比你快了一步。
这里本来有苍蝇翅膀...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
In fact, I don't like Fly's wings.
Flies are so dirty.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
其实，我不喜欢苍蝇翅膀。
苍蝇太脏了。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
By the way, why is one of the convenient transportations fly wing shaped?
Perhaps you know?
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
顺便问一下，为什么一种便捷的交通工具是苍蝇翅膀形状的？
也许你知道？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
...you don't know.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
...你不知道。

scripts.text:
Defeated by Lumin again.
Keep calm and find the next location.
scripts.translation:
再次败给了卢敏。
保持冷静，寻找下一个地点。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
...Hello
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
...你好

scripts.text: Are you kidding me?!
scripts.translation: 你在开玩笑吧？！

scripts.text: Where's the treasure?
scripts.translation: 宝物在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
No...
Meeting three times in one day must be destiny.
You and I can be friends.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
不...
一天之内相遇三次，一定是命运。
我们可以成为朋友。

scripts.text: Or Frenemies!
scripts.translation: 或者是亦敌亦友！

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Frene-what? Oh well I'm done with the mission.
Take care.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
亦敌...什么？算了，我的任务结束了。
保重。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you even listening to me?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你到底有没有在听我说话？！

scripts.text: ^4d4dff...I have to report the result to the Information Staff...^000000.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff...我得向咨询人员汇报结果...^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Fly Wings.
If I hand them over to you, you'll just waste 'em so I think I'll keep them.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
苍蝇翅膀。
如果我交给你的话，你只会浪费掉，所以我想还是自己留着吧。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Come on this is just friendly competition.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
拜托了，这只是友好的竞争而已。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I am doing this for you to make you stronger.
Now, so long.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
我这么做是为了让你变得更强。
那么，再见了。

scripts.text: ^4d4dff...I have to report of the result to Information staff...^000000.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff...我得向咨询人员汇报结果...^000000。

scripts.text: Except for the simple signboard, nothing can be found.
scripts.translation: 除了简单的指示牌外，什么特别的东西也没找到。

scripts.text: Why is there nothing?
scripts.translation: 为什么什么都没有？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Of course.
Fly's wings were here so I already packed them in my bag.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
当然。
既然这里有苍蝇翅膀，我已经把它们装进包里了。

scripts.text: So can I have some?
scripts.translation: 那能给我一些吗？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
That's not fair, I was here first so they're mine.
You better get to the next stop faster if you want the prize.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
这不公平，我先来的，所以是我的。
如果你想要奖品，最好快点赶到下一站。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Well, then.....

Lumin disappeared with his long hair in the air.
This guy....
scripts.translation:
卢敏带着飘扬的长发消失了。
这家伙...

scripts.text:
==== Information ====
Prontera Field.
The city of Prontera is located to the north.
scripts.translation:
==== 资讯 ====
普隆德拉野外。
普隆德拉城市位于北方。

scripts.text:
==== Information ====
Prontera Field.
The city of Prontera is located to the north.
scripts.translation:
==== 资讯 ====
普隆德拉野外。
普隆德拉城市位于北方。

scripts.text:
Quest cannot be continued due to the overfilled inventory.
Please try it again after organizing the items.
scripts.translation:
由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。
请整理物品后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Are you a student?
Do you have any problem in your body?
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
你是学生吗？
身体有什么不舒服吗？

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
This is the dispensary of the Royal Criatura Academy.
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
这里是皇家克里阿图拉学院的医务室。
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Are you injured?
Even the emergency treatment didn't work for you?
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
你受伤了吗？
连紧急治疗都对你无效吗？

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Is that good enough?
Have you recovered?
If you are sane, go to bed and rest before you go.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
这样好点了吗？
恢复了吗？
如果你神志清醒，出门前先去床上休息一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
I feel sorry for you but...
I can only give my free healing service to those under base level 20.
You don't look like you're going to die anyways.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
我很同情你，但是...
我只能为基础等级20以下的学生提供免费治疗服务。
而且你看起来也不像会死的样子。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Just take a rest here until you've recovered.
There are lots of vacant beds!
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
就在这里休息直到你恢复为止。
还有很多空床位！

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
You already know about First Aid.
We both are busy. Don't bother me.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
你已经知道紧急治疗了。
我们都很忙，别来烦我。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
You are commendable!
First Aid is a skill that transfers SP to HP during emergency situations.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
你值得称赞！
紧急治疗是在紧急情况下将SP转化为HP的技能。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Recovery ratio is very minimal...
It can help you avoid dying but won't give you much HP.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
恢复比例非常微小...
它能帮你避免死亡，但不会给你太多HP。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Press ^4d4dffALT + S^000000 to open your Skill window to see your skills.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
按下 ^4d4dffALT + S^000000 打开技能窗口，查看你的技能。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
If you press ^4d4dffF12^000000...
The shortcut window will open up with nine small compartments to register your skills to.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
按下 ^4d4dffF12^000000...
会打开快捷栏窗口，里面有9个格子可以注册技能。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Dragging the right hand corner at the shortcut window, you can open up more skill shortcut pages.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
拖动快捷栏窗口右下角，可以打开更多技能快捷页。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
It is a simple use.. ^4d4dffEach slot responds to individual keys from F1 to F9^000000.
Needed skills or items can be immediately used after registering on the corresponding slots.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
用法很简单.. ^4d4dff每个格子对应F1到F9的独立按键^000000。
将需要的技能或物品注册到对应格子后，即可立即使用。

scripts.output:
!- 资讯 -!
您可以将所需的物品或技能图标拖拽到^4d4dff快捷栏^000000中进行注册。
scripts.text:
!- Information -!
You can register needed items or skills at ^4d4dffshortcut slots by dragging the icons.

!- Information -!
^4d4dff The registered items and equipment at^4d4dff the slots can be immediately used or armed by pressing the reponding F1 - F9 keys.
scripts.translation:
!- 资讯 -!
^4d4dff 注册在格子中的物品和装备^4d4dff 可以通过按下对应的F1 - F9键立即使用或装备。

scripts.output:
!- 资讯 -!
您可以按照自己的喜好设置^4d4dff快捷键^000000，然后使用对应的快捷键。
scripts.text:
!- Information -!
By setting the ^4d4dffshortcut keys as you want, you can use the responding shortcut key.

scripts.output:
!- 资讯 -!
^4d4dff您可以注册经常使用的物品和技能，并方便地使用它们。^000000
scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffyou may register the frequently using items and skills, and use them at your convenience.

[Therapist]
Now open the skill window and register [First Aid] as shortcut key, then use it.
You will find it is more covenient to use this way.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
现在打开技能窗口，将 [紧急治疗] 注册为快捷键，然后使用它。
你会发现这样使用更方便。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Have you investigated the growing plants in the field?
^4d4dff Red Plant, Blue Plant, Green Plant, White Plant^000000etc..
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
你调查过田里生长的植物吗？
^4d4dff 红草、蓝草、绿草、白草^000000等等。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
You can get different colored herbs from the various plants.
Processing herbs turns to be a various useful potions.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
你可以从不同的植物中获得不同颜色的药草。
加工药草可以制成各种有用的药水。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Now, shall we collect the Red Herb with your hands?
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
现在，我们要用手采集红色药草吗？

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
A ^4d4dffRed Plant is growing near the academy building.^000000.
I secretly planted it for today.
Go and get ^4d4dff1 Red Herb^000000.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
^4d4dff学院建筑附近长着一株红草。^000000
我为了今天特意种下的。
去采集 ^4d4dff1个红色药草^000000。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
You got it.
^4d4dffYou could eat this herb and get the benefit of it immediately but it will be more efficient if you make it into a potion.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
你拿到了。
^4d4dff你可以直接吃掉这个药草立即获得效果，但制成药水会更有效。^000000

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Herbs vary their virtues according to their color.
^4d4dffGreen Herbs^000000 detox you.
^4d4dffBlue Herbs^000000 recover your SP.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
药草的功效因颜色而异。
^4d4dff绿色药草^000000 可以解毒。
^4d4dff蓝色药草^000000 可以恢复SP。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Any other?
Well, HP is recovering like this red herb.
This like this... Make a nectar and put it into a bottle....
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
还有其他吗？
嗯，HP恢复就像这个红色药草一样。
就像这样... 制成糖浆并装进瓶子里....

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
This becomes the recovering potion possible to take anywhere, anytime.
I will give it to you as souvenir.
And also give you the recipe to make potions easily.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
这就变成了可以随时随地携带的恢复药水。
我把它作为纪念品送给你。
同时也给你制作药水的配方。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
This is the book for the simple combination of potion use.
You can make it easily by ^4d4dffusing the combination kit or cooking tool^000000.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
这是简单组合药水使用的书。
你可以 ^4d4dff使用组合专用工具或烹饪工具^000000 轻松制作。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Not only potions but also other easily attainable things can be turned to various tools. Please make use of them.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
不仅可以制作药水，其他容易获得的东西也可以变成各种工具。请善加利用。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
For your trial to make it, I gave you a Red Herb and one Apple,
How about making it with the combination kit?
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
为了让你尝试制作，我给了你一个红色药草和一个苹果，
用组合专用工具制作一下怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Read the combination kit by ^4d4dffright-clicking^000000, and ^4d4dffclick the book shaped icon^000000 which will open up the explanation window.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
^4d4dff右键点击^000000组合专用工具，然后^4d4dff点击书本形状的图标^000000，即可打开说明窗口。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Why don't you learn about the virtues of herbs?
Bring one Red Herb by beating the growing Red Herb near the academy building.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
你要不要了解一下草药的功效？
去学院建筑附近击败生长的红草，带一株红色药草回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
You can find it near the entrance of the academy.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
你可以在学院入口附近找到它。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
I already let you know about the basic medical botany.
By the way, there is something called a ^4d4dffShining Plant^000000 here on Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
我已经向你介绍了基础的医学植物学知识。
顺便一提，米德加尔特有一种叫^4d4dff光芒草^000000的植物。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Nobody knows which herb comes out from this plant.
Once I got the fruit of Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
没人知道这种植物会结出什么草药。
我曾经得到过世界树的果实。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
And, in the Alberta merchant guild, there is an old man making potions.
You can ask him for help.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
在艾尔贝塔的商人公会里，有一位制作药水的老人。
你可以向他求助。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
^4d4dffAlchemist^000000 or ^4d4dffBiochemist^000000 or the higher class job ^4d4dffGeneticist^000000 are all good at creating potions.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
^4d4dff炼金术士^000000、^4d4dff生物化学家^000000，或者更高级的职业^4d4dff基因学家^000000，都很擅长制作药水。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
If you want to have a well-made potion, it may be a good idea to ask for a specialist.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
如果你想要品质优良的药水，找专家帮忙是个好主意。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
I see...
For emergency situations, in case you've fainted and want to be brought back here, I will save your current location.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
我明白了...
为了应对紧急情况，如果你昏倒了想回到这里，我会保存你当前的位置。

scripts.text:
Your inventory is too full so you can't continue this quest.
Please try it again after organizing the items.
scripts.translation:
你的物品栏已满，无法继续此任务。
请整理物品后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Hey there Turtle
You are really slow.
This Red Plant is no longer useful for you.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
嘿，乌龟
你动作真慢。
这株红草对你已经没用了。

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在说什么？

scripts.text: Who're you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
You heard me.
Aren't you here to collect the Red Plant for the Academy Therapist.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
你听到了吗。
你不是来为学院治疗师采集红草的吗。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
But, But something weird just happened.
It happened right before my eyes.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
但是，刚才发生了奇怪的事。
就在我眼前发生的。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Did you lose your memory?
If the captain hears about it, he'll cry.
It is still ok as long as I remember you.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
你失忆了吗？
如果船长知道了，他会哭的。
只要我还记得你就行。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Lumin.
.......
How about being happy?
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
卢敏。
......
开心点怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Anyway, let me explain it to you, I have just cut all the leaves of this Red Plant.
You can't collect the Red Plant anymore.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
总之，让我解释一下，我刚把这株红草的叶子全剪掉了。
你没法再采集红草了。

scripts.text: Ok so give me a ^ff0000Red Herb^000000
scripts.translation: 那就给我一株^ff0000红色药草^000000

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
OK... then...
I don't even need it anyways. I already know all about basic medical botany.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
好吧...那么...
反正我也用不着。我已经知道所有基础医学植物学知识了。

scripts.text: Then, why did you do it?
scripts.translation: 那你为什么要这么做？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I didn't do it!
I was just standing here.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
不是我做的！
我只是站在这里。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Here take this Red Herb.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
拿着，这是红色药草。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Ah... see it's growing back.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
啊...看，它又长出来了。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I guess you should go back to the Therapist.
He's probably waiting for you..
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
我想你应该回去找治疗师。
他可能在等你...

scripts.text:
He seems to think of something deeply.
Disregard it.
scripts.translation:
他似乎在深思什么。
请忽略这一点。

scripts.text:
[Criatura Student]
.......
scripts.translation:
[克里亚图拉学院学生]
......

scripts.text: This student looks familiar...
scripts.translation: 这个学生看起来很眼熟...

scripts.text:
[Criatura Student]
.......
scripts.translation:
[克里亚图拉学院学生]
......

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
snoring... snoring...
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
呼噜...呼噜...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
snoring... snoring...
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
呼噜...呼噜...

scripts.text:
- A man is lying here
- he's barely breathing.
scripts.translation:
- 这里躺着一个男人
- 他几乎停止了呼吸。

scripts.text: - Is this maybe...?!
scripts.translation: - 这难道是...？！

scripts.text:
- an accident...
- yes, this is a murder!
- There's a murderer here!
scripts.translation:
- 意外...
- 不，这是谋杀！
- 这里有凶手！

scripts.text:
- I swear on some old person's grave
- I will solve this case!
scripts.translation:
- 我对着某位老人的坟墓发誓
- 我一定要侦破此案！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Yawn. Who are you making so much noise next to me...
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
哈欠。是谁在我旁边这么吵...

scripts.text: You aren't dead?
scripts.translation: 你没死？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Dead?! Who....?
me? Pu ha ha ha!!
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
死？谁...？
我？噗哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Sorry for laughing. Ha ha ha!
I was just taking a nap because the weather is good.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
抱歉笑了。哈哈哈！
我只是因为天气好，所以小睡了一会儿。

scripts.text: But you weren't breathing...
scripts.translation: 但你刚才没有呼吸...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Ahh...... that?
Right it makes sense that you misunderstood.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
啊......那个？
难怪你会误会。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I used the skill<^ff0000Play Dead^000000> because I didn't want to be disturbed by monsters or someone else.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
我使用了<^ff0000装死^000000>技能，因为我不想被魔物或其他人打扰。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I never thought someone would think of me as an actual dead body.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
我从未想过会有人把我当成真正的尸体。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Oh, I see... you are a new novice who just has arrived here?
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
哦，我明白了...你是刚到这里的新手吗？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I guess it is unexpected and surprising but do you want to learn <^ff0000Play Dead^000000>?
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
这确实出乎意料，但你想学习<^ff0000装死^000000>吗？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I am sure that it will help you. How do you think about it?
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
我相信这对你会有帮助。你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: I am sorry but I am busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙。

scripts.text: I want to learn it!
scripts.translation: 我想学！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Really ? If you are busy then fine by me.
I should keep sleeping.
yawning...
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
真的吗？如果你很忙，那也没关系。
我该继续睡觉了。
哈欠...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
You made a right decision!
I want to teach you for good.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
你做了一个正确的决定！
我想好好教你。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
A novice does not know the potential power of himself nor how strong the enemy is.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
新手往往不了解自己的潜力，也不知道敌人有多强。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
There is a studious type of novice who studies well..but i guess we are not.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
有些新手很爱学习...但我猜我们不是那种人。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Just take prompt action.
And sometimes you'll be defeated by stong enemies...
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
只要迅速采取行动。
有时候你会被强大的敌人打败...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Huh? You're right this is my story.
I was getting sick of being defeated.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
嗯？你说得对，这是我的故事。
我厌倦了一再被击败。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
One day, a good idea came to my mind. If I pretend to be dead when I find a strong enemy...
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
有一天，我灵机一动。如果我遇到强大的敌人时假装死亡...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I was faced with the risk of death, because I was not good at pretending to be dead.
Even when I look back at that time. it is still thrilling...
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
我面临着死亡的风险，因为我不擅长装死。
即使现在回想起来，那依然让人心惊胆战...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
let's continue to talk
So ever since then, Playing Dead started working out for me!
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
让我们继续聊。
从那以后，装死对我来说开始奏效了！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
And then...
I could not hold a breath for a long time.
That was a problem!
Clever monsters were checking out my breath!
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
然后...
我无法长时间屏住呼吸。
那是个问题！
聪明的魔物会检查我的呼吸！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
So I had to train myself to hold my breath for a long time.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
所以我不得不训练自己长时间屏住呼吸。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Sounds complicated.. but it is quite simple.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
听起来很复杂...但其实很简单。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
If you feel like you can not beat the enemy, when a strong one appears, just fall down on the ground and pretend to be dead.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
如果你觉得打不过敌人，当强大的敌人出现时，就倒在地上假装死亡。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I will put you on a brief test whether you hold you breathe or not.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
我会对你进行一个简单的测试，看看你能否屏住呼吸。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Hold a breath for 20 seconds, then talk to me later. I won't admit you if you talk to me before that time is over!
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
屏住呼吸20秒，然后再来找我。
如果在那之前就来找我，我是不会让你通过的！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Start!
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
开始！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
What? You aren't able to hold your breath for even 20 seconds?
You can't learn this skill until you are able to hold it!
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
什么？你连20秒都屏不住呼吸吗？
如果你做不到这一点，就无法学习这个技能！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Hold breath for 20 seconds again!
Then talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
再屏住呼吸20秒！
然后再来找我。

scripts.text: - Learned the <^ff0000Play Dead^000000>skill.

[Instructor Argos]
Okay, good job.
If you have strong patience like that, it will save you. There will be no monsters that can hurt you.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
很好，干得不错。
如果你能保持这样的耐心，就能救你一命。没有魔物能伤害到你。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
The <^ff0000Play Dead^000000> skill is in your skill list which you can open by pressing <Alt + S>, Please do not forget to use it, it will save you when you are in a danger.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
<^ff0000装死^000000>技能已经加入你的技能列表，你可以按<Alt + S>打开它。请别忘了使用它，在危险时刻它能救你一命。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
If you grow up and get another job, then you do not need this skill so do not spare it! Wse it when you need to and don't hesitate.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
如果你长大并转职，就不需要这个技能了，所以不要浪费它！需要时就用，不要犹豫。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I need to get some sleep, do not wake me up. Yawn.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
我要去睡觉了，别吵醒我。哈欠。

Hello, {0}.

I am in charge guiding you here in the Academy.
scripts.translation:

你好，{0}。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

It is your first step to be an adventurer that you have made a visit to us.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

On our next meeting, I anticipate you will grow up a bit more.

One who is not a Novice can't attend the educational course.
scripts.translation:

非初心者无法参加教育课程。

scripts.text:

However, a part of the educational course except the character cultivation can be freely attended. So, you may look around the Academy and neighboring places.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Are you ready to learn about abnormal statuses? I promise that I won't trick you anymore. I am a ''trainer'' after all right?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
准备好了解异常状态了吗？我保证不会再捉弄你了。毕竟我可是个“教官”嘛，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
First of all, I'll tell you about <^FF0000Poison^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
首先，我来给你讲讲<^FF0000中毒^000000>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
As you already experienced, when you are poisoned, your body turns purple and you lose a little HP every second.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
正如你之前体验到的，中毒后身体会变成紫色，并且每秒损失少量HP。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
You can't lose HP forever so you won't die from poison.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
HP不会无限流失，所以你不会死于中毒。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Experiencing is believing! I will put you in a poisoned status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
眼见为实！我要让你进入中毒状态。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
See what happens to you in the poisoned status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
看看你在中毒状态下会发生什么。

scripts.text: You are- <^FF0000Poisoned^000000>.

[Mainz]
Did you see what is the poisoned status? After a certain period of time, you could be detoxicated, but if you're being attached, it is dangerous to expect being detoxicated naturally.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
你看到中毒状态的效果了吗？经过一段时间后，毒素可能会自然消退，但如果持续受到攻击，指望自然解毒是很危险的。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Refer to the detoxicants such as <^0022FFGreen Herb^000000>, <^0022FFGreen Potion^000000>, <^0022FFPanacea^000000> and <^0022FFRoyal Jelly^000000>.

[Mainz]
Next, I'll tell you about<^FF0000 Stun^000000.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
接下来，我来给你讲讲<^FF0000眩晕^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
While in the Stun status, stars will circle around your head and you can't move basically you'll be ''defenseless''.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
处于眩晕状态时，你的头顶会转圈圈，基本上无法移动，也就是处于“无防备”状态。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
As you are defenseless, you can't move, use skills, and use items.
So, it is impossible to recover from it by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
由于处于无防备状态，你无法移动、使用技能或使用物品。
所以，你无法自行恢复。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
The exceptional case is you can recover from it by the skill called <^0022FFGentle Touch-Cure^000000> if you are a Sura.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
有一个例外情况：如果你是修罗，可以使用技能<^0022FF点穴-快^000000>来恢复。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
You can recover with skills such as the Priest's <^0022FFRecovery ^000000> or the Arch Bishop's <^0022FFLauda Ramus^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
你也可以通过牧师技能<^0022FF恢复^000000>或大主教技能<^0022FF折枝赞颂^000000>来恢复。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Let me show you what will happen in the Stun status!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
让我给你演示一下眩晕状态会发生什么！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
How was it?
Didn't you feel oppressed since you couldn't move?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
感觉如何？
因为无法移动，你难道没有感到压抑吗？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Imagine that you are in that status and monsters are rushing to you...
Believe me it'll happen.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
想象一下，当你处于这种状态时，魔物正朝你冲来...
相信我，这种情况真的会发生。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
This time, I will teach you about <^FF0000Sleep^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
这次，我要教你关于<^FF0000睡眠^000000>的知识。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In Sleep status, you fall asleep with a <Zzz> popped up over your head.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
在睡眠状态下，你会睡着，头顶会出现一个<Zzz>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Same as the Stun status, you are defenseless, but the difference is you can recover from the enemy's attack.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
和眩晕状态一样，你毫无防备，但不同的是，你可以从敌人的攻击中恢复过来。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
But in Sleep status, the possibility to be hit by ''Critical'' attacks from enemy's attack is increased, you are in danger and exposed a severe damage.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
不过在睡眠状态下，被敌人攻击命中“暴击”的可能性会增加，你会陷入危险并遭受严重伤害。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
For your reference, recovery by yourself is impossible and is only possible with the <^0022FF Recovery ^000000>skill of a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
供你参考，自己无法恢复，只能依靠牧师的<^0022FF恢复^000000>技能。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Let me show you what will happen in the Sleep status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
让我给你演示一下睡眠状态会发生什么。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
How was it? It isn't fun to imagine being asleep in front of a dangerous enemy is it?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
感觉如何？想象一下在危险的敌人面前睡着，这可不是什么好玩的事，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Sleep is good for recovery but not necessarily good while you're in the middle of a battle.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
睡眠虽然适合恢复，但在战斗正酣时并不一定有利。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Lastly, I will teach you about  <^FF0000 Silence ^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
最后，我要教你关于<^FF0000沉默^000000>的知识。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In Silence status,  you can't use any magic skills and a <...> will appear above your head.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
在沉默状态下，你无法使用任何魔法技能，头顶会出现一个<...>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
But all attacks are not impossible. Normal attacks can still be done while silenced.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
但这并不意味着所有攻击都不可行。沉默状态下仍然可以进行普通攻击。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In the silence status, you can merely still physically attack or recover by using potions.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
在沉默状态下，你只能进行物理攻击，或者通过使用药水来恢复。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
It's possible to recover with the items such as<^0022FF Green Herb^000000>, <^0022FFGreen Potion^000000>, <^0022FFPanacea^000000> and <^0022FFRoyal Jelly^000000>.

[Mainz]
Let me show you what will happen in Sleep status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
让我给你演示一下睡眠状态会发生什么。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
It's frustrating to not be able to use your skills right?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
无法使用技能是不是很令人沮丧？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Especially, when you are a high class depending upon the skills rather than physical attacks or in Sleep status during the battle, you will be damaged severely.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
特别是当你是一个依赖技能而非物理攻击的高阶职业，或者在战斗中陷入睡眠状态时，你会遭受严重伤害。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In addtion, there are other statuses like Darkness, Frozen, Curse, Stone, Confusion etc, but I can let you experience all of them.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
此外，还有黑暗、冰冻、诅咒、石化、混乱等状态，但我可以让你体验所有状态。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I hope this was helpful for you to experience some of the things that you will see out in the world.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
我希望这能帮助你体验一些在外界会遇到的情况。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Whenever you want to experience an abnormal status, please come to me.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
如果你想体验异常状态，请随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
As an apology for the lunchbox matter, I will give you a small gift.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
为了弥补午餐盒的事情，我会送你一份小礼物。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Wish you have good luck in your adventures!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
祝你在冒险中好运！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Hey, you there!
By any chance, are you a training beginner?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
嘿，你！
请问，你是刚入学的训练新手吗？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I'm Trainer Mainz; and I'm in charge of education at this Academy.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
我是教官美因茨，负责这所学院的教务工作。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Which course?
It is not important so I will let you know later.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
哪个课程？
这并不重要，我稍后会告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
You must be very exhausted after having to read and learn so much right?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
读了这么多书，你一定很累吧？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Of course, you are... Oh, you poor thing.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
当然，你是... 噢，可怜的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
There's a person who can help you when you need it.
Do you know who is it?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
当你需要帮助时，有个人可以帮你。
你知道是谁吗？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
That's me!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
就是我！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
What does that mean?
It means I have prepared a special gift just for your exhausted self!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
这是什么意思？
意思是我为你疲惫的身体准备了一份特别的礼物！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
A lunchbox for you!!! Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
给你的午餐盒！！！哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Since I'm not the one who made it don't worry.
My beloved wife prepared it. So, just be my guest and enjoy!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
既然不是我做的，你就别担心了。
是我亲爱的妻子准备的，所以，请随意享用！

scripts.text: Don't take it.
scripts.translation: 不要了

scripts.text: Take it.
scripts.translation: 喝

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
You don't want to have this lunchbox? I guess it's your loss then.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
你不想要这个午餐盒？那真是你的损失。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Should I just take it for myself then?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
那我干脆自己吃了吧？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Yes... You made a right decision.
Please keep in mind that I really wanted to have it but since you look exhausted I offered it to you first!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
是的... 你做了一个正确的决定。
请记住，我其实很想吃，但看你这么累，才先让给你的！

scripts.text: - You open the lunchbox and there is some type of food inside -
scripts.translation: - 你打开午餐盒，里面有一些食物 -

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Wahahahat! Don't hesitate and just take it!
It will refresh you from your fatigue!
Eat it~~ Eat it~~
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
哈哈哈哈哈！别犹豫，快吃吧！
它能帮你恢复疲劳！
吃吧~~ 吃吧~~

scripts.text: - Since you're tired and starved you're obliged to take the box -
scripts.translation: - 既然你又累又饿，你就不得不收下这个午餐盒了 -

scripts.text: - You eat the food and suddenly feel a sharp pain in your stomach. Your vision seems to be blurry too -
scripts.translation: - 你吃下食物后，突然感到胃部一阵剧痛。你的视线似乎也有些模糊 -

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Oh... what happened to you?
You don't look too good!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
哦... 你怎么了？
你看起来气色不太好！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Oh, man...
I think you've been poisoned.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
噢，天哪...
我想你中毒了。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I will give you an antidote. You might get better if you take it.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
我给你一瓶解毒剂。吃了可能会好一些。

scripts.text: - You reluctantly take the antidote -
scripts.translation: - 你勉强喝下了解毒剂 -

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Well, how the heck were you poisoned?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
喂，你到底是怎么中毒的？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
By the way, I heard that there's a ghost wandering around the Royal Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
顺便说一句，我听说皇家克里阿图拉学院附近有个幽灵在游荡。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I think the ghost must have poisoned you.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
我觉得那个幽灵肯定是在你身上下了毒。

scripts.text:
- You roll your eyes at Mainz -
- Mainz turns his head as if he doesn't notice -
scripts.translation:
- 你对美因茨翻了个白眼 -
- 美因茨转过头去，装作没注意到 -

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Ehem! Anyway, I am sorry.
Please understand there is no malice.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
咳！总之，我很抱歉。
请理解我并没有恶意。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
All of these are for you...
Want to know what I mean?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
这一切都是为了你好...
想知道我的意思吗？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
There are various kinds of monsters on the Midgard continent. And some of them can poison you or put you in abnormal conditions.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
米德加尔特大陆上有各种各样的魔物。其中有些会下毒或让你陷入异常状态。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Usually, anybody is too embarrassed to admit being poisoned without knowing.  I just did it on purpose to let you have the experience in case it happens out in the real world.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
通常，人们在不知情的情况下中毒时会感到尴尬。我故意这么做，是为了让你体验一下，以防在现实世界中遇到这种情况。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Understand that I didn't intend to pass my wife's lunchbox as if it was a present. It was just another lesson from the Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
请理解，我并不是故意把妻子的午餐盒当作礼物送你的。这只是克里阿图拉学院的一堂课而已。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
As an apology, I would like to inform you of several abnormal statuses you might experience in the Midgard Continent.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
作为道歉，我想向你介绍几种在米德加尔特大陆上可能遇到的异常状态。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Don't decline it! Being ready to learn so speak to me again.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
别拒绝！准备好学习的话，就再来和我对话。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Are you here for an explanation about the abnormal statuses? What makes you anxious?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
你是来了解异常状态的吗？是什么让你感到焦虑？

scripts.text: I have no questions.
scripts.translation: 我没有其他问题了。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I'll tell you about <^FF0000Poison^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
我来给你讲讲<^FF0000中毒^000000>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
As you already experienced, when you are poisoned, your body turns purple and you lose a little HP every second.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
正如你之前体验到的，中毒后身体会变成紫色，并且每秒损失少量HP。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
You can't lose HP forever so you won't die from poison.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
HP不会无限流失，所以你不会死于中毒。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Experiencing is believing! I will put you in a poisoned status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
眼见为实！我要让你进入中毒状态。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
See what happens to you in the poisoned status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
看看你在中毒状态下会发生什么。

scripts.text: You are- <^FF0000Poisoned^000000>.

[Mainz]
Did you see what is the poisoned status? After a certain period of time, you could be detoxicated, but if you're being attached, it is dangerous to expect being detoxicated naturally.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
你看到中毒状态的效果了吗？经过一段时间后，毒素可能会自然消退，但如果持续受到攻击，指望自然解毒是很危险的。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Refer to the detoxicants such as <^0022FFGreen Herb^000000>, <^0022FFGreen Potion^000000>, <^0022FFPanacea^000000> and <^0022FFRoyal Jelly^000000>.

[Mainz]
What else are you anxious about?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
还有什么让你感到焦虑的吗？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I'll tell you about <^FF0000Stun^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
我来给你讲讲<^FF0000眩晕^000000>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
While in the Stun status, stars will circle around your head and you can't move basically you'll be ''defenseless''.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
处于眩晕状态时，你的头顶会转圈圈，基本上无法移动，也就是处于“无防备”状态。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
As you are defenseless, you can't move, use skills, and use items.
So, it is impossible to recover from it by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
由于处于无防备状态，你无法移动、使用技能或使用物品。
所以，你无法自行恢复。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
The exceptional case is you can recover from it by the skill called <^0022FFGentle Touch-Cure^000000> if you are a Sura.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
有一个例外情况：如果你是修罗，可以使用技能<^0022FF点穴-快^000000>来恢复。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
You can recover with skills such as the Priest's <^0022FFRecovery ^000000> or the Arch Bishop's <^0022FFLauda Ramus^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
你也可以通过牧师技能<^0022FF恢复^000000>或大主教技能<^0022FF折枝赞颂^000000>来恢复。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Let me show you what will happen in the Stun status!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
让我给你演示一下眩晕状态会发生什么！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
How was it?
Didn't you feel oppressed since you couldn't move?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
感觉如何？
因为无法移动，你难道没有感到压抑吗？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Imagine that you are in that status and monsters are rushing to you...
Believe me it'll happen.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
想象一下，当你处于这种状态时，魔物正朝你冲来...
相信我，这种情况真的会发生。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
What else are you anxious about?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
还有什么让你感到焦虑的吗？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I will teach you about <^FF0000Sleep^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
我来教你<^FF0000睡眠^000000>的相关知识。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In Sleep status, you fall asleep with a <Zzz> popped up over your head.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
在睡眠状态下，你会睡着，头顶会出现一个<Zzz>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Same as the Stun status, you are defenseless, but the difference is you can recover from the enemy's attack.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
和眩晕状态一样，你毫无防备，但不同的是，你可以从敌人的攻击中恢复过来。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
But in Sleep status, the possibility to be hit by ''Critical'' attacks from enemy's attack is increased, you are in danger and exposed a severe damage.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
不过在睡眠状态下，被敌人攻击命中“暴击”的可能性会增加，你会陷入危险并遭受严重伤害。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
For your reference, recovery by yourself is impossible and is only possible with the <^0022FF Recovery ^000000>skill of a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
供你参考，自己无法恢复，只能依靠牧师的<^0022FF恢复^000000>技能。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Let me show you what will happen in the Sleep status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
让我给你演示一下睡眠状态会发生什么。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
How was it? It isn't fun to imagine being asleep in front of a dangerous enemy is it?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
感觉如何？想象一下在危险的敌人面前睡着，这可不是什么好玩的事，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Sleep is good for recovery but not necessarily good while you're in the middle of a battle.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
睡眠虽然适合恢复，但在战斗正酣时并不一定有利。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
What else are you anxious about?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
还有什么让你感到焦虑的吗？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I will teach you about  <^FF0000 Silence ^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
我来教你<^FF0000沉默^000000>的相关知识。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In Silence status,  you can't use any magic skills and a <...> will appear above your head.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
在沉默状态下，你无法使用任何魔法技能，头顶会出现一个<...>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
But all attacks are not impossible. Normal attacks can still be done while silenced.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
但这并不意味着所有攻击都不可行。沉默状态下仍然可以进行普通攻击。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In the silence status, you can merely still physically attack or recover by using potions.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
在沉默状态下，你只能进行物理攻击，或者通过使用药水来恢复。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
It's possible to recover with the items such as<^0022FF Green Herb^000000>, <^0022FFGreen Potion^000000>, <^0022FFPanacea^000000> and <^0022FFRoyal Jelly^000000>.

[Mainz]
Let me show you what will happen in Sleep status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
让我给你演示一下睡眠状态会发生什么。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
It's frustrating to not be able to use your skills right?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
无法使用技能是不是很令人沮丧？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Especially, when you are a high class depending upon the skills rather than physical attacks or in Sleep status during the battle, you will be damaged severely.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
特别是当你是一个依赖技能而非物理攻击的高阶职业，或者在战斗中陷入睡眠状态时，你会遭受严重伤害。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Do you have any more questions?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
你还有其他问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
If you don't have any more questions, would you please have my lunchbox on behalf of me?
No?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
如果你没有其他问题了，能不能帮我吃掉这个便当？
不？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Haaaaa...
What should I do with this lunchbox?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
哈啊...
这个便当该怎么办才好呢？

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Ahaaa~~ sticking at the dispensary.
Playing hooky is cool and awesome.
while XXXXXX, but what are you?
Are you the same kind of XXXXX?
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
啊哈~~ 赖在药房里。
翘课真是酷毙了。
虽然XXXXXX，但你是谁？
你是那种XXXXX吗？

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Ahaaa~~ sticking at the dispensary.
Playing hooky is cool and awesome.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
啊哈~~ 赖在药房里。
翘课真是酷毙了。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Hmmm... you look like you have some talent.
Being in a good mood, shall I show you something newfangled?
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
嗯...你看起来有点天赋。
既然心情不错，要不要给你看点新花样？

scripts.text: Newfangled?
scripts.translation: 新花样？

scripts.text: Who are you..?
scripts.translation: 你是谁..？

scripts.text: Why are you here?
scripts.translation: 你为什么在这里？

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text: Who are you..?
scripts.translation: 你是谁..？

scripts.text: Why are you here?
scripts.translation: 你为什么在这里？

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
I may look ordinary to you but I have a newfangled talent.
Not my fault, if you are shocked at seeing it.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
在我眼里你可能很普通，但我有一项新花样的天赋。
如果你看到后感到震惊，那可不是我的错。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
OK. Where should I start?
First, Bash!
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
好的。该从哪里开始呢？
首先，狂击！

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Hehehe.. Surprised?
I'm just pretending...
It's not a real punch.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
嘿嘿嘿..惊讶吗？
我只是装装样子...
这不是真的拳头。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Looks like you were surprised!
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
看来你很惊讶嘛！

scripts.text:
