scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
万物都需要平衡，有强有弱。所以^3131FF平衡与和谐^000000始终存在。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Balance and harmony is strongly related to your power as well. So remember well.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
平衡与和谐也与你的力量息息相关。所以请好好记住。

scripts.text: Water
scripts.translation: 水

scripts.text: Fire
scripts.translation: 解雇

scripts.text: Earth
scripts.translation: 地

scripts.text: Wind
scripts.translation: 风

scripts.text: Etc...
scripts.translation: 其他...

scripts.text: I already know
scripts.translation: 我已经知道了

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
^0D6EF2Water^000000 is stronger than ^FF0000Fire^000000, so they give bonus damage to anything with Fire attribute!
But it is weak to ^006600Wind^000000.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
^0D6EF2水^000000属性克制^FF0000火^000000属性，因此对火属性魔物造成额外伤害！
但水属性会被^006600风^000000属性克制。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Examples of monsters with the Water Attribute are Poring and Roda Frog... have you heard of those monsters?
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
水属性魔物的例子有波利和罗达蛙...你听说过这些魔物吗？

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
^FF0000Fire^000000 is stronger than ^B97246Earth^000000, so they give bonus damage to anything with Earth attribute!
Examples of monsters with the Fire Attribute are Drops and Picky.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
^FF0000火^000000属性克制^B97246地^000000属性，因此对地属性魔物造成额外伤害！
火属性魔物的例子有土波利和小鸡。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Examples of monsters with the Fire Attribute are Drops and Picky.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
火属性魔物的例子有土波利和小鸡。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
^B97246Earth^000000 is stronger than  ^006600Wind^000000, so they give bonus damage to anything with Wind attribute!
But it is weak to ^FF0000Fire^000000.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
^B97246地^000000属性克制^006600风^000000属性，因此对风属性魔物造成额外伤害！
但地属性会被^FF0000火^000000属性克制。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Examples of monsters with the Earth Attribute are Pupa and Fabre.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
地属性魔物的例子有虫蛹和绿棉虫。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
^006600Wind^000000 is stronger than ^0D6EF2Water^000000, so they give bonus damage to anything with Water attribute!
But it is weak to ^B97246Earth^000000.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
^006600风^000000属性克制^0D6EF2水^000000属性，因此对水属性魔物造成额外伤害！
但风属性会被^B97246地^000000属性克制。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Examples of monsters with the Wind Attribute are ChonChon and Hornet.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
风属性魔物的例子有苍蝇和蜂兵。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
^3131FFPoison^000000 is stronger than Fire, Wind, and Earth, but weak at Undead attribute.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
^3131FF毒^000000属性克制火、风、地属性，但会被不死属性克制。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
It is important.. Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
这很重要...不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Do you want to experience an attribute?
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
你想体验一下属性克制吗？

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
All right, do you see those ^3131FFFire Eggs^000000 over there?
Go over there and smack one of them.
Don't worry about destroying it either.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
好的，你看到那边的^3131FF火蛋^000000了吗？
过去打它一下。
不用担心会把它打坏。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
How is it? Have you ever attacked to Fire Eggs?
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
感觉如何？你以前攻击过火蛋吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit.
scripts.translation: 我想退出。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
How much damage did you give?
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
你造成了多少伤害？

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Oh man, {0}! Are you even trying?
You're barely hitting it.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
天哪，{0}！你是在认真打吗？
你几乎没打到它。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
You are good I guess...
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
看来你还挺厉害的...

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
But wait that's impossible.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
但等等，这不可能。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
All right. Class is over.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
好了，下课。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
I am not sure if you remember monsters with ^FF0000Fire^000000 are weak against ^0D6EF2Water^000000.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
我不确定你是否还记得，^FF0000火^000000属性魔物会被^0D6EF2水^000000属性克制。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
I will give the ^0D6EF2Water^000000 attribute to you as a present.
If you attack the Fire Eggs again you should do more damage now.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
作为礼物，我将赋予你^0D6EF2水^000000属性。
如果你再次攻击火蛋，现在应该能造成更多伤害了。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
There is only one more chance!
Hurry up, the attribute magic will be gone if you take more time thanks for joining to my class.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
只剩最后一次机会了！
快一点，属性魔法很快就会消失。谢谢你来上我的课。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Go and smack those eggs over there.
The egg of an ant is strong so don't worry about destroying them too much.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
去把那边的蛋打碎吧。
蚂蚁的蛋很坚硬，所以不用担心打不碎它们。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
There is nothing I can do. But I will help you anytime if you need.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
我无能为力。但如果你需要，我会随时帮助你。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Magic basically consists of different attribute attacks. There is another way of giving the attribute to your weapon by using skill or item. You will learn more the longer you play. Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
魔法基本上由不同的属性攻击组成。通过技能或物品，还有另一种方法可以给武器赋予属性。随着游戏时间的推移，你会学到更多。祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Are you getting interested in the depth of the different attributes?
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
你对不同属性的奥秘感兴趣吗？

scripts.output:
[达克瓦兹]
你带这么多东西干什么？
把它们放下，然后回来。
scripts.text:
Why are you carrying so much stuff?
Put them down and come back.

[Dacquoise]
What an alluring smell!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
多么诱人的香味！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Various dishes to stimulate the five senses. Oh, its heaven!
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
各种能刺激五感的菜肴。噢，简直是天堂！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
It's not an accident that you came here!
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
你能来到这里绝非偶然！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
What's your name stranger?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
陌生人，你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
I am Dacquoise, the pupil of the legendary chef of Rune-Midgarts, ^0000cdCharles Orleans^000000.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
我是达克瓦兹，卢恩·米德加兹传奇厨师^0000cd查尔斯·奥尔良^000000的弟子。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
And we are also club members of Sir Orleans' ^0000cdfan club- Loverleans^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
我们也是奥尔良爵士^0000cd粉丝俱乐部——勒奥尔良^000000的成员。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Orlean belongs to all of us!
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
奥尔良属于我们所有人！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Ah, what do all the fools of the land eat?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
啊，这片土地上的愚民都吃什么？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Fruits? Of course you can eat it raw, but isn't it art when you see the red strawberries laying on top of a creampie?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
水果？当然你可以生吃，但当你看到红色的草莓躺在奶油上时，难道不觉得那是艺术吗？

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Bread? Of course you can eat it plain, but can you resist the fantastic harmony of meat and cheese and vegetables in a perfect sandwich?
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
面包？当然你可以直接吃，但你能抗拒完美三明治中肉类、奶酪和蔬菜的绝妙和谐吗？

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
I like the steamed horse feet of Minourus!
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
我喜欢米诺鲁斯的蒸马脚！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
If you eat a dedicated meal, you can ^0000cdraise a specific stats^000000 and additionally, ^0000cdrecover your health^000000, so what's the reason not to cook?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
如果你吃一顿精心准备的餐食，可以^0000cd提升特定属性^000000，此外还能^0000cd恢复生命值^000000，那还有什么理由不烹饪呢？

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
You, do you want to know more about cooking?
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
你，想了解更多关于烹饪的知识吗？

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Will you exeprience the various spectrums of cooking?
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
你想体验烹饪的种种奥妙吗？

scripts.text: I'm not interested, excuse me...
scripts.translation: 我不感兴趣，失礼了...

scripts.text: Wow! I want to know more!
scripts.translation: 哇！我想知道更多！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Really? Okay then... come back whenever you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
真的吗？好吧...等你改变主意时随时回来。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
I have a hunch that you will come back again!
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
我预感你会再回来的！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Don't forget to pound your chest if you choke on sweet potato!
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
如果吃红薯噎住了，别忘了捶捶胸口哦！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Ok, we will be kind guides to the journey of cooking!!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
好的，我们将成为你烹饪之旅的贴心向导！！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
It's ok with me, asking me everthing you want to know.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
没问题，尽管问你想了解的一切。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Kindness is our spice~
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
亲切就是我们的调味~

scripts.text: Cooking Benefits
scripts.translation: 烹饪的好处

scripts.text: Cooking Methods
scripts.translation: 烹饪方法

scripts.text: Actually, I have to go...
scripts.translation: 其实，我得走了...

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Aha! You want to know about the benefits of cooking? Cooked meals have two benefits!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
啊哈！你想了解烹饪的好处吗？烹饪后的食物有两个好处！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
First, ^0000cdincreased stats!^000000 Baaam!!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
第一，^0000cd提升属性！^000000 砰！！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Cooking is divided into 6 catagories. Each will raise up ^0000cdStr, Agi, Vit, Int, Dex, Luk^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
烹饪分为6种类别。每种都会提升^0000cd力量、敏捷、体质、智力、幸运、魅力^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
The amount of the stat increase changes depending on the level of cooking.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
属性提升的幅度取决于烹饪等级。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
And the next benefit? Babam!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
那下一个好处呢？巴姆！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
^0000cdHP and SP recovery^000000 effect!
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
^0000cd恢复HP和SP^000000的效果！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
This also differs with cooking levels, and some only recover HP.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
这也随烹饪等级而变化，有些食物只恢复HP。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
How is it? Sounds yummy right?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
怎么样？听起来很美味吧？

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Your level is too low to experience the effects right now. If you level up more you will experience and cry for the effect of cooking.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
你的等级太低，现在还无法体验这些效果。等你等级再高一些，就会体验到烹饪的效果，甚至感动得哭出来。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Prepare lace handkerchief.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
记得准备好蕾丝手帕。

scripts.text: How can I cook?
scripts.translation: 如何烹饪？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
There you go! Now you seem interested!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
这就对了！看来你很有兴趣嘛！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
But haste is waste in cooking! Proper cooking requires preparation.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
但在烹饪中，急躁是浪费！正确的烹饪需要充分的准备。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Only the one who is well prepared can enter the world of cooking!
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
只有准备充分的人，才能进入烹饪的世界！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Preparation, it's not hard!
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
准备工作，其实不难！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Preparation can also be split into two stages.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
准备工作也可以分为两个阶段。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Right, cooking needs some preparation. This can also be divided into two catagories.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
没错，烹饪需要一些准备。这也可以分为两类。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
What is this? What a waste of time!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
这是什么？真是浪费时间！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
I thought we were going to get more members!
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
我还以为我们要招更多成员呢！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Never show up again!!
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
再也不要出现了！！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
First, you need a ^0000cdCookbook.^000000
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
首先，你需要一本^0000cd食谱^000000。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Let's say you have a mountain of ingredients, but you don't know what to do with them?
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
假设你有一堆食材，但不知道该怎么处理它们？

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
That's when you open the Cookbook.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
这时候你就该翻开食谱了。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
You need a Cookbook to know how to prepare the ingredients for cooking.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
你需要食谱来了解如何准备烹饪所需的食材。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
So how can I get these Cookbooks?
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
那我该如何获得这些食谱呢？

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Cookbook can be earned ^0000cdthrough Quest^000000s or can be found by hunting ^0000cdmonster^000000s.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
食谱可以通过^0000cd任务^000000获得，也可以通过狩猎^0000cd魔物^000000掉落。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
After getting the Cookbook, next preperation is!
The ^0000cdingredients!^000000.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
拿到食谱后，下一个准备事项是！
^0000cd食材！^000000

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
You can't cook without ingredients! Even a novice knows that!
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
没有食材怎么烹饪！连初心者都知道这一点！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
You can get ingredients by beating or smashing ^0000cdmonster^000000 or you can buy them from a ^0000cdCooking Ingredient Merchant^000000.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
你可以通过击败或击碎^0000cd魔物^000000来获取食材，也可以从^0000cd烹饪食材商人^000000那里购买。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Cooking requires some preparation but the benefits are well worth it.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
烹饪需要一些准备，但回报绝对值得。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
And one thing to remember, there is ^0000cda potential to fail in cooking^000000.  Be careful as it depends on your cookwares and cooking level.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
还有一点要记住，烹饪^0000cd有失败的可能性^000000。请小心，这取决于你的厨具和烹饪等级。

scripts.text: I want to cook!
scripts.translation: 我要烹饪！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
That's the spirit! Let's cook for real!
Get prepared and come back!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
好有干劲！让我们真正开始烹饪吧！
做好准备后再回来！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
We are not responsible even if it fails!
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
即使失败了，我们也不负责哦！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Did you bring them all?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
你都带齐了吗？

scripts.text: Yes! I did!
scripts.translation: 是的！都带了！

scripts.text: No, I gave up.
scripts.translation: 不，我放弃了。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
I used my valuable time to introduce the cooking world to you.
Then you just give up?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
我花了宝贵的时间向你介绍烹饪世界。
结果你直接放弃了？

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
You have insulted us!
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
你这是在侮辱我们！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Come back again, if you want to learn later~ I guess...
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
如果你以后还想学，欢迎再来~ 我想...

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Can I have a look?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
可以让我看看吗？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
You brough what I need! Okay, then I will cook for you as I promised.
Time to move like greased lightning!!!!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
你带来了我所需要的东西！好的，那么我会履行承诺为你烹饪。
时间到了，像抹了黄油一样飞速行动吧！！！！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Go hunting after eating this. You will feel your power enhanced.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
吃完这个再去狩猎。你会感觉到力量增强了。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
If you really want to cook, go and see ^0000ffSir. Charles Orleans at the basement of Prontera castle^000000!!
Kya... Sir Orleans!!
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
如果你真的想烹饪，去^0000ff普隆德拉王宫地下室的查尔斯·奥尔良爵士^000000那里看看！！
哎呀...奥尔良爵士！！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
You brough what I need! Okay, then I will cook for you as I promised.
Time to move like greased lightning!!!!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
你带来了我所需要的东西！好的，那么我会履行承诺为你烹饪。
时间到了，像抹了黄油一样飞速行动吧！！！！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Try this. It will make you run like you are a flying bee.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
尝尝这个。它会让你跑得像一只飞行的蜜蜂。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
If you really want to cook, go and see ^0000ffSir. Charles Orleans at the basement of Prontera castle^000000!! You must be attracted by him!!
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
如果你真的想烹饪，去^0000ff普隆德拉王宫地下室的查尔斯·奥尔良爵士^000000那里看看！！你一定会被他吸引的！！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
You brough what I need! Okay, then I will cook for you as I promised.
Time to move like greased lightning!!!!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
你带来了我所需要的东西！好的，那么我会履行承诺为你烹饪。
时间到了，像抹了黄油一样飞速行动吧！！！！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Can you feel unknown power coursing through your veins? You're eating it!
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
你能感觉到一股未知的力量在血管中奔涌吗？你正在吃它呢！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
If you are really curious about the cooking, go seek Sir. Charles Orleans at the basement of Prontera Castle.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
如果你真的对烹饪感到好奇，那就去普隆德拉王宫的地下室找查尔斯·奥尔良爵士吧。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
You brough what I need! Okay, then I will cook for you as I promised.
Time to move like greased lightning!!!!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
你带来了我所需要的东西！好的，那么我会履行承诺为你烹饪。
时间到了，像抹了黄油一样飞速行动吧！！！！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
If you eat this. You will never miss your target!
In fact, never miss the target for level 1!
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
吃了这个，你就再也不会打偏了！
事实上，1级时也不会打偏！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Go and see Sir. Charles Orleans at the basement of Prontera castle!!
You can learn real cooking from him!
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
去普隆德拉王宫的地下室找查尔斯·奥尔良爵士吧！！
你可以从他那里学到真正的烹饪！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
What do you want me to do without ingredients? Go and get them myself?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
没有食材你想让我做什么？难道要我自己去弄吗？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
You came back to me again because you want to cook, right?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
你又回来了，是因为想烹饪，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
So what do you want to cook?
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
那么你想做什么菜？

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Oh? That kid is back again. {0} right? So what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
哦？那个小孩又来了。是{0}对吧？那么你想要什么？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Are you ready? Then making is believing! Let's cook!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
准备好了吗？那就开始吧！让我们烹饪！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
For this demonstration the duration of the cooking will be shortened.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
为了这次演示，烹饪时间将被缩短。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
The cooking we are about to show you requires a recipe and cooking equipment but it is difficult for novices so I will cook for you.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
我们要向你展示的烹饪需要食谱和烹饪设备，但这对于初心者来说很难，所以我会为你烹饪。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Why are you saying you will make them?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
你为什么要说你会做？

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Ah, Why not?
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
啊，为什么不呢？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
I am the leader of this flame cooking trio chefs!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
我是这个火焰烹饪三人组厨师的首领！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
What?!! When was that decided?
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
什么？！！什么时候决定的？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Is there anyone who is older than me?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
有比我年纪大的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Age! There is nothing I can do with it.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
年龄！对此我无能为力。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Just because you're one year older, you want to automatically be rejected. Anyone have an objection?
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
仅仅因为你大一岁，就自动被拒绝。有人反对吗？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Quiet!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
安静！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
So what do you want to make? Int and Luk meals would have no benefit to you, so I prepared the other 4 foods.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
那么你想做什么？Int和Luk餐对你没有好处，所以我准备了其他4种食物。

scripts.text: Fragrant Herb Mix
scripts.translation: 芳香草药混合

scripts.text: Crunchy Salad
scripts.translation: 脆爽沙拉

scripts.text: Mixed Shabu Shabu
scripts.translation: 什锦火锅

scripts.text: Golden Apple Roast
scripts.translation: 金苹果烤

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
^0000cdFragrant Herb Mix^000000. It increases ^0000cdStr^000000.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
^0000cd芳香草药混合^000000。它能提升^0000cdStr^000000。

scripts.text:
[Equazu]
It's usually eaten by people of strength.
scripts.translation:
[埃夸祖]
通常由强壮的人食用。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Ingredients- ^0000cd1 Clover, 1 Green Herb, 1 Red Herb^000000.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
材料- ^0000cd1 三叶草, 1 绿色药草, 1 红色药草^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Clover and the Red Herb are dropped by Lunatic or Fabre monsters wandering everywhere on the field outside Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
三叶草和红色药草由在依斯鲁得岛外野外游荡的疯兔或绿棉虫掉落。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Green Herbs are dropped by Fabres.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
绿色药草由绿棉虫掉落。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
We can cook once you bring all the ingredients.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
集齐所有材料后，我们就可以烹饪了。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Crunchy Salad. This I really like. You know your cooking.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
脆爽沙拉。这个我真的很喜欢。你很懂烹饪嘛。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Crunchy Salad increases ^0000cdAgi^000000. Good for fast attacks and avoiding damage from monsters.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
脆爽沙拉能提升^0000cdAgi^000000。适合快速攻击和躲避魔物的伤害。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Ingredients are ^0000cd1 Apple & 2 Carrots^000000.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
材料是^0000cd1 苹果 & 2 胡萝卜^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Apples are dropped by Porings bouncing around the field outside of Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
苹果由在依斯鲁得岛外野外蹦跳的波利掉落。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Carrots are given by Lunatics.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
胡萝卜由疯兔掉落。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
If you bring all the ingredients we can cook.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
集齐所有材料后，我们就可以烹饪了。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Scary ^0000cdAnything ShabuShabu!^000000 This raises ^0000cdVit^000000. Even a small portion makes you full.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
可怕的^0000cd什锦火锅！^000000 它能提升^0000cdVit^000000。即使只吃一小份也能吃饱。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
If you eat this, you can feel less pain from monsters.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
吃了这个，你能感觉到魔物造成的疼痛减轻。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Ingredients are ^0000cd1 Jellopy, 1 Fluff, 1 Feather^000000.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
材料是^0000cd1 杰勒比结晶, 1 绒毛, 1 羽毛^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Jellopy are dropped by Porings bouncing around the field of Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
杰勒比结晶由在依斯鲁得岛野外蹦跳的波利掉落。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Fluff can be received from Fabre or Lunatic.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
绒毛可以从绿棉虫或疯兔那里获得。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Feathers are dropped by Lunatics or Fabres.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
羽毛由疯兔或绿棉虫掉落。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
When you bring all the ingredients I'll make them for you.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
当你把所有材料都带来时，我会为你制作。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
^0000cdGolden Apple Toast~^000000 shiny golden glaze...  It tastes as good as it looks.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
^0000cd金苹果吐司~^000000 闪闪发光的金色光泽... 味道和外观一样美味。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
This raises ^0000cdDex^000000. It is mainly enjoyed by Archers who want to increase his attacking power or by people to increase their hit rate.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
这能提升^0000cd敏捷^000000。主要受那些想要提高攻击力的弓箭手，或想要提高命中率的人喜爱。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Ingredients are-^0000cd 1 Apple & 1 Clover^000000.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
材料是^0000cd 1 苹果 & 1 三叶草^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Apple can be found in Porings in the field outside of Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
苹果可以在依斯鲁得岛野外的波利身上找到。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Clovers are dropped by Lunatics or Fabre in the field outside Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
三叶草由依斯鲁得岛野外的疯兔或绿棉虫掉落。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
When you bring all the ingredients I'll make them for you.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
当你把所有材料都带来时，我会为你制作。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
I am Dacquoise, the pupil of the legendary chef of Rune-Midgarts, ^0000cdCharles Orleans^000000.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
我是达克瓦兹，卢恩·米德加兹传奇厨师^0000cd查尔斯·奥尔良^000000的弟子。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Steaks not only increase stats but also recover both your HP and SP.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
牛排不仅能提升属性，还能恢复你的HP和SP。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
If you really want to cook, go and see^0000cd Sir. Charles Orleans at the basement of Prontera castle^000000!! You must be attracted by him!!
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
如果你真的想学烹饪，去普隆德拉王宫地下室找^0000cd查尔斯·奥尔良先生^000000吧！！你一定会被他吸引的！！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Looks like you're no longer a beginner. Are you cooking these days?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
看来你不再是新手了。最近有在烹饪吗？

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
If not why don't we start?
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
如果没有的话，我们开始吧？

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Steaks not only increase stats but also recover both your HP and SP.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
牛排不仅能提升属性，还能恢复你的HP和SP。

scripts.text:
[Flame Cook Trio Chefs]
If you really want to cook, go and meet ^0000cdSir. Charles Olreans at the basement of the Prontera castle^000000! You must be attracted by him.
scripts.translation:
[烈焰料理三人组]
如果你真的想学烹饪，去普隆德拉王宫地下室见^0000cd查尔斯·奥尔良先生^000000吧！你一定会被他吸引的。

scripts.text:
Quest cannot be continued due to the overfilled inventory.
Please try it again after organizing the items.
scripts.translation:
由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。
请整理物品后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Are you interested in the beginner's guild?
I am selling Combination books and kits.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
你对新手公会感兴趣吗？
我在出售组合书和组合专用工具。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
To the Criatura students below level 20, a special sale is going on. Hope you to buy a lot!!!
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
针对20级以下的克里亚图拉学院学生，正在进行特别促销。希望你们多买一些！！！

scripts.text: Novice Combination Book
scripts.translation: 新手物品组合书

scripts.text: Combination Kit
scripts.translation: 组合专用工具

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Have you been treated by the Therapist?
At the medical botany class, you may receive a guild book.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
你接受过治疗师的治疗吗？
在医学植物学课上，你可以获得公会书。

scripts.text: Ah... is that so?
scripts.translation: 啊...是这样吗？

scripts.text: I lost it.
scripts.translation: 我弄丢了。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Later, buy a lot of the guild combination kits~~~
I am selling them at a jaw dropping price to students below base level 20.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
之后，请多买一些公会组合专用工具~~~
对于基础等级20以下的学生，我会以令人震惊的低价出售。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Say what?
A book costs you 1000z.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
你说什么？
一本书要1000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
You mean the combination book.
A book costs you 1000z.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
你是说组合书。
一本书要1000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Buy
scripts.translation: 购买

scripts.text: Don't buy.
scripts.translation: 不买

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Use it next time.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
下次再用吧。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Here you are.
This book is for the beginners. But it will allow you combine the useful tools together, if you use it correctly.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
给你。
这本书适合初学者。但如果正确使用，它能让你将有用的工具组合在一起。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
The book price is 1000 zeny.
You seem to be short of zeny.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
这本书的价格是1000 Zeny。
看来你的Zeny不够。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Breaking news! Special sale for you only!
One combination kit only for 30z!
How many do you need?
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
突发新闻！仅限你的特价促销！
一套组合专用工具只要30 Zeny！
你需要多少？

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
No sales today.
One combination kit costs you 500z.
Tell me how many pieces you need?
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
今天没有特价。
一套组合专用工具要500 Zeny。
告诉我你需要多少？

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Well, you don't need to buy it now.
Use it next time.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
嗯，你现在不需要买。
下次再用吧。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
How many pieces do you need?
You can buy up to 99 at once.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
你需要多少？
一次最多可以买99个。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
{0} combination kits will cost you {1}.... zeny.
You look short of money for that amount.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
{0}套组合专用工具需要{1}... Zeny。
看来你的钱不够买这么多。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
{0} combination kits will cost you {1}.... zeny.
Thank you. Come back again.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
{0}套组合专用工具需要{1}... Zeny。
谢谢。欢迎下次再来。

scripts.text:
- You have too many items.
- Clear inventory and try again.
scripts.translation:
- 你的物品栏已满。
- 请清理物品栏后重试。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
You shouldn't be like this, you are high enough to change your job.
I won't stop you even if you stay still...
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
你不应该这样，你的等级已经足够转职了。
即使你站着不动，我也不会阻止你...

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
Try to talk to ^ff0000each job instructor^000000 on the 2nd floor of the Academy if you aren't sure what job you want still.
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
如果你还不确定想转职成什么职业，可以去学院二楼找^ff0000各职业指导员^000000谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
Welcome!
I am ^ff0000Battle Instructor Subino^000000.
I ^ff0000provice a simple request^000000 to help you to grow up as good a soldier as fast as you can, so look around.
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
欢迎！
我是^ff0000战斗指导员 苏比诺^000000。
我^ff0000提供简单的任务^000000，帮助你尽快成长为优秀的士兵，所以请四处看看。

scripts.text: Check requests
scripts.translation: 查看任务

scripts.text: Warp me to the Field
scripts.translation: 传送到野外

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text: The most delicious in the world (1~3)
scripts.translation: 世界上最美味的食物 (1~3)

scripts.text: Carrots are delicious (1~3)
scripts.translation: 美味的胡萝卜 (1~3)

scripts.text: Fabre rolling clothes (4~6)
scripts.translation: 绿棉虫的绒毛 (4~6)

scripts.text: Barrier!! (4~6)
Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
^ff0000Poring^000000s are very cute monsters when you see them.
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
^ff0000波利^000000看起来是非常可爱的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
They drop Jellopy which are regarded as a main cooking material in Criatura Academy so we always need to hunt Porings.
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
它们会掉落杰勒比结晶，这是克里阿图拉学院的主要烹饪材料，所以我们需要经常狩猎波利。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
^ff0000Lunatic^000000s are very cute animal that live near Prontera.
Tender...Soft...Very cute... It is very cute........
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
^ff0000疯兔^000000是生活在普隆德拉附近的非常可爱的动物。
软绵绵...毛茸茸...非常可爱...真的很可爱........

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
It always bring ^ff0000Carrot^000000s with it, so it is easy to get a delicious carrot by hunting them.
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
它们总是带着^ff0000胡萝卜^000000，所以狩猎它们很容易就能获得美味的胡萝卜。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
A carrot has lots of fibrous cells and contains vitamin A and carotin so it is good for eyes!
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
胡萝卜富含纤维细胞，含有维生素A和胡萝卜素，对眼睛很有好处！

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
^ff0000Fabre^000000 is the most common bug which is usually seen in Rune-Midgarts Kingdom..
It is a worm but it is very popular because it looks cute.
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
^ff0000绿棉虫^000000是卢恩·米德加兹王国最常见的虫子。
虽然它是虫子，但因为长得可爱而很受欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
Most of the clothes provided by Criatura Academy are made from ^ff0000Fluff^000000 from Fabres. It makes very strong and warm fabric.
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
克里阿图拉学院提供的大部分服装都是用^ff0000绿棉虫^000000的绒毛制成的。它能制成非常结实且保暖的布料。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
^ff0000Pupa^000000 is the intermediate stage of a Fabre before transforming into a Creamy.
The process of a larva turning into a buttefly is mysterious.
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
^ff0000虫蛹^000000是绿棉虫变成克瑞米之前的中间阶段。
幼虫变成蝴蝶的过程充满了神秘感。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
As a Fabre transforms to a Creamy I hope that all Novices turn to be great adventurers! So ^ff0000Chrysalis^000000.
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
就像绿棉虫变成克瑞米一样，我希望所有初心者都能成长为伟大的冒险者！所以^ff0000破茧成蝶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
^ff0000Hornet^000000s are a group of bees that live near Prontera under control of the Queen bee Mistress.
Not aggressive... They only attack with their stingers when they are in danger.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text: Taming a monster

scripts.text: Hatching the egg
scripts.translation: 孵化蛋

scripts.text: Monitoring pet's status
scripts.translation: 查看宠物状态

scripts.text: Feeding

scripts.text: Performances
scripts.translation: 表演

scripts.text: Removing the accessory

scripts.text: Transforming back to egg
scripts.translation: 变回蛋

scripts.text: End Conversation

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Only some monsters can become pets and they all have different things to tame them.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
只有部分魔物可以成为宠物，而且驯服它们所需的物品各不相同。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Each monster that can be tamed requires a specific ^3131FFtaming item^000000.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
每种可驯服的魔物都需要特定的^3131FF驯服物品^000000。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
To begin taming,
^3131FFdouble click^000000 the taming item in your inventory and select which monster to tame.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
要开始驯服，请在物品栏中^3131FF双击^000000驯服物品，并选择要驯服的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Press ^3131FFClick^000000 in the center of the pop-up slot machine to tame the monster..
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
点击弹出窗口中央的^3131FF点击^000000按钮即可驯服魔物。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
If successful, the monster will be tranformed into an egg!
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
如果成功，魔物就会变成一颗蛋！

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Hatching requires you to have a ^3131FF<Pet Incubator>^000000 to awaken a monster in the egg.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
孵化需要持有^3131FF<携带用孵蛋器>^000000，才能唤醒蛋中的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Most towns have a ^3131FF<Pet Groomer>^000000 where you can buy the ^3131FF<Pet Incubator>^000000.
Ask the town guide for the location of the Pet Groomer if you can't find them.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
大多数城镇都有^3131FF<宠物美容师>^000000，可以在那里购买^3131FF<携带用孵蛋器>^000000。
如果找不到，可以询问城镇向导宠物美容师的位置。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
^3131FFRight-click^000000 on your pet and select ^3131ffCheck the Pet Status^000000 to check on its status. Or you can press ^3131FF<Alt+J>^000000.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
^3131FF右键点击^000000您的宠物并选择^3131ff查看宠物状态^000000即可检查其状态。或者您可以按下^3131FF<Alt+J>^000000。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
This will open up the Status Window. Here you can change the pet's ^3131FFname^000000 as well as check their ^3131FFHunter^000000 and ^3131FFIntimacy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
这将打开状态窗口。在这里您可以更改宠物的^3131FF名字^000000，并查看其^3131FF猎人^000000和^3131FF亲密度^000000。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
There are some special pets that gives special skills when their ^3131FFIntimacy^000000 level becomes Loyal. Most pets start off as shy and time and food changes that.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
有些特殊的宠物在^3131FF亲密度^000000达到“忠诚”时会获得特殊技能。大多数宠物一开始都很害羞，随着时间和喂食，它们会发生变化。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
<Pet Food> is normal food for pets but some pets prefer other foods. You should keep enough with you so your pet doesn't get hungry.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
<宠物饲料>是宠物的普通食物，但有些宠物更喜欢其他食物。您应该随身携带足够的食物，以免宠物饿肚子。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Pets will ^3131FFrun away^000000 if they are too full or too hungry. So make sure you check your pets hunger status frequently!
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
如果宠物太饱或太饿，它们会^3131FF逃跑^000000。所以请经常检查宠物的饥饿状态！

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Some pets will show a special performance when they are in a good mood.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
有些宠物在心情好时会展示特殊的表演。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Some pets can even wear accessory items.
^3131FF<Pet Groomer>^000000 will sell some pet accessory items but some monsters will also drop pet accessory items as well.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
有些宠物甚至可以佩戴饰品。
^3131FF<宠物美容师>^000000会出售一些宠物饰品，但某些魔物也会掉落宠物饰品。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
I think it is better off experiencing more together than transforming back to the eggs?
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
我觉得一起经历更多事情，比变回蛋更好吧？

scripts.text:

Come back again when you have another question.
scripts.translation:

如果有其他问题，欢迎随时回来。

只要与宠物的^3131FF亲密度^000000足够高，就能实现这些效果。

Intimacy requires a time commitment and a lot of food. Food is the way to any being's loyalty right? ha ha

[Adept Adventurer]
You can return to the Academy through the portal to the north.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
你可以通过北边的传送门返回学园。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Would you look at that...Porings growing in the garden of the closed Criatura Academy like little Jelly Babies.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
你看...在封闭的克里阿图拉学园的花园里，波利像小果冻宝宝一样生长着。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Not all monsters in Midgard are our for your blood, just most of them.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
米德加尔特并非所有魔物都渴望你的鲜血，只是大多数如此。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Take a look at that, looks like that ^3131FFPoring^000000 has something to say to you
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
你看，那只^3131FF波利^000000似乎有话想对你说。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
If you are confused, Please check the quest status by pressing ^3131FF<Alt+U>^000000 anytime.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
如果你感到困惑，请随时按下^3131FF<Alt+U>^000000查看任务状态。

scripts.text: How to gain Unripe Apples
scripts.translation: 如何获得青苹果

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
You'd want to go to the Dispensary to learn how to make ^3131FFUnripe Apple^000000s.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
你应该去药房学习如何制作^3131FF青苹果^000000。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
One of the staff there should have a ^3131FFItem compounding book^000000 for novices, ^3131FFHow to make Unripe Apples^000000 is one of the subjects.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
那里的工作人员应该有一本给初心者看的^3131FF物品合成书^000000，^3131FF如何制作青苹果^000000就是其中的一门课题。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
So you used the taming item on the Little Porings, then they turned into eggs?
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
所以你对宝贝波利使用了驯服道具，然后它们变成了蛋？

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Ha ha ha, don't fret my pet.
You just cleared ^3131FFtaming^000000.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
哈哈，别担心，我的宠物。
你刚刚通过了^3131FF驯服^000000测试。

scripts.text: Taming?
scripts.translation: 驯服？

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Yep, it means you are ready to be a friend like me and Debbie Ruchi.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
没错，这意味着你准备好像我或德比·鲁奇一样成为朋友了。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
There are lots of different monsters and tames out there.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
外面有很多不同的魔物和宠物。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
If you successfully tame it you end up with a little egg.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
如果你成功驯服了它，就会得到一颗小蛋。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
So congratulations again for passing the test, the friendship test!
Ask anytime whenever you have a question about cute pets.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
再次恭喜你通过了测试，也就是友谊测试！
关于可爱宠物的问题，随时可以来问我。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Do you see the shivering poring over there? Go easy on the lil' blighter, okay?
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
你看到那边发抖的波利了吗？对这小东西温柔点，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
If you are confused, Please check the quest status by clicking ^3131FF<Alt+U>^000000 anytime.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
如果你感到困惑，请随时点击^3131FF<Alt+U>^000000查看任务状态。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
You have too many items to continue the quest.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
你的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Open inventory with ^3131FFAlt+E^000000 key, if you find unnecessaty items, sell them to ^3131FFmerchant^000000 or put into ^3131FFwarehouse^000000 by using kafra service~.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
按^3131FFAlt+E^000000打开物品栏，如果发现有不必要的物品，可以卖给^3131FF商人^000000，或者使用卡普拉服务存入^3131FF仓库^000000~。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Help me novice...
scripts.translation:
[波利]
帮帮我，初心者...

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Dear oh dear...what do we have 'ere?
scripts.translation:
[波利]
天哪...这是怎么回事？

scripts.text: What happened?
scripts.translation: 发生了什么？

scripts.text: Ignore him/it?
scripts.translation: 无视它？

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Oh dear, oh dear...
scripts.translation:
[波利]
天哪，天哪...

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Wot a sad state of affairs.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
真是糟糕透顶。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
That geeza' ghostring got defeated out in his dungeon and came here to pick on other monsters like me.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
那个臭幽灵波利在迷宫里被打败了，就跑来这里欺负像我这样的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
I'm too low level to stop 'im, you can hear them cheering now...
scripts.translation:
[波利]
我的等级太低，根本打不过它，你现在还能听到它们在欢呼...

scripts.text:
[Ghostring]
Oi you lot! Tell me wot I want to hear!
scripts.translation:
[幽灵波利]
喂，你们这群家伙！告诉我你们想听的话！

scripts.text:
[Unskilled Poring]
Ghostring's the strongest in the world!
scripts.translation:
[笨拙的波利]
幽灵波利是世界上最强的！

scripts.text:
[Ghostring]
What kind of monster I am?
scripts.translation:
[幽灵波利]
我是什么样的魔物？

scripts.text:
[Unskilled Poring]
Ghostring's da Boss!
scripts.translation:
[笨拙的波利]
幽灵波利是大BOSS！

scripts.text:
[Ghostring]
Bwa ha ha ha~
scripts.translation:
[幽灵波利]
哇哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Bleedin' shame...
Little Porings takin' up with a git like that and not bein' cute anymore.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
真是丢人现眼...
宝贝波利竟然跟那种家伙混在一起，一点都不可爱了。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
The Little Porings aren't bad'uns, they've just not been to the outside world.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
宝贝波利们其实不坏，只是它们没见过外面的世界。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
If this keeps up, all of the Porings in Midgard will be under the sway of Ghostring.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
如果这样下去，米德加尔特所有的波利都会受幽灵波利控制了。

scripts.text: Can I help you?
scripts.translation: 我能帮你吗？

scripts.text: Too bad.
scripts.translation: 真可惜。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Oh dear, oh dear.....
scripts.translation:
[波利]
天哪，天哪.....

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Now that you mention it sir, I could use some help.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
既然您这么说了，先生，我确实需要一些帮助。

scripts.text:
[Unskilled Poring]
Wot's Dat? Onna them Poring's talkin' to a huumie.
Shall we beat him up?
scripts.translation:
[笨拙的波利]
那是什么？居然有波利在跟人类说话。
我们要不要揍他一顿？

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Blimey!
Help me! Save me!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
天哪！
帮帮我！救救我！

scripts.text: What can I do to help?
scripts.translation: 我能做什么来帮忙？

scripts.text:
[Poring]
I do have a good idea!
Come over here!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
我有个好主意！
过来这边！

scripts.text:
[Poring]
This is ^3131FFunripe apple^000000.
The favorite items for Little Poring to eat.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
这是^3131FF青苹果^000000。
是宝贝波利最爱吃的东西。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Maybe you can use it to tempt them away from listenin' to Ghostring.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
也许你可以用它来引诱它们，让它们别听幽灵波利的话。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
^3131FFDouble click the unripe apple^000000 that I gave you and ^3131FFselect^000000 a ^3131FFLittle Poring^000000 that you fancy.

[Poring]
TThe click the centre of the slot machine.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
点击老虎机的中间。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
That'll lure them from out of Ghostring's influence.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
这样就能把它们从幽灵波利的影响中引开。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Ello' mate. Were you successful? Where are the lil' bleeders?
scripts.translation:
[波利]
嘿，伙计。成功了吗？那些小家伙在哪？

scripts.text: Show eggs
scripts.translation: 展示蛋

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Steady on now guv'na...
What did you do to Unskilled Poring!?!? Novice!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
冷静点，伙计...
你对笨拙的波利做了什么！？初心者！！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I used the unripe apples that you gave me, then they turned into eggs.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我用了你给我的青苹果，然后它们变成了蛋。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Oh, guess I didn't expect they'd be turned into pets so easily!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
哦，没想到它们这么容易就能变成宠物！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yeah, don't worry, I'll make sure to
give them a good home.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，别担心，我会好好照顾它们的。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
^3131FFDouble click the unripe apple^000000 that I gave you and ^3131FFselect^000000 your preferred ^3131FFLittle Poring^000000.

scripts.output:
[波利]
你只需要^3131FF点击^000000老虎机的中间即可。
scripts.text:
[Poring]
The all you have to do is ^3131FFclick ^0000 the middle of the slot machine.

[Poring]
It may fail, but keep trying to lure way those Little Porings!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
可能会失败，但请继续尝试引诱那些宝贝波利！

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Have you ever heard about the changes of a novice from adept adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[波利]
你听说过初心者变成老练的冒险者的变化吗？

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Unripe Apples are the item to tame.
It will only work on the Little Porings hopping around.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
青苹果是用来驯服的道具。
它只对四处跳动的宝贝波利有效。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
If you're going to make them a cute pet...
You must take care of your Little Poring!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
如果你想把它们变成可爱的宠物...
你必须好好照顾你的宝贝波利！

scripts.text: What?
scripts.translation: 什么？

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Even before that Ghostring came here, the Little Porings were kind of cowardly.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
即使在那只幽灵波利来这里之前，宝贝波利也有点胆小。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Since they've never been out in the real world, sort of like human novices.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
因为它们从未去过外面的世界，有点像人类的新手。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
You're just starting out on your adventure, right? You will visit many towns and meet many people and encounter the frightful Boss Monsters.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
你刚开始你的冒险，对吧？你会访问许多城镇，遇见许多人，并遭遇可怕的Boss魔物。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Won't you consider taking one of these chavs with you?
scripts.translation:
[波利]
你要不要考虑带一只这样的家伙一起走呢？

scripts.text:
[Poring]
They're smeggin' talkative, but they'll be loyal friends!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
它们虽然有点话多，但会是忠诚的朋友！

scripts.text:
[Poring]
I'd say that the ^31311FAdept adventurer ^000000knows lots of things about pets, so you can ask him about your new Little Poring Friend.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
我觉得^31311F老练的冒险者^000000对宠物很了解，你可以向他询问关于你新的宝贝波利朋友的事情。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
By the way, you should have a ^3131FFportable egg incubator ^000000.
It was dropped by a careless ^3131FFPet Groomer^000000 traveling through.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
顺便说一下，你应该有一个^3131FF便携式孵化器^000000。
那是被一位粗心的^3131FF宠物美容师^000000在路上掉落的。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
I will also give you the Little Poring's favorite ^3131FFapple juice^000000, so make sure that it stays fed all the time!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
我还会给你宝贝波利最喜欢的^3131FF苹果汁^000000，所以请确保它随时都有东西吃！

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Oi, Little Poring.
I look forward to seeing you once you've explored Midgard!
Cheers mate.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
嘿，宝贝波利。
期待你在探索完米德加尔特后回来见我！
祝你好运，伙计。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Take good care of your Little Poring. Ask the adept adventurer if you have any questions about cute pets!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
好好照顾你的宝贝波利。如果你有关于可爱宠物的问题，请去问老练的冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Ghostring]
I am da biggest and da meanest Ghostring!
scripts.translation:
[幽灵波利]
我是最大、最凶的幽灵波利！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Welcome, Kafra service is always close to your heart
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
欢迎光临，卡普拉服务永远在您身边

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
For those who are using the Kafra service for the first time.
Kafra service offers thorough information rundown~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
对于第一次使用卡普拉服务的玩家。
卡普拉服务提供详尽的信息介绍~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Tell us what you would like to know
about the Kafra service~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
请告诉我们您想了解
关于卡普拉服务的哪些内容~！

scripts.text: Saving
scripts.translation: 存档

scripts.text: Storage Service
scripts.translation: 仓库服务

scripts.text: Teleport Service
scripts.translation: 瞬间移动服务

scripts.text: Use of Pushcart Service
scripts.translation: 手推车使用

scripts.text: Check Other Information
scripts.translation: 查看其他资讯

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Save service is for when you ^8B4513die in battle^000000 or use an item like ^8B4513Butterfly Wings^000000, you will be sent back to your Save Location.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
存档服务用于您在战斗中^8B4513死亡^000000或使用^8B4513蝴蝶翅膀^000000等物品时，您将被送回您的存档点。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Easy to understand~?
You want to try the Save service~?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
容易理解吧~？
您想试试存档服务~吗？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Don't be afraid of it~!
Save service doesn't swallow you.
If you change your mind, you would better try it definitely~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
别害怕~！
存档服务不会吞掉您。
如果您改变主意，最好还是试试看~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Well~ then, for now, ^8B4513Izlude Square^000000 where the Criatura Academy is located will be saved as your save point~!.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
那么~现在，位于克里阿图拉学院的^8B4513依斯鲁得广场^000000将被保存为您的存档点~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Voila~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
瞧~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
It's already done. Easy huh?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
已经完成了。很简单吧？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Now, when you use a ^006400Butterfly Wing^000000, it will send you to the last saved location.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
现在，当您使用^006400蝴蝶翅膀^000000时，它会传送到您上次保存的位置。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Storage service is a place where you can safely store your items.
Your items can be accessed by all characters in your account.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
仓库服务是一个可以安全存放物品的地方。
您账号下的所有角色都可以访问您的物品。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
To use the storage, you need to be over Novice Job Level 6 and higher.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
要使用仓库，您的职业等级需要达到初心者6级或更高。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
For a small fee, most Kafra Employees will let you open your storage.
You can even buy Kafra Cards from the Item Mall to open storage from anywhere!
Do you want to use the storage?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
只需支付少量费用，大多数卡普拉 职员都会为您打开仓库。
您甚至可以从道具商城购买随身仓库使用券，在任何地方打开仓库！
您想使用仓库吗？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Storage is necessary for you to survive so use it regularly.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
仓库对于您的生存至关重要，所以请经常使用它。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
To use the storage, you need to be raised the beginner level 6 and higher.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
要使用仓库，您需要将初心者等级提升到6级或更高。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
I'll open the storage~.
Thanks for using~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
我要打开仓库了~。
感谢您使用~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Dear customer, you don't have enough money~!
You need 500 zeny to use the storage~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
亲爱的顾客，您的Zeny不足~！
使用仓库需要500 Zeny~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Teleport service is a service that sends you to various locations throughout Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
瞬间移动服务是一项可以将您传送到米德加尔特各地不同地点的服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Different Kafra Employees have different teleport locations to send you to so you need to talk to them to find out where they're teleporting to.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
不同的卡普拉 职员拥有不同的瞬间移动目的地，所以您需要与他们交谈以了解他们能传送到哪里。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Ok, so for educational purposes I'm offering a free teleport service here at the Academy.
Why don't you try it out?~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
好的，为了教学目的，我在学院这里提供免费的瞬间移动服务。
何不试试看呢？~！

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
You afraid of having your cells spliced or something? Don't worry this is perfectly safe~!
This is an essential service~
So, you better get used to it ok?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
您害怕细胞被拼接或什么的吗？别担心，这绝对安全~！
这是一项基本服务~
所以，您最好习惯一下，好吗？

scripts.text: Academy 1st floor Great Hall
scripts.translation: 学院1楼大厅

scripts.text: Academy 2nd floor Principal's Office
scripts.translation: 学院2楼院长办公室

scripts.text: Izlude southern entrance
scripts.translation: 依斯鲁得岛南入口

scripts.text: Use later
scripts.translation: 稍后使用

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
This will take you to the outside of the Criatura Academy, is that ok?
If you want to come back to the academy, find the entrance to the north of Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
这将把您传送到克里阿图拉学院外面，可以吗？
如果您想回到学院，请找到依斯鲁得岛北边的入口。

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
You afraid of having your cells spliced or something? Don't worry this is perfectly safe~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
您害怕细胞被拼接或什么的吗？别担心，这绝对安全~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
You afraid of having your cells spliced or something? Don't worry this is perfectly safe~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
您害怕细胞被拼接或什么的吗？别担心，这绝对安全~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Pushcart service is used for those who have the job ^8B4513Merchant^000000.
To rent a Pushcart Merchants pay a small zeny fee and that's it.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
手推车使用服务是供职业为^8B4513商人^000000的人使用的。
商人只需支付少量的Zeny费用即可租用手推车。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
If you aren't a Merchant class or if you haven't learned the Cart Skill then you can't use this Kafra service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
如果您不是商人职业，或者没有学习手推车技能，就无法使用这项卡普拉服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Among the other services we provide, there is a Customer point service system from Kafra!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
在我们提供的其他服务中，卡普拉还有一套顾客积分系统！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Every time you use a Kafra Service you get Special Reserve Points~
You can use these points at the Kafra Headquarters in Aldebaran to trade for certain items.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
每次使用卡普拉服务，您都会获得特别储备积分~
您可以在艾尔帕兰的卡普拉总部使用这些积分兑换特定物品。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Here, I'll show you how many Special Reserve Points you currently have.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
来，我给您看看您目前有多少特别储备积分。

scripts.text: Check Special Reserve Points.
scripts.translation: 查看特别储备积分

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Even later~~!!
Please check your accumulated customer points~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
稍后~~！！
请查看您累积的顾客积分~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
{0}, your accummulated points are {1} points.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
{0}，您累积的积分是{1}分。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
You can exchange your
Special Reserve Points for
rewards at the Kafra Main Office in Al De Baran. Please use our
convenient services to see the benefits of our rewards program.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
您可以在艾尔帕兰的卡普拉总部用特别储备积分兑换奖励。请利用我们便捷的服务，享受我们的奖励计划带来的福利吧。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Our Kafra service is doing our best to give you the best satisfaction that you deserve as a customer.
Thanks for using us.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
我们的卡普拉服务正竭尽全力，为您提供配得上您身份的极致满意度。
感谢您使用我们的服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
First, you need to complete your^8B4513 registration^000000 at the Academy's front desk.
If you go to the first floor,
there'll be someone
to take your registration.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
首先，您需要在前台完成^8B4513注册^000000。
如果您去一楼，
会有人为您办理注册。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
You are the just a beginner.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
您只是个初学者。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Everything looks new and unfamiliar, doesn't it? Isn't it all exiciting?
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
一切都显得新鲜而陌生，不是吗？是不是令人兴奋？

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
What can be a more exciting start than a marriage in your life?
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
还有什么比婚姻更令人兴奋的开端呢？

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Are you in love?
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
您坠入爱河了吗？

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
I am the Wedding Secretary sent here for those people wanting to join their lives to another.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
我是婚礼秘书，被派来为那些想要与他人结合的人服务。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Please ask anything you are concerned with about marriage!
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
请尽管询问您关于婚姻的任何疑虑！

scripts.text: How to get married.
scripts.translation: 如何结婚

scripts.text: Benefits of marriage
scripts.translation: 婚姻的好处

scripts.text: Adoption
scripts.translation: 收养

scripts.text: Shut up!
scripts.translation: 闭嘴！

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Concluding the ceremony between two lovers is really the most beautiful and special event in one's life.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
为两位恋人主持婚礼，真是一生中最美丽、最特别的事情。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
However, being together requires several procedures.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
不过，想要结为夫妻，还需要完成一些手续。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
First, the two of you wishing to get married have to be at least base level ^0000cd45^000000 or higher, meaning  you should be at the level responsible for your life and your finances.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
首先，想要结婚的双方，基础等级必须达到^0000cd45^000000级以上，这意味着你们已经具备了独立生活和理财的能力。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Next, you need to prepare some tokens of appreciation. Men need a ^0000cdTuxedo^000000 Ladies need a ^0000cdWedding Dress^000000 and both need to have ^0000cdDiamond Ring^000000s as the symbol of everlasting love.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
其次，你们需要准备一些信物。男士需要^0000cd燕尾服^000000，女士需要^0000cd结婚礼服^000000，双方都需要拥有^0000cd钻石戒指^000000，作为永恒爱情的象征。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
You will also need to provide a fee of ^0000cd1 million Zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
此外，你们还需要支付^0000cd100万Zeny^000000的手续费。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Having prepared all of these things, you must create a party with just the two of you and go to the ^0000cdProntera Cathedral^000000.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
准备好所有物品后，你们需要创建一个只有你们两人的队伍，前往^0000cd普隆德拉大教堂^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
There, another  ^0000cdWedding Secretary^000000 like me is wating for you. When you speak to her, she will give more details of what to do.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
在那里，会有另一位像我一样的^0000cd婚礼秘书^000000在等你们。与她对话，她会告诉你们更详细的流程。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
I hope that you will meet a great fiance and enjoy a happy marriage!
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
希望你们能找到一位优秀的伴侣，享受幸福的婚姻生活！

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
To say the least, the benefit of marriage is being together forever!
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
简单来说，婚姻最大的好处就是能永远在一起！

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
After the wedding ceremony, you can enjoy a sweet honeymoon at the ^0000cdJawaii^000000 resort only for you.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
婚礼结束后，你们可以在^0000cd爪哇^000000度假村享受只属于你们的甜蜜蜜月。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
And, upon marriage you will both get a ^0000cdspecial skill^000000.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
而且，结婚后你们双方都会获得一项^0000cd特殊技能^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Two of these skills are called ^0000cdLoving Touch^000000 and ^0000cdUndying Love^000000 which are used to sacrifice HP or SP and send it to your partner.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
其中两项技能叫做^0000cd只呵护妳^000000和^0000cd只为你牺牲^000000，它们可以牺牲HP或SP并将其转移给伴侣。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
But among them, the skill called ^0000cdRomantic Rendezvous^000000 is the most romantic one, enabling you to summon your partner to you from anywhere in the world.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
不过，其中名为^0000cd浪漫约会^000000的技能最为浪漫，它能让你们从世界的任何地方召唤伴侣到身边。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Aren't these skill great? Don't you want to get married right now?
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
这些技能是不是很厉害？你们难道不想现在就结婚吗？

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Being together is wonderful but people without experience of it in the past couldn't understand the full Euphoria of being a parent.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
虽然在一起很美好，但没有经历过的人，无法完全体会成为父母的那种喜悦。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Married couple can adopt other characters as their children.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
已婚的夫妻可以收养其他角色作为他们的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
^0000cdKids of extended jobs such as Taekwon boy/girl, Gunslinger or Ninja can't be adopted^000000.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
^0000cd像跆拳男孩/女孩、神枪手或忍者这类转职后的角色无法被收养^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
And any prospecting parents need to be at least base level  ^0000cd70^000000, meaning you should be at the level responsible enough to be parents.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
而且，想要收养孩子的准父母，基础等级必须达到^0000cd70^000000级，这意味着你们已经具备了成为父母的足够能力。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Having made a family, ^0000cdaSkill to be used among the family^000000 will be earned.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
组建家庭后，你们将获得一项^0000cd家庭专用技能^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
There is another skill enables you to concrete your bond such as being able to summon your child when you miss them or not losing your earned level if you die during battle.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
还有一项技能能加深你们的羁绊，比如想念孩子时可以召唤他们，或者在战斗中死亡时不会损失已获得的等级。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Cute charms coming from your kid is a bonus~
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
孩子发出的可爱魅力可是额外的惊喜哦~

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Your mother didn't teach you right?
Mercy on you. You are ignorant of the beauty of love!!!
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
你妈妈没教好你吗？
真是可怜。你竟然不懂爱情的美妙！！！

scripts.text:
[Mom]
Honey~~~
scripts.translation:
[妈妈]
亲爱的~~~

scripts.text:
[Dad]
Yep~~
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
嗯~~

scripts.text:
[Mom]
Did you see Etinifni playing at the backyard?
scripts.translation:
[妈妈]
你看到埃蒂尼夫尼在后院玩耍了吗？

scripts.text:
[Dad]
Nope~~
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
没有~~

scripts.text:
[Mom]
He's out again? Never stays in the house!! Shall I use it?
scripts.translation:
[妈妈]
他又跑出去了？从来都不待在家里！！我要用那个吗？

scripts.text:
[Dad]
Leave him alone~ He may be playing somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
随他去吧~ 他可能正在哪里玩呢。

scripts.text:
[Mom]
You spoil him too much!
scripts.translation:
[妈妈]
你太宠他了！

scripts.text:
[Mom]
^0000cd[Come to me, honey~]^000000

[Etinifni]
What's up? Where am I?
scripts.translation:
[埃蒂尼夫尼]
怎么了？我在哪？

scripts.text:
[Mom]
Here!
scripts.translation:
[妈妈]
这里！

scripts.text:
[Etinifni]
Ah... Again!! I have been out hunting Orcs.
scripts.translation:
[埃蒂尼夫尼]
啊...又是这样！！我刚才在外面打哥布林。

scripts.text:
[Mom]
I told you stop hunting! Go and buy us milk!
scripts.translation:
[妈妈]
我说过让你别打怪了！快去给我们买牛奶！

scripts.text:
[Etinifni]
Why am I just your errand boy? Go, get me a brother!
scripts.translation:
[埃蒂尼夫尼]
为什么我只是你的跑腿男孩？去，给我找个哥哥！

scripts.text:
[Mom]
What? This moron?!
scripts.translation:
[妈妈]
什么？这个笨蛋？！

scripts.text:
[Etinifni]
OK. I will do it.
scripts.translation:
[埃蒂尼夫尼]
好吧。我会去做的。

scripts.text:
[Dad]
I am sorry... Dad has no power over your mom.
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
对不起...爸爸管不了你妈妈。

scripts.text:
[Dad]
Got this boy ten years ago after years of childlessness.
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
我们在多年没有孩子后，十年前收养了这个男孩。

scripts.text:
[Dad]
He is the apple of my eyes to me, but my wife is too strict on him.
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
他是我眼中的掌上明珠，但我妻子对他太严厉了。

scripts.text:
[Dad]
So, I am always worrying if the only son might be spoiled.
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
所以，我总是担心这个独生子会被宠坏。

scripts.text:
[Dad]
Maybe all parents worry?
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
也许所有父母都会这样担心吧？

scripts.text:
[Etinifni]
Once you have time, come to Orc Dungeon!
scripts.translation:
[埃蒂尼夫尼]
等你有空了，来兽人地下城吧！

scripts.text:
[Romantic Male]
Let's go~~ together hand in hand~~ Put everything aside ~~ in the dark blue night of Jawaii~~ under the stars~~
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的男子]
让我们手牵手一起走吧~~ 抛开一切 ~~ 在爪哇深蓝色的夜空下~~ 在星光中~~

scripts.text:
[Romantic Male]
We are leaving for Jawaii-the place of our honeymoon to celebrate our 10th wedding anniversary!
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的男子]
我们要去爪哇——我们度蜜月的地方，庆祝结婚十周年纪念日！

scripts.text:
[Romantic Male]
Are you lifting up our good old memories renting my wedding dress and your tuxedo!! It will strenghthen our relationship, won't it?
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的男子]
你穿上我的结婚礼服，我穿上你的燕尾服，这样能唤起我们美好的回忆吧！！这一定会让我们的感情更深厚，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Romantic Male]
Honey~~ I love you!! Sweetheart~
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的男子]
亲爱的~~ 我爱你！！宝贝~

scripts.text:
[Romantic Male]
No!! I love you more than you do!!
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的男子]
不！！我比你还爱你！！

scripts.text:
[Romantic Female]
Shout like this when I miss you, honey!!
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的女子]
想我的时候，就大声喊出来，亲爱的！！

scripts.text:
[Romantic Female]
^0000cd[I miss you.]^000000

[Romantic Female]
Then, you run towards me leaving everything behind,~ don't you?
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的女子]
然后，你会抛下一切向我跑来，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Romantic Female]
I will definitely do as you call me!!
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的女子]
我一定会听从你的呼唤！！

scripts.text:
[Romantic Female]
You are tired of sitting, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的女子]
你坐累了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Romantic Female]
My sweetheart!!! I love you!!!
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的女子]
我的宝贝！！！我爱你！！！

scripts.text:
[Romantic Male]
Yes, thank you for sharing your SP! You are also tired, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的男子]
是的，谢谢你分享你的SP！你也累了吧？

scripts.text:
[Romantic Male]
My sweetheart!! I love you!!!
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的男子]
我的宝贝！！我爱你！！！

scripts.text:
[Romantic Female]
Kia~ You are Coolest!!!
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的女子]
起亚~ 你最酷了！！！

scripts.text:
[Manufacturing Maniac]
Hi~! I am an Alchemist.
It's one of the second jobs after Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[制造狂人]
嗨~！我是炼金术士。
这是继商人之后的第二职业。

scripts.text:
[Manufacturing Maniac]
I am making a potion.
I came to izlude to make potions at a quiet place.
I feel that quiet places help to increase the rate of success.
I am feeling good!
scripts.translation:
[制造狂人]
我正在制作药水。
我来依斯鲁得岛是为了在安静的地方制作药水。
我觉得安静的地方有助于提高成功率。
我现在感觉很好！

scripts.text:
[Working Blacksmith]
The guy sitting over there has been staring at Wagzak. I was told that only one knife is left after losing all weapons?
scripts.translation:
[干活的铁匠]
坐在那边的那个家伙一直在盯着瓦格扎克。听说他失去所有武器后，只剩下一把刀了？

scripts.text:
[Working Blacksmith]
He can use safe refining... I don't understand why he takes such risks.
scripts.translation:
[干活的铁匠]
他明明可以使用安全精炼...我不明白他为什么要冒这种险。

scripts.text:
[Refining Maniac]
Shh...! Be quiet.
I am focusing on ^3131FFrefining^000000.
scripts.translation:
[精炼狂人]
嘘...！安静点。
我正在专心^3131FF精炼^000000。

scripts.text: What is refining?
scripts.translation: 什么是精炼？

scripts.text: Good luck.
scripts.translation: 祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Refining Maniac]
Come on.. Co..me on...!!
scripts.translation:
[精炼狂人]
拜托了...成...成功...！！

scripts.text:
[Refining Maniac]
Some equipment except some specific ones can be enhanced by ^3131FFrefining^000000.
scripts.translation:
[精炼狂人]
除了某些特定装备外，其他装备都可以通过^3131FF精炼^000000来强化。

scripts.text:
[Refining Maniac]
Weapons get increased ^3131FFAttack Power^000000, so the more you refine them the stronger they become.
scripts.translation:
[精炼狂人]
武器精炼后^3131FF攻击力^000000会提升，精炼等级越高，武器就越强。

scripts.text:
[Refining Maniac]
Each weapon level has a different refining safe point. So it's important to pay attention when refining.
If you break it you lose it.
scripts.translation:
[精炼狂人]
每个武器等级都有不同的安全精炼点。所以精炼时务必小心。
如果失败了，装备就会损坏。

scripts.text:
[Refining Maniac]
I'm trying to get to +10 right now... All my training is for this!
scripts.translation:
[精炼狂人]
我现在正试着精炼到+10...我所有的训练都是为了这一刻！

scripts.text:
[Refining Maniac]
Please ask to the owner of refining, I have a important mission +10!
scripts.translation:
[精炼狂人]
请向精炼的主人祈祷吧，我有一个重要的任务：+10！

scripts.text:
[Otter Samssoon]
Welcome~
I am Samssoon~! I am a royal hair designer otter sent to academy.
scripts.translation:
[水獭 萨姆孙]
欢迎光临~
我是萨姆孙~！我是被派到学院来的皇家发型设计师水獭。

scripts.text:
[Otter Samssoon]
If you take ^ff0000Criatura Hair Coupon^000000, they change your hairstyle for free! So do not miss this ^ff0000once in a lifetime^000000 chance~
scripts.translation:
[水獭 萨姆孙]
如果您持有^ff0000克里图拉美发券^000000，就可以免费更换发型！千万不要错过这个^ff0000千载难逢^000000的机会哦~

scripts.text: Read style book.
scripts.translation: 阅读发型书

scripts.text: Change hair style.
scripts.translation: 更换发型

scripts.text: How to get a coupon
scripts.translation: 如何获得美发券

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Otter Samssoon]
Oh my~ I am sure any hair style will suit you! You really have a good style~
There are many styles so pick ^ff0000from page 1 to 19^000000.
If you want to stop, say 0.
scripts.translation:
[水獭 萨姆孙]
哎呀~我确信任何发型都适合您！您的品味真好~
这里有多种发型，请从^ff0000第1页到第19页^000000中选择。
如果您想停止，请输入0。

scripts.text:
