[身无分文的学员]
吃，消化，再吃，再消化，嘿嘿。
你要不要一起？

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
Hey, do you know about the gunslinger's own weapon?
scripts.translation:
[吵闹的学员]
嘿，你知道神枪手专用的武器吗？

scripts.text: Don't know
scripts.translation: 不知道

scripts.text: Know
scripts.translation: 知道

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
Cha, yeah right!
scripts.translation:
[吵闹的学员]
哈，我就知道！

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
I guessed you were.
scripts.translation:
[吵闹的学员]
我猜你肯定知道。

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
Gunslinger handles 5 kinds of guns and each gun has its own character.
scripts.translation:
[吵闹的学员]
神枪手使用5种不同的枪械，每种枪都有各自的特点。

scripts.text: What character?
scripts.translation: 什么特点？

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
Hahahaha~ I am also taking the lesson, but I don't know the details as I haven't become a gunslinger.
scripts.translation:
[吵闹的学员]
哈哈哈~ 我也在上课，但因为我还没成为神枪手，所以也不清楚细节。

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
I heard that as it was a dangerous weapon they don't let us use them yet!
scripts.translation:
[吵闹的学员]
我听说因为那是危险的武器，所以还不让我们使用！

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
Oh Mr. gunslinger!! Nice.
scripts.translation:
[吵闹的学员]
哦，神枪手先生！真厉害。

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
What? Why did you take the other job rather than being a nice gunslinger?
scripts.translation:
[吵闹的学员]
什么？为什么你选择了其他职业，而不是成为帅气的枪手呢？

scripts.text: [Quiet Trainee]
scripts.translation: [安静的学员]

scripts.text:
[Quiet Trainee]
Are you coming to take the lesson for gunslinger?
scripts.translation:
[安静的学员]
你是来上神枪手课程的吗？

scripts.text:
[Quiet Trainee]
Ms. Lusa really looks pretty.
scripts.translation:
[安静的学员]
露莎老师看起来真的很漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Quiet Trainee]
I wish to be a gunslinger, like her.
scripts.translation:
[安静的学员]
我想像她一样成为神枪手。

scripts.text:
[Quiet Trainee]
I hope I finish my lessons soon!
scripts.translation:
[安静的学员]
希望我能快点完成课程！

scripts.text:
[Quiet Trainee]
Learning is too difficult...
scripts.translation:
[安静的学员]
学习好难啊...

scripts.text:
[Quiet Trainee]
You are a gunslinger? You look great! I want to become a gunslinger......
scripts.translation:
[安静的学员]
你是神枪手吗？看起来好厉害！我也想成为神枪手......

scripts.text:
[Quiet Trainee]
Desperado is the bullet... Blable... Ranged attack... Physics....
scripts.translation:
[安静的学员]
亡命之徒是子弹...巴拉巴拉...远程攻击...物理...

scripts.text: You can't hear her clearly because of her small voice.
scripts.translation: 因为她声音太小，你听不太清楚。

scripts.text:
[Frightened Trainee]
That man looks too scary.
scripts.translation:
[受惊的学员]
那个男子看起来好可怕。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
A sudden poetic inspiration hit me!
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
我突然有了诗意的灵感！

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
^3377FFIn the night of the Byalan Island under the moonlight, sitting alone in Izlude^000000
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
^3377FF在拜兰岛的月光之夜，独自坐在依斯鲁得岛^000000

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
^3377FFWearing Tzurugie on my belly, in the deep anxiety,^000000
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
^3377FF腹中怀着Tzurugie，在深深的焦虑中，^000000

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
^3377FFHearing I made a fortune from somewhere, killing me softly.^000000
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
^3377FF听说我从某处发了大财，温柔地杀死了我的灵魂。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
How about it? It is excellent, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
怎么样？很出色，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
I will ^FF0000transcend ^000000and ^FF00003rd job change^000000. Become a nice Minstrel, I can play with a famous Wanderer like Mr. Igoo.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
我要^FF0000转生^000000并进行^FF0000三转^000000。成为一名优秀的宫廷乐师，就能和像伊古先生那样的著名浪姬舞者一起玩耍了。

scripts.text: What is transcending?
scripts.translation: 什么是转生？

scripts.text: What is the 3rd job change?
scripts.translation: 什么是三转？

scripts.text: Who is Igoo?
scripts.translation: 伊古是谁？

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
You seem to already know what it is!
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
看来你已经知道这是什么了！

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Transcending is great. Very great.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
转生很伟大。非常伟大。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Basically the 2nd job adventurer gains the base level 99 and job level 50, on then can that person transcend.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
基本上，二转冒险者达到基础等级99和职业等级50后，就可以转生了。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Once you transcend, you can go back to the base level Novice.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
一旦转生，你就可以回到基础等级的初心者状态。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
It is very hard to start your adventure again. However, there is a merit to the hardship.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
重新开始冒险非常艰难。但是，艰难中也有好处。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
The most important merit is to learn new skills at a new upgraded level. In my case, I could transfer to not an ordinary Bard but a Minstrel.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
最重要的好处是在新的升级等级中学习新技能。对我来说，我可以转职成为不普通的诗人，而是宫廷乐师。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Indeed, be careful as you can only follow the way of the job you chose before transcending.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
确实，要小心，因为转生后你只能沿着之前选择的职业道路前进。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
If you are interested in transcending, recommend you visit the Sage castle in ^FF0000Juno^000000. I may be far behind for it.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
如果你对转生感兴趣，推荐你去^FF0000朱诺^000000的贤者城堡。我可能离那里还很远。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Oh, you know very well, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
哦，你很清楚，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
The 3rd job change is obviously a new job.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
三转显然是新的职业。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Adventurers with the 2nd job or can be transferred to the 3rd job class once gaining the base level 99 and the job level more than 50.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
二转的冒险者，在基础等级达到99且职业等级超过50后，就可以转职为三转职业。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
For example, a Bard like me was an Archer in the beginning. Now I became a Bard. As I am diligently adventuring, I may be able to change jobs to a third job.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
比如像我这样的诗人，一开始是弓箭手。现在成为了诗人。只要我努力冒险，也许就能转职为三转职业。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Ah, of course, though I don't make transfer, I could be Minstrel as my final target. However, I won't compromise with the reality. Someday I will be the best Minstrel.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
啊，当然，虽然我现在还不能转职，但我的最终目标是成为宫廷乐师。不过，我不会向现实妥协。总有一天，我会成为最棒的宫廷乐师。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
So, if you transfer, you could first be Novice and be a Bard. But someday I could be Minstrel, couldn't I?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
所以，如果你转职，可以先成为初心者，然后成为诗人。但总有一天，我也能成为宫廷乐师，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Choice is always on you. Be ambitious, adventurer. Someday I will sing an encouraging song for you.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
选择权始终在你手中。要有野心，冒险者。总有一天，我会为你唱一首鼓舞人心的歌。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
No! You don't know the most beautiful girl Wanderer Igoo in this era?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
不！你不知道这个时代最美的浪姬舞者伊古吗？

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Haven't you heard about [Volume 1 - Lost Poring] or [Volume 2 : Poring my love]?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
你没听说过《第一卷 - 迷失的波利》或《第二卷：波利，我的爱》吗？

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Then, have you never heard the songs like [It's a Good day for an OCA] or [Baphomet I hardly knew you]
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
那么，你也没听过像《今天是OCA的好日子》或《巴风特，我几乎不认识你》这样的歌吗？

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
A beautiful Wanderer from Comodo at the age of 20. Not only Midgard but also wherever her wandering troupe goes, a fan club follows.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
来自克魔岛的美丽浪姬舞者，年仅20岁。不仅在米德加尔特，无论她的巡演队伍走到哪里，都有粉丝团追随。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
I am ^FF0000Ragie^000000 in charge with the Rune-Midgarts branch head of Igoo's informal fan club! As Igoo has gone to the 2nd world, I am taking a rest for a while. But she will be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
我是^FF0000拉吉埃^000000，负责卢恩·米德加兹分部，是伊古非正式粉丝团的一员！因为伊古去了第二世界，我暂时休息了一段时间。但她很快就会回来。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
As I am still a low level of adventurer, I haven't followed her to the 2nd world... See! I will make great efforts and follow her everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
因为我还是低等级的冒险者，所以没能跟随她去第二世界...看吧！我会努力，追随她的脚步。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Ahaa. No sweat no sweat. It is useless to tell such a story to those ignorant.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
啊哈。没关系没关系。对无知的人讲这些故事也没用。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Ah! I happened to come up with another great poetic inspiration.. Take a memo.. Memo..
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
啊！我突然想到了另一个伟大的诗意灵感...记个备忘...备忘...

scripts.text:
[Lady]
There is a town called Payon to the east. Taking a long way to the south, you can even reach Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
东边有一个叫斐扬的城镇。往南走很远的路，甚至能到达艾尔贝塔。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Payon is the wonderful city. There you can be transferred to an Archer or to a Taekwon. And a nice Dungeon there. If you have time, please make a visit.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
斐扬是一座美妙的城市。在那里你可以转职为弓箭手或跆拳。那里还有一个不错的地下城。如果有时间，请去参观一下。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
You are a novice? right?
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
你是初心者，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
Class aptitude test is nonsense for those who already have a job.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
对于已经有职业的人来说，职业倾向测试毫无意义。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
You haven't decided your job yet?
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
你还没决定职业吗？

scripts.text: No... how did you know?
scripts.translation: 不...你怎么知道的？

scripts.text: I decided.
scripts.translation: 我已经决定了。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
Have you already decided? Ok then.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
你已经决定了？好吧。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
I wanted you to take the Class aptitude test for fun...
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
我本来是想让你做职业倾向测试来玩玩...

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
Oh, that is good.
What is the ^0000FFClass aptitude test^000000.
I have one book left. Do you want to try? I won't say it will be help for sure but it will be fun.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
哦，那很好。
什么是^0000FF职业倾向测试^000000呢？
我还剩一本书。你想试试吗？我不敢保证它一定会有帮助，但肯定很有趣。

scripts.text: Class aptitude test?
scripts.translation: 职业倾向测试？

scripts.text: Take the Class aptitude test.
scripts.translation: 参加职业倾向测试

scripts.text: stop.
scripts.translation: 停下

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
The Class aptitude test is a test for recommending jobs by reviewing your personality and capability with the answers.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
职业倾向测试是通过回顾你的回答，来评估你的个性和能力，从而推荐适合的职业。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
It has 3 types of test and each one give 30 minutes to finish.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
它包含3种类型的测试，每种测试给你30分钟的时间完成。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
If you have free time and have not decided your job... how about taking this test?
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
如果你有空闲时间，并且还没有决定职业...不如试试这个测试？

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
All right. Good bye.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
好的。再见。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
Shall we start?
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
我们要开始吗？

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
The first type of question is about taking an action for a given situation.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
第一种题型是关于在特定情境下采取的行动。

scripts.text: In the middle of the dark, you're walking on the street of Prontera when suddenly you hear someone scream.
scripts.translation: 在漆黑的夜晚，你走在普隆德拉的街道上，突然听到有人尖叫。

scripts.text: 'Aaaahh!! Don't hurt me ~'
scripts.translation: “啊啊啊！！别伤害我~”

scripts.text: You run to the place and see someone surrounded by punks. Because of your sudden appearace, the punks are surprised.
scripts.translation: 你跑到那里，看到一个人被一群朽魔包围。因为你的突然出现，朽魔们感到惊讶。

scripts.text: What would be your reaction to this situation?
scripts.translation: 面对这种情况，你会做出什么反应？

scripts.text: Fight against the punks
scripts.translation: 与朽魔战斗

scripts.text: Cast Magic.
scripts.translation: 施放魔法

scripts.text: Call for Guards.
scripts.translation: 呼叫卫兵

scripts.text: Throw rocks at them.
scripts.translation: 扔石头砸它们

scripts.text:
After clear up the mess, you approach the person who was being attacked.
Do you think the person who was surrounded by punks is a man or a woman?
scripts.translation:
解决完麻烦后，你走向那个被袭击的人。
你觉得被朽魔包围的人是男子还是女子？

scripts.text: Man
scripts.translation: 男子

scripts.text: Woman
scripts.translation: 女子

scripts.text: The situation of encountering the gangs were like this
scripts.translation: 遭遇帮派的情况是这样的

scripts.text: You find out that {0} is the {1} of very rich family in Alberta and Punks attacked while {2} was on an errand for the family
scripts.translation: 你发现{0}是艾尔贝塔一个非常富裕家庭的{1}，朽魔是在{2}为家里跑腿时袭击的

scripts.text: What kind of errand was he doing?
scripts.translation: 他在做什么跑腿工作？

scripts.text: Delivering an important object
scripts.translation: 运送重要物品

scripts.text: Deliver a small souvenir
scripts.translation: 送一个小纪念品

scripts.text: Deliver a message
scripts.translation: 送一封书信

scripts.text:
For your bravery, {0} becomes your friend and decides to go on a trip.
Where is {1} going?
scripts.translation:
因为你的勇敢，{0}成为了你的朋友，并决定去旅行。
{1}要去哪里？

scripts.text: Capital city, Prontera
scripts.translation: 首都城市，普隆德拉

scripts.text: Mountain city, Payon
scripts.translation: 山城，斐扬

scripts.text: Port city, Alberta
scripts.translation: 港口城市，艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Magic city, Geffen
scripts.translation: 魔法城市，吉芬

scripts.text: Satelite city, Izlude
scripts.translation: 卫星城市，依斯鲁得岛

scripts.text: Desert city, Morocc
scripts.translation: 沙漠城市，莫洛奇

scripts.text: Industrial city, Einbroch
scripts.translation: 工业城市，艾音布罗克

scripts.text: World of natural life, Amatsu
scripts.translation: 自然生命的世界，樱花城

scripts.text: Garden city, Hugel
scripts.translation: 花园城市，毁葛

scripts.text: You're having a great time. Do you feel like something will be happening or not?
scripts.translation: 你玩得很开心。你觉得接下来会发生什么吗？

scripts.text: Happening
scripts.translation: 会发生

scripts.text: Not happening.
scripts.translation: 不会发生

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
Now for the second test. Choose the best answer in your own opinion.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
接下来是第二项测试。请凭你自己的感觉选择最佳答案。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
2nd type of question is to select a word or sentence which is closest to yourself.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
第二种题型是选择最符合你自身的一个词语或句子。

scripts.text: Study
scripts.translation: 学习

scripts.text: Exercise
scripts.translation: 锻炼

scripts.text: Service
scripts.translation: 服务

scripts.text: Violence
scripts.translation: 暴力

scripts.text: Change
scripts.translation: 改变

scripts.text: Preservation
scripts.translation: 保存

scripts.text: Consumer
scripts.translation: 消费者

scripts.text: Seller
scripts.translation: 卖家

scripts.text: Producer
scripts.translation: 生产者

scripts.text: Speedy
scripts.translation: 快速

scripts.text: Cautious
scripts.translation: 谨慎

scripts.text: Theory
scripts.translation: 理论

scripts.text: Experience
scripts.translation: <黑暗搜集者>经验值

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
2nd type of question is done. It was simple. Right ? Let's move to next.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
第二种题型结束了。很简单吧？我们继续下一项。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
Now for the third test. Please choose (Yes) or (No) to each question.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
接下来是第三项测试。请对每个问题选择（是）或（否）。

scripts.text: Do you always pick up money that you find on the ground?
scripts.translation: 你总是会把地上捡到的钱捡起来吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: If you had the same name as someone of the opposite sex, would that make you less attracted to them?
scripts.translation: 如果你和异性同名，这会降低你对他们的吸引力吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Do you like to be able to carry a lot of items at once?
scripts.translation: 你喜欢能一次性携带很多物品吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Do you like to read books?
scripts.translation: 你喜欢读书吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: You read everything in a magazine?
scripts.translation: 你会把杂志里的内容都读完吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Do you take the time to worry about what you are wearing?
scripts.translation: 你会花时间在意自己穿什么衣服吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Do you tell others what kind of fancy foods you've eaten recently?
scripts.translation: 你会告诉别人你最近吃了什么美食吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Do you write things down in a notebook often?
scripts.translation: 你经常把东西记在笔记本上吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Do you consider yourself attractive?
scripts.translation: 你觉得自己有魅力吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Do you like to be in areas where a lot of people gather?
scripts.translation: 你喜欢待在人群聚集的地方吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Do you like the idea of living a single life?
scripts.translation: 你喜欢独居的生活吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Do you like to keep your distance from others?
scripts.translation: 你喜欢与他人保持距离吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Do you think that having a good hiding space is important in battle?
scripts.translation: 你认为在战斗中拥有良好的隐匿地点很重要吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Would you defend your friend even if you knew they were wrong?
scripts.translation: 即使知道朋友做错了，你也会为他们辩护吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Would you try to convince an enemy not to fight you with logic?
scripts.translation: 你会试图用逻辑说服敌人不要与你战斗吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Can you sit still in the same place for a long time?
scripts.translation: 你能在同一个地方长时间保持静止吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Do you think that you can take a punch straight to the gut from an Orc?
scripts.translation: 你认为自己能承受哥布林直击腹部的重击吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Do you make up nicknames for your friends?
scripts.translation: 你会给朋友起外号吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Do you always have a plan B for various situations?
scripts.translation: 面对各种情况，你总是有备选方案吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I think about something else while talking to others.
scripts.translation: 和别人说话时，你会想着别的事情。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
Class aptitude test is finished with 1,2 and 3rd test. Please wait for a moment.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
职业适应性测试的第一、二、三项已经结束。请稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
It requires to manually calculate as you know.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
你知道的，这需要手动计算。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
All right!!!! It's done!!!!!!!!

[Cream Puff]
Finished calculating. Math is always difficult.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
计算完毕。数学总是很难。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
According to the Class aptitude test!
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
根据职业适应性测试的结果！

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
The one who wants to be a hero with stong belief and wants to influence on the world.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
拥有坚定信念，想要成为英雄并影响世界的人。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
The one who is curious about knowing everything and independently work alone.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
对万事充满好奇，喜欢独立工作的人。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
The one who is romantic and understands the feeling of others and tries to be understood by others as well.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
富有浪漫情怀，能理解他人感受，也渴望被他人理解的人。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
the one who is good at reading the mind of others and is decisive.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
善于洞察人心，且行事果断的人。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
The one who wants to have fun is optimistic who loves adventure.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
乐观开朗，热爱冒险，追求快乐的人。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
The one who has a great heart to help others and understand.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
心胸宽广，乐于助人且善于理解他人的人。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
the one who has sound mind from right training.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
经过正确训练，拥有健全心智的人。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
The one who is called as a justice giver but also gives chaos and fear.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
被称为正义的化身，却也带来混沌与恐惧的人。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
The one who does not want to get attention.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
不引人注目，低调行事的人。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
An error occurred.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
发生错误。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
The one who wants to protect the weak.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
想要保护弱者的人。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
the one who has good judgement, not out-going, analyzing and insightful and likes to observe...
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
判断力良好，性格内敛，善于分析洞察，喜欢观察……

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
The one who wants to spend time finding out who they are.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
想要花时间探索自我的人。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
the one who is strongly interested in achieving and target-driving and responsible.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
对成就有强烈渴望，目标导向且富有责任感的人。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
The one who wants to find out something exciting and wants to donate to the world in his own way.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
想要发现令人兴奋的事物，并以自己的方式回馈世界的人。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
The one who wants to be loved and wants to care for others.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
渴望被爱，也想要关爱他人的人。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
The one who tries hard everyday with certain belief and tries to make people understand.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
怀着坚定信念每天努力，并试图让人理解自己的人。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
The one who tries to balance between justice and chaos.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
试图在正义与混沌之间保持平衡的人。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
and who is persistant without giving up until reaching the target.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
并且坚持不懈，直到达成目标的人。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
^8014EB{0}^000000 is a good matching job for you.

[Cream Puff]
Hmm, it says.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
嗯，上面是这么写的。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
You do not have to choose the job from Class aptitude test. That is only just for fun.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
您不必选择职业适应性测试推荐的职业，那只是娱乐而已。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
If you want, I will send it to the class that was recommended by the aptitude result.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
如果您愿意，我可以将您转职为适应性测试推荐的职业。

scripts.text: Send me now.
scripts.translation: 现在就转职。

scripts.text: It's okay, I'm still deciding.
scripts.translation: 没关系，我还在考虑。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
Ok, you know what you want I guess.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
好吧，看来你已经知道想要什么了。

scripts.text:
[Cream Puff]
Your recommended job is {0}. I will send you to where you can talk to that job professional.
scripts.translation:
[泡芙]
为您推荐的职业是{0}。我会将您送往可以咨询该职业专业人士的地方。

scripts.text: - Quest can't be continued as your overloaded items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Oh! I am sorry but in order to take the class, y'all have to register first. Ya come back here after registration at that there counter on the 1st floor, ya hear?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哎呀！抱歉，想要参加考核，你们得先登记才行。去一楼那个柜台登记完再回来，听到了吗？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Gosh Darnit! You are cuter then a piglet! Are ya trying ta learn to be a ^ff0000Gunslinger^000000?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
天哪！你比小猪还可爱！你想学^ff0000神枪手^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You're so cute! A ^ff0000Gunslinger^000000 who has true grit wield his weapons bringing justice in these wild times.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你真可爱！一位拥有真正勇气的^ff0000神枪手^000000，挥舞着武器，在这个动荡的时代伸张正义。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Ya, know you remind me of my little brother, that varmint couldn't shoot the broadside of a barn.. at least not until I taught him.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你知道吗，你让我想起我那小弟弟，那家伙连谷仓的侧板都打不中...至少在我教他之前是这样。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Ya, know you remind me of my little sister, that scamp couldn't shoot the broadside of barn.. At least not until I taught her.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你知道吗，你让我想起我那小妹妹，那家伙连谷仓的侧板都打不中...至少在我教她之前是这样。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Now y'all need to understand, guns aren't some little thing that you just swing at an animal, you don't wiggle those there fingers and shock them to death.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你们得明白，枪可不是那种对着动物乱挥的小玩意儿，也不是用手指戳一下就能把对方电死的。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
No! You shoot things, which means ya need to aim straight. This takes a lot of ^ff0000dexterity^000000 on the part of the gunslinger.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
不！你是要射击目标，这意味着你需要瞄准。这对神枪手来说需要很高的^ff0000敏捷^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Now before ya go running off shooting dem guns in the air, all high fallootin and dancing around. Ya need to understand that this isn't an easy job!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
在你们跑去对着天空乱开枪、手舞足蹈之前，得明白这不是个轻松的工作！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Bullets cost zeny so you need to be sure that everything you shoot is worth the price! We attack at range so that nasty cur with the pig sticker doesn't rustle your jimmies!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
子弹很贵，所以你得确保每一发子弹都物有所值！我们是远程攻击，这样那些带刺的讨厌鬼就不会让你受惊了！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Y'all understand?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你们明白了吗？

scripts.text: Ranged attack?
scripts.translation: 远程攻击？

scripts.text: Why is ammo expensive?
scripts.translation: 为什么弹药很贵？

scripts.text: Job Change Test?
scripts.translation: 转职测试？

scripts.text: Yes~!!
scripts.translation: 是的~！！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Those low tech barbarians need both Strength and Dexterity in order to fight properly. This isn't true for gunslingers.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
那些低科技的野蛮人需要力量和敏捷才能正常战斗。神枪手则不然。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Why our dexterity influences both attack power and accuracy! Remember, Talk slowly but think quickly!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
我们的敏捷既影响攻击力也影响命中率！记住，说话要慢，思考要快！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Do y'all see lots of factories around here? Mines? Alchemical labs? All these things take zeny to run and thats how they fund it!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你们看到周围有很多工厂吗？还有矿山？炼金实验室？
运营这些东西都需要Zeny，这就是它们的资金来源！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Some other jobs may think it is safe enough to hand any yonkle the strength to seriously hurt someone.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
有些其他职业可能觉得，随便给一个路人赋予能严重伤害他人的力量是安全的。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
But we have to see that you have grit! Remember, fast is good but accurate is better.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
但我们必须确认你有毅力！
记住，快是好的，但准更好。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Y'all can come back now if you gets any more questions.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
如果你们还有更多问题，随时可以回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
They tell me Criatura Academy is for the novices not yet decided what job to take.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
听说克里阿图拉学院是接待那些还没决定转职方向的初心者的地方。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
They hired me, gun and all, to show you how to be a gunslinger!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
他们雇了我，连枪带人，来教你们如何成为神枪手！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Would you like me to show you how?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
要我教你们吗？

scripts.text: Yes mam!
scripts.translation: 是的，女士！

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Hrmm, you didn't look like you had the grit any how.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
嗯，你看起来似乎并没有那种毅力。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Hey! What kind of con is this?! You already had a manual!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
嘿！这是什么把戏？！你已经有一本手册了！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Here take this manual, I ain't too good at that there book learnin' but I can answer your questions.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
拿着这本手册吧，我不太擅长读书写字，但我可以回答你的问题。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
If you need the battle training, visit <NAVI>[Subino]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
如果你需要战斗训练，请去拜访<NAVI>[苏比诺]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Oh, sorry! Children cannot become Gunslingers!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哦，抱歉！儿童不能成为神枪手！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Perhaps you should talk to your parents about other professions.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
也许你应该和父母谈谈其他职业。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Are you going to learn to shoot as a gunslinger?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你要学习射击，成为神枪手吗？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Wooo doggy! You aren't ready for the big city yet!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哇哦，你还没准备好进入大城市呢！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Get to ^ff0000Job Level: ^0000ff10^000000 and come back here and I will help ya!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
达到^ff0000职业等级: ^0000ff10^000000后再来这里，我会帮你的！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Y'all ready to take the test to become a gunslinger?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你们准备好参加成为神枪手的测试了吗？

scripts.text: Wait a moment.
scripts.translation: 等一下。

scripts.text: Send me.
scripts.translation: 送我过去。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
When ya are ready, come to me!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
准备好了就来找我！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Okay then, you should find a^ff0000 Mr. Master Miller^000000 and ask him about the test.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
好的，你应该去找^ff0000米勒大师^000000，问问他关于测试的事。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Remember, if you find yourself in a hole, the first thing to do is stop digging!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
记住，如果你发现自己陷入了困境，首先要做的就是停止挖掘！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Y'all need help with that book?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你们需要关于那本书的帮助吗？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Y'all need help with that book?
[Lusa]
If ya need more questions you can always come back ta me.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你们需要关于那本书的帮助吗？
[露莎]
如果你们还有更多问题，随时可以回来找我。

scripts.text: How do I use this book?
scripts.translation: 我该怎么使用这本书？

scripts.text: I can't find the skill.
scripts.translation: 我找不到那个技能。

scripts.text: I don't have a gun....
scripts.translation: 我没有枪....

scripts.text: No more questions now.
scripts.translation: 现在没有问题了。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Oh.. I think I know what the problem is,
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哦..我想我知道问题出在哪里了，

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Ta use the guide, first ya need to equip it. ^ff0000To open the equipment window the Shortcut key is Alt + E.^000000
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
要使用指南，首先你需要装备它。^ff0000打开装备窗口的快捷键是 Alt + E。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Sometimes I forget ta do that too! ^ff0000Drag the item from your inventory to the appropriate slot in the equipment window. Alternatively you can double click the item in inventory.^000000
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
有时候我自己也会忘记这样做！^ff0000将物品从物品栏拖到装备窗口的相应槽位中。或者，你可以双击物品栏中的物品。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Do ya have any other questions?
[Lusa]
If ya need more questions you can always come back ta me.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你们还有其他问题吗？
[露莎]
如果你们还有更多问题，随时可以回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Y'all need ta learn how to use the skill?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你们需要学习如何使用这个技能吗？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
^ff0000To open the skill window use the short cut Alt + S. The skill will be located in the ETC tab.^000000
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
^ff0000使用快捷键 Alt + S 打开技能窗口。该技能位于 ETC 标签页中。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
^ff0000You can then drag the skill to your hot bar for easy use!.^000000
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
^ff0000然后你可以将技能拖到你的快捷栏中，以便轻松使用！^000000

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
... and thats how I learned that When in doubt, let your peco do the thinkin'.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
... 这就是我学到的：当犹豫不决时，让你的佩科（Peco）来思考。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Do ya have any other questions?
[Lusa]
If ya need more questions you can always come back ta me.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你们还有其他问题吗？
[露莎]
如果你们还有更多问题，随时可以回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Well, I don't think that you are quite ready to get a shootin iron. So the training book only shows ya skills that don't need guns.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
嗯，我觉得你们还没准备好拿一把枪。所以训练书只展示了那些不需要枪的技能。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Do ya have any other questions?
[Lusa]
If ya need more questions you can always come back ta me.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你们还有其他问题吗？
[露莎]
如果你们还有更多问题，随时可以回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
If ya need more questions you can always come back ta me.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
如果你们还有更多问题，随时可以回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Oh! Are you just darling, a newly minted gunslinger!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哦！你真是可爱极了，一位新晋的神枪手！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Why your shootin iron looks shinier then a silver zeny! Do ya need anything?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
为什么你的枪看起来比银色的Zeny还要闪亮！你需要什么吗？

scripts.text: Can you help me get to Einbroch?
scripts.translation: 你能帮我到艾音布罗克吗？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Sure, why not? Make sure to spend some time trainin!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
当然可以，为什么不呢？记得多花点时间训练哦！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Get over there ya scamp!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
快去吧，你这小调皮鬼！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Oh, I am glad to hear that you are so strong!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哦，很高兴听到你这么厉害！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Ah, still in basic training eh? You're not carelessly using Butterfly Wings, right?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
啊，还在基础训练中吗？你并没有随意使用蝴蝶翅膀吧？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Are you going to Einbroch to complete basic training?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你是要去艾音布罗克完成基础训练吗？

scripts.text: Can you help me get to Einbroch?
scripts.translation: 你能帮我到艾音布罗克吗？

scripts.text: No, I have other things to do.
scripts.translation: 不，我有其他事要做。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Sure, why not? Make sure to spend some time trainin!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
当然可以，为什么不呢？记得多花点时间训练哦！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Get over there ya scamp!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
快去吧，你这小调皮鬼！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Oh, is that so? If you wish to go to Einbroch but not take the Airship, come speak to me.
Because you're still training, I will send you there for free.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哦，是吗？如果你想前往艾音布罗克但不乘坐飞空艇，可以来找我对话。
因为你还处于训练阶段，我会免费送你过去。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Ah you're back, and now wearing lovely Gunslinger clothing! It suits you well, congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
啊，你回来了，而且穿上了漂亮的神枪手服装！很适合你，恭喜！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
I just received the news from my brother regarding your achievement of completing basic training.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
我刚收到我哥哥的消息，说你完成了基础训练。

scripts.text: Brother?
scripts.translation: 哥哥？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Huh? My brother did not tell you? My brother is the one in charge of Basic Training.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
咦？我哥哥没告诉你吗？负责基础训练的人就是我哥哥。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Louie and Lusa are very similar names, right?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
路易和露莎的名字很相似，对吧？

scripts.text: I guess so...
scripts.translation: 我想也是...

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Ha ha~ Well, our relationship is not really that important.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哈哈~ 好吧，我们的关系其实没那么重要。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
I have been assigned to conduct Combat Training for the Gunslinger guild.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
我被指派负责神枪手公会的战斗训练。

scripts.text: Why you?
scripts.translation: 为什么是你？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Gunslingers are very fond of freedom, so the Guild had limited choices to choose from.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
神枪手们非常崇尚自由，所以公会的选择范围很有限。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
They suddenly called me to do this. Frankly I think it's a bit absurd.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
他们突然叫我来做这件事。说实话，我觉得有点荒唐。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
But on the basis of there being no previous Combat Training before, I have agreed to help.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
但鉴于之前没有战斗训练的先例，我同意帮忙了。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
So it was decided that we would use this opporunity to help get rid of some of the monsters near Prontera and Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
所以决定利用这个机会，顺便清理一下普隆德拉和依斯鲁得岛附近的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
It should help the people of those areas that are plagued by the same monsters every day.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
这应该能帮助那些每天都被同样魔物困扰的居民。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
In accordance with the principles of guilds, the Combat Training is not mandatory.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
根据公会的原则，战斗训练并非强制要求。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Once you complete a task, talk to me again to complete to process.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
完成任务后，请再次与我交谈以完成流程。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Well that's all! If a task proves to be too difficult you can cancel at any time, so please don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
好了，就这些！如果任务太难，您可以随时取消，所以请不要担心。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Haven't started your basic combat training yet have you? What do you want to know about training?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
您还没有开始基础战斗训练吧？您想了解关于训练的什么内容？

scripts.text: How long can I train for?
scripts.translation: 训练可以持续多久？

scripts.text: Where do I receive tasks for training?
scripts.translation: 在哪里领取训练任务？

scripts.text: Why do combat training?
scripts.translation: 为什么要进行战斗训练？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Basic combat training can be performed until Base Level 20.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
基础战斗训练可以一直进行到基础等级20级。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You must've thought that the training would be pretty low because this is still the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
您一定觉得训练很简单吧，毕竟这只是个开始。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Sorry! Did I not mention this?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
抱歉！我是不是没提到这一点？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You can choose any task you wish from the requests on my desk near the entrance.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
您可以从入口附近我桌上的请求中任选一个任务。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Right, ah, why? Well, The Gunslinger guild didn't have any combat training in the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
对，啊，为什么？嗯，神枪手公会最初并没有战斗训练。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
So they suddenly asked me to perform combat training for new recruits.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
所以他们突然让我为新成员进行战斗训练。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
This training is not mandatory if you do not want to do it.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
如果您不想参加，这个训练并非强制的。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You finished <Assignment A>?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
您完成了<任务A>？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Wow! You did perfectly! I have confirmed the 10 Hornets. Kids will be happy.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哇！您做得完美！我已确认10只蜂兵。孩子们会很开心的。

scripts.text: After looking over the report, you receive experience and a Kafra Storage Coupon.
scripts.translation: 在查看报告后，您获得了经验值和一张卡普拉仓库券。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You finished <Assignment B>?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
您完成了<任务B>？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You finished <Assignment B> too?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
您也完成了<任务B>？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Wow! You did perfect! I have confirmed the 10 Roda Frogs. Tonight I should get a good sleep.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哇！您做得完美！我已确认10只罗达蛙。今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。

scripts.text: After looking over the report, you receive experience and a Kafra Storage Coupon.
scripts.translation: 在查看报告后，您获得了经验值和一张卡普拉仓库券。

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哇！您做得完美！我已确认10只小野猪。想要培养专业宠物的学生一定很开心。

scripts.text: After looking over the report, you receive experience and a Kafra Storage Coupon.
scripts.translation: 在查看报告后，您获得了经验值和一张卡普拉仓库券。

scripts.text:

You finished <Assignment D>?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
您完成了<任务D>？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You finished <Assignment D> too?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
您也完成了<任务D>？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Wow! You did perfect! I have confirmed the 10 Rockers. Were they hard to catch?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哇！您做得完美！我已确认10只蝗虫。它们很难抓吗？

scripts.text: After looking over the report, you receive experience and a Kafra Storage Coupon.
scripts.translation: 在查看报告后，您获得了经验值和一张卡普拉仓库券。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
I have finished processing your completed tasks. Would you like to cancel any existing tasks?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
我已处理完您已完成的任务。您想取消任何现有任务吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Okay, good luck continuing your training!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
好的，祝您训练顺利！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Huh? You do not have any assignments to cancel. Are you sure you have them?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
咦？您没有可以取消的任务。您确定您有任务吗？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You still have some assignments, are they too difficult? Do you want to cancel them?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
您还有一些任务，它们太难了吗？您想取消它们吗？

scripts.text: Cancel Assignment
scripts.translation: 取消任务

scripts.text: Nevermind
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Well then, continue to impress!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
那么，继续加油吧！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You are currently doing <Assignment A>.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
您目前正在执行<任务A>。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Hornets are not easy to deal with, huh? Do you want to cancel the assignment?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
蜂兵不好对付，是吗？您想取消任务吗？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
If you do cancel the assignment, you will be unable to receive the reward you know?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
如果您取消任务，您将无法获得奖励，您知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
I have cancelled all the assignments you wished to cancel. If you have a hard time with any others, please come see me.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
我已取消您希望取消的所有任务。如果其他任务有困难，请随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Times flies, your basic training is coming to an end!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
时间过得真快，您的基础训练即将结束！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You have worked hard during this period! You have become a good marksman.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
这段时间您辛苦了！您已经成为了一名优秀的射手。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
However, you have still not completed your tasks.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
但是，您还没有完成所有任务。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You cannot receive any rewards if you do not complete the tasks assigned to you.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
如果不完成分配的任务，您将无法获得任何奖励。

scripts.text: What?! I'll go complete them!
scripts.translation: 什么？！我去完成它们！

scripts.text: I'm done with training!
scripts.translation: 我训练完了！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Take care!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
保重！

scripts.text: After looking over the report, you receive experience and a Kafra Storage Coupon.
scripts.translation: 在查看报告后，您获得了经验值和一张卡普拉仓库券。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Your Gunslinger basic training is now over.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你的神枪手基础训练到此结束了。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Oh my god! It's you again!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
天哪！又是你啊！

scripts.text: How are you?
scripts.translation: 你好吗？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Same old, same old. Every day teaching newbies about Gunslingers. But I love it.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
老样子，老样子。每天教新手关于神枪手的事。但我喜欢这样。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Oh yeah! My brother said he hasn't seen you for a long time. Be sure to take some time to visit him.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
对了！我哥哥说好久没见你了。记得抽空去拜访他一下。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Howdy! It's nice to see you again.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
嘿！很高兴再次见到你。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Howdy!
Huh! You seem to have transferred into a different class, why have you come here?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
嘿！
咦！你好像转职成了别的职业，为什么来这里？

scripts.text: To become a Gunslinger
scripts.translation: 想成为神枪手

scripts.text: Leave
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Huh? Huh? Where are you going?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
咦？咦？你要去哪里？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You cannot have more than one job. But you seem really serious to learn.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你不能拥有多个职业。不过你看起来真的很想学。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Since this is my job, and because it's no trouble, I will give you a simple explaination!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
既然这是我的工作，而且也不麻烦，我就给你简单解释一下！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Gunslingers is a class with long-range attacks. However, unlike arrows, bullets are expensive. This tends to give beginners some reason for concern.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
神枪手是一个远程攻击职业。但是，与箭矢不同，子弹很昂贵。这往往会让新手感到担忧。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Is that enough?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
这样解释够了吗？

scripts.text: Isn't that a little too simple?
scripts.translation: 这不是很简单吗？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Huh, is it? What else do you want to know?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
咦，是吗？你还想知道什么？

scripts.text: Stats
scripts.translation: 属性

scripts.text: Skills
scripts.translation: 技巧

scripts.text: Weapons
scripts.translation: 武器

scripts.text: Nevermind.
scripts.translation: 算了。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Gunslingers is a long-range attack class, so hand agility (DEX) will be very important.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
神枪手是远程攻击职业，所以敏捷（DEX）非常重要。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
If you want to increase your attack power, then you must strengthen your hands.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
如果你想提高攻击力，就必须强化你的双手。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Gunslinger skills are not like other classes. Each weapon type has skills that can be specifically used with them.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
神枪手的技能与其他职业不同。每种武器类型都有专门配合使用的技能。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Like with other classes, there is no standard toward which skills you should learn.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
与其他职业一样，没有规定你应该学习哪些技能的标准。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Gunslingers have five different kinds of guns.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
神枪手有五种不同类型的枪械。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Revolvers have low hit rates, but the attack speed is fast.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
左轮手枪命中率较低，但攻击速度很快。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Rifles are average in their performance, and is typically the weapon of choice for new Gunslingers.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
步枪性能中规中矩，通常是新手神枪手的武器首选。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Shotguns have strong attack power, but pretty low attack speeds.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
霰弹枪攻击力很强，但攻击速度较慢。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Gatling guns have quite a fast attack speed, but the attack power is low.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
加特林机枪攻击速度相当快，但攻击力较低。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Gernade Launchers can be used for strong ground attacks, but the bullets will be consumed quickly.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
榴弹发射器可以进行强力地面攻击，但弹药消耗很快。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Phew~ I hope I answered all your questions. This is the first time I've seen someone want to study other classes.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
呼~ 希望我回答了你的所有问题。这还是我第一次见到有人想研究其他职业。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Take care!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
保重！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]

你还有其他问题吗？

scripts.translation:

委托人：孩子们
村庄边缘有一只非常凶恶的蜂兵，因为它的存在，孩子们无法在外面玩耍。请消灭10只蜂兵。

[Lusa's desk]
There are lots of files on the desk, they seem to be tasks from Prontera and Izlude residents.
scripts.translation:
[露莎的书桌]
桌上有很多文件，看起来是普隆德拉和依斯鲁得岛居民的任务。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 您携带的物品太多了。-

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
Yesssssss? I wass sssent by the academy.
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
是...是吗？我是被学院派来的。

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
I am ^A2563ESharp Snake's Fang^000000 from the Gunslinger Guild. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
我是^A2563E锐利的蛇牙^000000，来自神枪手公会。您需要什么？

scripts.text: Exchange Guns
scripts.translation: 交换枪械

scripts.text: Just Saying Hello
scripts.translation: 只是打个招呼

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
You seem to be that guy our brother mentioned.
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
你似乎就是那位兄弟提到的人。

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
You don't need to worry, he said you're doing great!
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
不用担心，他说你做得很棒！

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
Do you wish to exchange your guild issued weapon?
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
您想要交换公会配发的武器吗？

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
Let's first check your gun's condition.
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
让我们先检查一下您的枪的状况。

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
If you want to proceed, you need to have your weapon equipped.
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
如果您想继续，需要装备您的武器。

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
The gun you are using is was not provided by the guild.
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
您使用的枪不是由公会提供的。

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
You want to exchange your Guild issued Revolver?
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
您想要交换公会配发的左轮手枪吗？

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
You want to exchange your Guild issued Rifle?
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
您想要交换公会配发的步枪吗？

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
You want to exchange your Guild issued Shotgun?
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
您想要交换公会配发的霰弹枪吗？

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
You want to exchange your Guild issued Gatling Gun?
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
您想要交换公会配发的加特林机枪吗？

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
You want to exchange your Guild issued Grenade Launcher?
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
您想要交换公会配发的榴弹发射器吗？

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
The gun looks to be in good condition.
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
这把枪看起来状况良好。

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
Please select the novice weapon you wish to exchange for your {0}!
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
请选择您想要用来交换{0}的初心者武器！

scripts.translation: 交换为左轮手枪

scripts.text: Exchange for Gatling Gun

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
Gun control management number ^FF0000{0}{1}{2}{3}{4}{5}{6}^000000.

[Sharp Snake's Fang]
Are there any issues?
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
还有其他问题吗？

scripts.text: No issues.
scripts.translation: 没有问题

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
Cherish your gun!
scripts.translation:
