scripts.text: Change job to Thief.
scripts.translation: 转职为盗贼

scripts.text: Thief Stat Explanation
scripts.translation: 盗贼属性说明

scripts.text: Thief Skill Explanation
scripts.translation: 盗贼技能说明

scripts.text: Not curious about it.
scripts.translation: 不感兴趣

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
You made up your mind.
Welcome to the world of shadows.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
你下定决心了。
欢迎来到阴影的世界。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If you are ready, I will send you to the deserts of Morocc to embrace the shadows.
The journey will be both strange and challenging.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
如果你准备好了，我将把你送往莫洛克的沙漠去拥抱阴影。
这段旅程既新奇又充满挑战。

scripts.text: At once please.
scripts.translation: 请立刻出发

scripts.text: I need more time.
scripts.translation: 我需要更多时间。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Yes, after a sufficient survey of other jobs, you may make a decision.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
是的，在充分调查其他职业后，你可以做出决定。

scripts.output:
[梅塞尔]
^4d4dff在摩洛克西北方寻找金字塔^000000。
scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffFind the Pyramid^000000 in the ^4d4dffNorthwest^000000 of Morocc.

[Mayssel]
I'm sorry but you are short of job levels to change your job.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
很抱歉，您的职业等级不足，无法转职。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Level composes of Base level and Job level.
Job level is what determines your current job.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
等级由基础等级和职业等级组成。
职业等级决定了您当前的职业。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffThe 1st job condition condition is job level 10.^000000
You need more experience so fight more and level up first.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
^4d4dff一转的条件是职业等级10。^000000
您需要更多的经验值，所以请先多战斗并提升等级。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
You want to know more about stats?
As Vicente already told you, stats don't have a fixed answer.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
您想更多地了解属性吗？
正如维森特告诉您的那样，属性并没有固定的答案。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If I choose one among them,
^4d4dffAGI is related to flee ability^000000,
^4d4dffDex is related with hit ratio
STR raises physical attacking power^000000
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
如果我在其中选择一个，
^4d4dffAGI与移花接木能力有关^000000，
^4d4dffDEX与命中率有关，
STR提升物理攻击力^000000

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Vit, Luk, Int are valued according your target chosen.
For your reference, Verkhasel has high level of Luk.
A weapon called Katar is good for Critical.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
VIT、LUK和INT的价值取决于您选择的目标。
供您参考，维尔卡塞尔拥有很高的LUK。
一种名为拳刃的武器很适合暴击。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
But thief's primary weapon is a dagger.
In the end, you have only to supplement your weak point, after evaluating you and your enemy.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
但盗贼的主要武器是短剑。
最终，您只需要在评估自己和敌人后，弥补自己的弱点即可。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If your attack doesn't hit the enemy, you come to think of the hit ratio.
Hope you find the right stats that are suitable to your fighting style.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
如果您的攻击无法命中敌人，您就会想到命中率。
希望您能找到适合自己战斗风格的正确属性。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Which skill are you curious about?
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
您对哪个技能感到好奇？

scripts.text: Improve Dodge
scripts.translation: 残影

scripts.text: Double attack
scripts.translation: 二刀连击

scripts.text: Hiding and Steal
scripts.translation: 隐匿和偷窃

scripts.text: Envenom and Detoxify
scripts.translation: 施毒和解毒

scripts.text: Not curious about it.
scripts.translation: 不感兴趣

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
As the name implies, ^4d4dffthis skill increases a certain amount of evasion ratio^000000
You want to avoid taking damage from enemy attack, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
顾名思义，^4d4dff这个技能会增加一定比例的回避率^000000
您想要避免受到敌人攻击的伤害，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffThis skill allows you to deal two damages with only one attack.^000000
Even though this dagger looks poor, it can damage your enemy severely by the fast two attacks.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
^4d4dff这个技能允许您仅用一次攻击造成两次伤害。^000000
虽然这把短剑看起来不起眼，但通过快速的两次攻击，它可以对敌人造成严重伤害。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffHiding means exactly that... to hide.^000000
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
^4d4dff隐匿的意思就是...躲藏。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffSteal is the skill of stealing enemy's items^000000.
You can steal one item from one enemy.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
^4d4dff偷窃是窃取敌人物品的技能^000000。
您可以从一名敌人身上偷取一件物品。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffEnvenom is used to poison your enemy.^000000
If poisoned, it can make a physical attacks slowly eat away at your foe.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
^4d4dff施毒用于毒害您的敌人。^000000
如果中毒，物理攻击会缓慢地消耗敌人的生命值。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Oppositely, the name implies, Detoxify removes poison status.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
相反，顾名思义，解毒可以移除中毒状态。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
It is good you have enough knowledge.
Supplementary the field experiences will make you perfect.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
很高兴您拥有足够的知识。
补充实战经验将使您变得完美。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Is that so?
Like other job guilds, there is a limit learned through theory.
I would like to recommend you to experience battle first-hand.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
是吗？
和其他职业公会一样，仅靠理论是有局限的。
我建议您先亲身体验一下战斗。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
You are a stranger.
Excuse me but I was invited to explain about the jobs for the students,
I have no words to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
您是陌生人。
抱歉，我被邀请来为学生讲解职业知识，
没有多余的话可以告诉您。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
It is almost miracle to meet you and me living far away from the light of ground.
We should abide by the regulations.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
能在远离地面光芒的地方遇到您和我，几乎是个奇迹。
我们应该遵守规定。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Attending the class, first you may be a student of Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
要参加课程，首先您必须是克里阿图拉学院的学生。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
However, if you want the information about the thief job itself, I will let you know.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
不过，如果您想了解盗贼职业本身的信息，我会告诉您。

You have a good memory.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
正确！
你的记忆力很好。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
You like doing that?
That is a terrible thing to do.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
你喜欢那样做吗？
那是非常糟糕的行为。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Yes, we steal monster items.
the higher your skill level and the higher your hit ratio is, the success ratio also becomes higher.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
是的，我们偷取魔物的物品。
技能等级越高，命中率越高，成功率也就越高。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Anyway, here I will finish my class.
If you want to continue, there is no way as your level is too high.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
总之，我的课程到此结束。
如果你想继续，由于你的等级太高，没有别的办法了。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Hmmm. What?
You are talking about the use of thief skills by using the manual?
First, equip the Thief Manual.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
嗯？什么？
你是在问如何使用手册来使用盗贼技能吗？
首先，装备盗贼入门手册。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
You can either double click ^4d4dffthe items to be equipped^000000 or drag it to the equipment window.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
你可以双击^4d4dff要装备的物品^000000，或者将其拖到装备栏中。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Then, open the skill window, you can find the added skills in the 'Misc' tab.
You can even set the skills in the shortcut bar.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
然后，打开技能窗口，你可以在“杂项”标签页中找到新增的技能。
你甚至可以将技能设置在快捷栏中。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Now, out of them, there is a skill called ^4d4dffSteal^000000.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
现在，其中有一个技能叫做^4d4dff偷窃^000000。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Here is an assignment.
Can you see the ornamental Poring cage?
Steal ^4d4dffone Stone from Poring by using the Steal skill.^000000
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
这里有一个任务。
你能看到装饰用的波利笼子吗？
使用偷窃技能从波利身上偷取^4d4dff一块石头^000000。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Steal has a possibility to fail so don't quit.
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
偷窃有失败的可能性，所以不要放弃。
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Oh, excellent!
Keep the stone as a souvenir.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
哦，太棒了！
把这块石头留作纪念吧。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Anyway, it is good enough for your skill experience purpose, let's finish the class here.
If you haven't finished Mr. Verkhasel's assignment, keep going with it.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
总之，对于你的技能经验来说已经足够了，让我们在这里结束课程吧。
如果你还没有完成维尔卡塞尔的任务，请继续完成它。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Steal one Stone from a Poring.
Wasn't it fun?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
从波利身上偷取一块石头。
是不是很有趣？

scripts.text: It didn't give me a stone.
scripts.translation: 我没有得到石头。

scripts.text: I won't do it.
scripts.translation: 我不做了。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Hmmm? All porings were stolen of their stones?
I will summon Porings again, and you, try it once again.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
嗯？所有的波利都被偷走了石头吗？
我会再召唤一些波利，你再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Hmmm. Is that so?
This is not your aptitude.
I see. This mission is now cancelled.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
嗯。是这样吗？
看来这不是你的天赋所在。
我明白了。这个任务就此取消。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Ahhh. Boring, Boring...
Now I can understand why Master ran away.
I want to go home.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
啊哈。真无聊，真无聊...
现在我终于明白师父为什么要逃走了。
我想回家了。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
So do I.
Mayssel... what did she think of...
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
我也是这么想的。
梅塞尔...她到底在想什么...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Hmmm. Did she go AWOL?
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
嗯。她擅离职守了？

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Are you kidding me?!
Would you rather be carrying out a fatal mission!?!
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
你在开玩笑吗？！
难道你想执行一个致命的任务吗？！

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Ah... I don't like it.
I would rather evaluate jewelry sitting at the workshop as usual...
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
啊...我不喜欢这样。
我还是想像往常一样，在工作室里鉴定珠宝...

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
.... .. ..
I will accept Verkhassel's wish.
Don't worry hohoho...
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
.... .. ..
我会接受维尔卡塞尔的请求。
别担心，呵呵呵...

scripts.text:
The mood is becoming gloomy.
Should I get out of here?
scripts.translation:
气氛变得有些阴沉。
我该离开这里吗？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
You are doing well.
I hope to see you again someday.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
你做得很好。
希望有一天能再见到你。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Ah, for your reference, I am operating a small workshop in Lighthalzen.
Visit me there someday.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
啊，顺便告诉你，我在里希塔乐镇经营着一家小工作室。
有空的时候来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Perhaps, I won't forget you...
Haha...
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
也许，我不会忘记你...
哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
You are not a student of Criatura Academy.
If you want more explanation about this job, you better register as a student of the Academy.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
你并不是克里阿图拉学院的学生。
如果你想要了解更多关于这个职业的信息，最好去学院注册成为学生。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Though only novices can register...
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
不过只有初心者才能注册...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Oh, you became a good thief.
Don't you want to be a shadow chaser in your future?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
哦，你成为了一个优秀的盗贼。
你未来不想成为逐影猎人吗？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
This is the higher class applied by the elite Rogues of good artistry.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
这是由技艺精湛的精英流氓所追求的高阶职业。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Above job level 40, any Thief can be transferred to a Rogue anytime.
Fortunately, the sailing service from Izlude wharf to Pharos lighthouse is available!!
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
职业等级40以上，任何盗贼都可以随时转职为流氓。
幸运的是，从依斯鲁得岛码头到发乐斯灯塔岛的渡轮服务已经开通！！

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
First, is it courteous to ask whether you can be a Rogue or not?
If it is an application for an Assassin, what happens to you?
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
首先，礼貌地问一下你是否能转职为流氓，这合适吗？
如果是申请成为刺客，那结果会怎样？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Haha. You like a bloody job?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
哈哈。你喜欢血腥的职业？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Haha... Calm down...
Don't respond to every tiny matter..
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
哈哈...冷静点...
不要对每件小事都做出反应...

scripts.text: The atmosphere became very tense.
scripts.translation: 气氛变得非常紧张。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Welcome to the Criatura Academy.
Here, I am teaching the basics to the people wishing to be a Thief.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
欢迎来到克里阿图拉学院。
在这里，我负责教导那些希望成为盗贼的人基础知识。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
So, in other words, I am handling the Novices wanting to be thieves.
Haha...
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
也就是说，我负责处理那些想成为盗贼的初心者。
哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
What? It interrupts me.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
什么？你在打扰我。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Eheee, Eheee, It can't be a joke.
Mayssel's class...
Did you call upon me for this kind of nasty thing?
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
呵呵，呵呵，这可不是开玩笑的。
梅塞尔的课...
你叫我来处理这种麻烦事？

scripts.text: ...Let's keep working?
scripts.translation: 继续上课

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
It's a pity. That man is scary.
But as long as I am with you, don't be afraid of him.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
真遗憾。那个男人很可怕。
但只要我在你身边，就不用怕他。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
What are you talking about this time?
In the beginning, Lue.. You should not be here...
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
这次又怎么了？
一开始，卢...你不应该在这里...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.........Who am I?
Assistant.... Trainer?

[Verkhasel]
Zt...
Well, which one are you curious about?
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
啧...
好吧，你对哪方面比较好奇？

scripts.text: Double Attack
scripts.translation: 二刀连击

scripts.text: Envenom
scripts.translation: 施毒

scripts.text: Improve Dodge and Hide
scripts.translation: 残影和躲藏

scripts.text: About you
scripts.translation: 关于你

scripts.text: That's enough.
scripts.translation: 够了

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You  may already know the primary weapon of a Thief is a dagger.
A Thief's specialty is the ^4d4dffDouble Attack^000000 by a dagger.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
你可能已经知道盗贼的主要武器是短剑。
盗贼的专长是使用短剑进行^4d4dff二刀连击^000000。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
If you are short of attacking power, it can be covered at a certain degree.
Any other questions?
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
如果攻击力不足，可以在一定程度上弥补。
还有其他问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
There is a skill called ^4d4dffEnvenom^000000 to intoxicate your enemy with poison and
the other skill called ^4d4dffDetoxify^000000 to remove the poisoned status.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
有一个技能叫^4d4dff施毒^000000，可以用毒让敌人中毒；
另一个技能叫^4d4dff解毒^000000，可以解除中毒状态。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You can tell the poisoned status by its very pretty purple color.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
你可以通过非常漂亮的紫色来识别中毒状态。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
In case, you are poisoned, venom will decrease your vitality rapidly,
you either detoxify right away or take the antidote potion.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
如果你中毒了，毒素会迅速降低你的生命力，
你必须立即解毒或服用解毒剂。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
If you have more interest in poison, you may be an assassin.
They officially use poison.
Then next!
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
如果你对毒更感兴趣，你可能适合成为刺客。
他们正式使用毒药。
那么接下来！

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Thiefs train the skill called ^4d4dffImprove Dodge^000000.
This makes the enemy powerless by evading its attack.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
盗贼训练一个叫^4d4dff残影^000000的技能。
这可以通过闪避敌人的攻击使其无效化。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Rather than being patient after being hit, it is more suitable for a less defensive thief to avoid from it fast.
Being this reason, agility [AGI] can't be neglected.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
与其在被打中后忍耐，对于防御力较低的盗贼来说，快速躲避更为合适。
因此，敏捷[AGI]不容忽视。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
^4d4dffHiding^000000 is the skill for refuge.
If successful, others can't see you.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
^4d4dff隐匿^000000是用于隐蔽的技能。
如果成功，其他人将无法看见你。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Ah, as it is said you can't cheat a ghost.... You would be found by evil.
Also sensitive insects recognize it...
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
啊，俗话说得好，你骗不了幽灵……你会被邪恶发现的。
而且敏感的昆虫也能察觉到……

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Other than these, it will be useful for avoiding emergency situations.
When you become higher jobs like Rogue or Assassin, you can learn more useful skills like Refuge.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
除此之外，它在躲避紧急状况时也很有用。
当你转职为流氓或刺客后，可以学到更多实用的技能，比如隐蔽。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Me? I am a chief of the Guillotine Cross.
......
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
我？我是十字斩首者的首领。
......

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
As one of the assassins, I am in charge of punishing the law violators, as the member of the execution group.
For your reference, the primary weapon of Verkhasel is Katar.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
作为刺客之一，我负责惩罚违法者，是行刑小组的成员。
供你参考，维尔卡塞尔的主要武器是拳刃。

scripts.text: How do you know that?
scripts.translation: 你怎么知道的？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
That's my hope.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
那是我的希望。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Oh.. Smart funk~~
That's enough, Lu.
Any more questions?
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
哦.. 聪明的家伙~~
好了，卢。
还有别的问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You can steal one item from one enemy.
I feel mortified at stopping here, but it's worse to be neglected...
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
你可以从一个敌人那里偷取一件物品。
我觉得停在这里很尴尬，但被忽视更糟...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
OK.
Considering your favor not to ignore me, let's finish it now.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
好的。
考虑到你不忽视我的好意，我们现在就结束吧。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Honestly, I don't think you need to know the details about the thief's skills.
Then, just be aware there is something like that..
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
老实说，我觉得你不需要知道盗贼技能的细节。
只要知道有这种东西就行了..

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
I mean it is good enough now.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
我的意思是，现在这样就足够了。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Anything else you're curious about?
I will give you an answer after you finish Mayssel's class.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
还有什么你好奇的吗？
在你完成梅塞尔的课程后，我会给你答案。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
I mean that she knows it.
Mayssel will do it for you.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
我的意思是她知道。
梅塞尔会为你做的。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Lazy boy.
Tell me the truth... You are annoying..
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
懒散的男孩。
告诉我实话... 你很烦..

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
.......You........
Zt.. I don't know the enemy..

[Verkhasel]
Actual experience assignments about the skill?
To do it, your level is too high.
I can't use the guide.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
关于技能的实际经验任务？
要做这个，你的等级太高了。
我无法使用向导。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Originally, I will let you hunt porings with envenom.
No way, if I can't use the skill....
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
原本，我会让你用施毒去猎杀波利。
没办法，如果我不能用这个技能....

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Envenom is the skill to poison.
If not poison him, you can damage to him due to the characteristic of venom.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
施毒是用于中毒的技能。
如果不让他中毒，你可以利用毒素的特性对他造成伤害。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Keep in mind of these. That might be good enough for you.
As it is the class to let you know what you can do.
Let's finish the skill experience.
Check with Mayssel.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
记住这些。对你来说可能已经足够了。
这是让你了解你能做什么的课程。
让我们完成技能经验。
去和梅塞尔确认。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You are doing well.
Envenom has the poison effect and can damage from venom itself.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
你做得很好。
施毒具有中毒效果，并且毒素本身也能造成伤害。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
The skill experience is now enough.
Check it with Mayssel.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
技能经验已经足够了。
去和梅塞尔确认一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You can't equip the Thief Manual?
Your level is too high.
There is no other way.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
你无法装备盗贼入门手册？
你的等级太高了。
没有其他办法了。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Envenom is the skill to poison.
If not poison him, you can damage to him due to the characteristic of venom.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
施毒是用于中毒的技能。
如果不让他中毒，你可以利用毒素的特性对他造成伤害。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Keep in mind of these. That might be good enough for you.
As it is the class to let you know what you can do.
Let's finish the skill experience.
Check with Mayssel.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
记住这些。对你来说可能已经足够了。
这是让你了解你能做什么的课程。
让我们完成技能经验。
去和梅塞尔确认。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
This is about the use of skill.
Now if you were an assassin, shall I let you test the skills related to venom which you may continue to use?
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
这是关于技能的使用。
现在，如果你是一名刺客，让我测试一下你可以继续使用的与毒素相关的技能，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Load the thief guide receved by Mayssel and open the skill window by pressing Alt+S key,
Register Envenom regisstered on the ETC compartment,  by pressing shortcut key^000000
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
加载从梅塞尔那里获得的盗贼向导，按下Alt+S键打开技能窗口，
按下快捷键将注册在ETC栏中的施毒^000000

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Then, approach the Poring's cage in the center of this room and
Aim at Poring, and ^4d4dff' hunt one poring by using
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
然后，靠近房间中央的波利笼子，
瞄准波利，使用^4d4dff'猎杀一只波利

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
That's my assignment to you.
You definitely use envenom to Poring in this room.
don't go out faraway to find Porings.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
这就是我的任务。
你必须在这个房间里对波利使用施毒。
不要跑太远去找波利。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Eummm.
It's sad..
Please accept my condolence in advance, as you can't experience envenom... hehehe...
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
嗯。
真可惜..
请提前接受我的哀悼，因为你无法体验施毒...呵呵呵...

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在说什么？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
From now, I am going to hunt Poring..
...Don't misunderstand me for challenging you, as such I  want to make a bet with you.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
从现在开始，我要去猎杀波利..
...别误会我在向你挑战，我只是想和你打个赌。

scripts.text: Lumin is betting win or loose.
scripts.translation: 卢敏正在赌输赢。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You are doing well.
Envenom has the poison effect and can damage from venom itself.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
你做得很好。
施毒具有中毒效果，并且毒素本身也能造成伤害。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
The skill experience is now enough.
Check it with Mayssel.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
技能经验已经足够了。
去和梅塞尔确认一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Come close to a poring cage and use envenom to poring.
You must do it only to porings in this room.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
靠近波利笼子并对波利使用施毒。
你只能对这个房间里的波利这么做。

scripts.text: I see..
scripts.translation: 我明白了..

scripts.text: I won't do it.
scripts.translation: 我不做了。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
OK. Until you kill all the porings in the cage, attack them with venom.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
好的。在杀死笼子里所有波利之前，用毒素攻击它们。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
These are not your aptitude.
I will cancel my assignment, and the other assignments from Mayssel to be cancelled by her.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
这不是你的专长。
我会取消我的任务，梅塞尔那边的其他任务也会由她取消。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: I will continue..
scripts.translation: 我会继续..

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Cancel the mission to hunt poring with envenom.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
取消用施毒猎杀波利的任务。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Have you changed your mind?
Then, until you kill all the poring in the cage, keep attacking them with envenom.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
你改变主意了？
那么，在杀死笼子里所有波利之前，继续用施毒攻击它们。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Now you fully understand what skill venom is..
As you completed my assignment, go and check it with Mayssel.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
现在你完全理解毒素技能了..
既然你完成了我的任务，去和梅塞尔确认一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You are the bung finished Mayssel's class complete.
Any more questions, ask Mayssel.
It is the end of my class.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
你终于完成了梅塞尔的课程。
如果还有问题，去问梅塞尔。
我的课程到此结束。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
If you become a thief, we may meet together in far future..
If you become an assassin.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
如果你成为盗贼，我们也许会在遥远的未来再次相遇..
如果你成为刺客。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
There is no words to tell you guy not belonging to our academy.
In fact, I pulled out here unwillingly, I don't have mind to be kind of you...
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
对于不属于我们学院的人，我无话可说。
事实上，我是被迫来到这里的，我并没有想要对你们好...

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Wait, Verkhasel.....
Don't get even with other innocent....
How about helping my class for me?
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
等等，维尔卡塞尔.....
不要对无辜的人发火....
不如帮我代一下课？

scripts.text: ... everyone seems tense..
scripts.translation: ... 大家似乎都很紧张..

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Yo~ You...
What do you want to be?
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
哟~ 你...
你想成为什么？

scripts.text: An Assassin!
scripts.translation: 刺客！

scripts.text: A Rogue!
scripts.translation: 流氓！

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Welcome to your joining in the way of bloody darness.
My comrad.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
欢迎加入血腥黑暗之道。
我的战友。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
..............
(Verkhasel glancing at sky)
...
... Ha...!
The mood is becoming strange.
scripts.translation: 气氛变得有些奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Go over there.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
去那边。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Oh... Mr. Verkhasel...
Don't play like this among a family.
Why are you dividing us into teams?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
噢... 维尔卡塞尔先生...
家人之间不要这样玩闹。
为什么要把我们分成两队？

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
I've never been in your family.
Originally, you are not a Rogue.
You were only a merchant.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
我从未属于过你们的家族。
原本，你也不是流氓。
你只是个商人。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Oh.. No.. What a dirty word.
Have I asked you for buying something from me?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
噢.. 不.. 真是难听的话。
我有向你买过什么东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
..........You look friendly.. Two of you...
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
..........你们看起来关系不错.. 你们两个...

scripts.text: The mood has become tense.
scripts.translation: 气氛变得紧张起来。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You are the guy knows everything you need.
Are you coming to watch only? Emmm?
Why don't you help the juniors without watch only?
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
你是那个什么都知道的人。
你只是来看着吗？嗯？
为什么不多帮帮后辈，只在一旁看着呢？

scripts.text:
Quest cannot be continued due to the overfilled inventory.
Please try it again after organizing the items.
scripts.translation:
由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。
请整理物品后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Your eagerness and efforst to complete mission moved me to offer something.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
你完成任务的热情和努力打动了我，让我想提供点东西。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
^4d4dff It is to hunt all 4 Porings here within 30 seconds^000000.
If you do, I will yield to you all the earned item in my hand.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
^4d4dff在30秒内猎杀这里所有的4只波利^000000。
如果你做到了，我会把手中获得的物品全部让给你。

scripts.text: If I fail?
scripts.translation: 如果我失败了？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
It is our bet. You have to give up yours as you lost.
Emmm. As I am generous, I will receive ^4d4dff10 beginner's red potions^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
这是我们的赌注。如果你输了，就必须放弃你的东西。
嗯。既然我很大方，我会收下^4d4dff10瓶初级红色药水^000000。

scripts.text: Give Up.
scripts.translation: 放弃

scripts.text: I Accept.
scripts.translation: 我接受

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.... Eh...
Coward!
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
……呃……
胆小鬼！

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.... Good!
Now, ^4d4dffspeak to me once you finish hunting 4 porings in 30 seconds.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
……很好！
现在，^4d4dff在30秒内猎杀4只波利后，再来与我对话。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
The intoxicated enemies won't die only from poisoning.
They only come close to death.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
中毒的敌人不会仅因中毒而死。
它们只是接近死亡状态。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.. Why do Porings turn their back?
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
……为什么波利会背对着我？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
... 30 seconds have passed and you have not yet hunted 4 porings.
Then, it is not interesting.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
……30秒已经过去了，你还没有猎杀4只波利。
那么，这就不有趣了。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
If you don't like do it... no way.
As I am generous, I disregard the bet this time.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
如果你不想做……算了。
既然我很大方，这次就免除赌注吧。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
You may be too busy in^4d4dff hunting 4 porings in 30 seconds.^000000
Hey, time passes now...
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
你可能正忙着^4d4dff在30秒内猎杀4只波利。^000000
嘿，时间正在流逝……

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Oh... You are very powerful!
Now then, as agreed I will give you everything I have.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
哦……你非常强大！
那么，按照约定，我会把我所有的东西都给你。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I've had a lot of fun because of you!
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
因为你，我玩得很开心！

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Regretfully, 30 seconds has passed.
.....
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
遗憾地是，30秒已经过去了。
……

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I will give them to you anyways.
Come on, take it.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
不管怎样，我会把它们给你的。
来吧，拿去吧。

scripts.text: Why are you treating me like this?
scripts.translation: 你为什么这样对我？

scripts.text: Didn't I loose?
scripts.translation: 我不是输了吗？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
You spent time with me.
Get it free. I stole them from Porings.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
你陪我度过了时光。
免费送你。我是从波利那里偷来的。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
We may meet again.
Becoming familiar with others is pleasrue and sad.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
我们可能会再见面。
与他人变得熟悉，既令人愉快又令人伤感。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
... It may be in trouble if it dies upfront...
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
……如果它先死了，可能会有麻烦……

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
At last, the day comes.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
终于，这一天来了。

scripts.text: Lumin changing clothes piece by piece.
scripts.translation: 卢敏正在一件一件地换衣服。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I was carrying out my mission.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
我在执行任务。

scripts.text: No need to make an excuse....
scripts.translation: 不用找借口……

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
At least to you, I don't want to be a stranger.
Forget what you saw today, as I have to introduce to the way of Thief Guild as many people as possible.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
至少对你，我不想做一个陌生人。
请忘记你今天看到的，因为我必须向尽可能多的人介绍盗贼公会的规矩。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Did you ^ff0000register with the Criatura Academy^000000?
You can register at ^ff0000information center of Criatura Academy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
你^ff0000在克里阿图拉学院注册^000000了吗？
你可以在^ff0000克里阿图拉学院的资讯中心^000000进行注册。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
It is annoying... but you need to register so you can receive ^ff0000lots of education and service of Criatura Academy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
虽然有点麻烦……但你需要注册，这样才能接受^ff0000克里阿图拉学院提供的众多教育和服务^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
oh Odin!
Nice to meet you.
I am Alice Yisha ^ff0000in charge of Acolytes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
哦，奥丁！
很高兴见到你。
我是^ff0000负责服事事务^000000的爱丽丝·伊莎。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Welcome~
Glad to meet you again.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
欢迎~
很高兴再次见到你。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
If you did not select Acolyte as a job, why don't you study more about it?
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
如果你没有选择服事作为职业，为什么不更多地了解一下呢？

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
I guess you do not need my help any more.
Do you have any questions about Acolytes?
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
看来你不再需要我的帮助了。
关于服事，你还有什么疑问吗？

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
An acolyte serves ^ff0000Odin^000000 so it can use ^ff0000Holy skills^000000 according to the will of Odin.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
服事侍奉^ff0000奥丁^000000，因此可以根据奥丁的意志使用^ff0000神圣技能^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Most skills are based on ^ff0000the purpose of treatment or aid^000000 so it is a very important job for ^ff0000party hunting^000000.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
大多数技能都基于^ff0000治疗或辅助的目的^000000，因此对于^ff0000队伍狩猎^000000来说是非常重要的职业。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
It is a ^ff0000hybrid job^000000 which can change ^ff0000attack type^000000 depends on increased status, but the range of weapon is narrow because they don't use fatal killing weapons for religious reason.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
这是一个^ff0000混合职业^000000，可以根据提升的属性改变^ff0000攻击类型^000000，但由于宗教原因不使用致命武器，所以武器范围较窄。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
An acolyte is categorized as ^ff0000support type^000000 and ^ff0000physical attack type^000000.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
服事被归类为^ff0000辅助型^000000和^ff0000物理攻击型^000000。

scripts.text: Support type
scripts.translation: 辅助型

scripts.text: Attack type
scripts.translation: 攻击型

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
^ff0000INT^000000 is important status for ^ff0000support type Acolytes^000000.
^ff0000INT^000000 enhances ^ff0000treatment function^000000 and increases ^ff0000SP^000000 which is necessary for using skills.
It also helps ^ff0000SP recovery^000000.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
^ff0000INT^000000是^ff0000辅助型服事^000000的重要属性。
^ff0000INT^000000能增强^ff0000治疗功能^000000，并增加使用技能所需的^ff0000SP^000000。
它还有助于^ff0000SP恢复^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
But  aid type acolyte has a weakness point such as ^ff0000It is difficult to hunt alone^000000.
So it goes huning with ^ff0000party^000000 or use ^ff0000heal^000000 skill to monsters with ^ff0000fire-attribute^000000.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
但是辅助型服事有一个弱点，比如^ff0000很难独自狩猎^000000。
所以它们通常与^ff0000队伍^000000一起狩猎，或者使用^ff0000治愈术^000000攻击具有^ff0000火属性^000000的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
It is like ^ff0000heal skill with holly power is fatal to undead with fire-attribute^000000.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
就像^ff0000带有神圣力量的治愈术对具有火属性的不死系魔物是致命的^000000一样。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
The important status FOR ^ff0000physical attack type^000000 acolyte is ^ff0000STR, VIT, AGI, DEX^000000.
The status seem to be complicated compare to support type but it is simple indeed.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
^ff0000物理攻击型^000000服事的重要属性是^ff0000STR、VIT、AGI、DEX^000000。
与辅助型相比，这些属性看起来比较复杂，但实际上很简单。

scripts.output:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
^ff0000STR是力量，提升攻击力；VIT是体质，提升物理防御力；AGI是敏捷，提升攻击速度、移动速度和回避率；DEX是灵巧，提升命中率和技能施放速度。^000000
scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
^ff0000STR is the power, increases attack power, VIT is physical power, AGI is attack , speed and dodge, DEX increases hitting rate and skill casting speed.

[Alice Yisha]
For the character of ^ff0000Attack type^000000, ^ff0000DEX^000000 will be most important status...no?
If the attack does not hit the enemy, the attack is meaningless.
You may increase STR, VIT, AGI according to your style.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
对于^ff0000攻击型^000000角色来说，^ff0000DEX^000000应该是最重要的属性...对吧？
如果攻击无法命中敌人，那么攻击就没有意义。
您可以根据自己的风格来提高STR、VIT和AGI。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
You might think an Acolyte is not strong enough because it has no attack type skill, it enables use of sub essential skills which enhance the powers as much as you want. It helps your stable hunting.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
您可能觉得服事没有攻击型技能，所以不够强大，但它可以使用辅助性技能，将能力增强到您想要的程度。这有助于您稳定地进行狩猎。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Ask me anything if you have more questions.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
如果您还有更多问题，尽管问我。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
An acolyte has lots of skills.
All those skills are useful.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
服事拥有许多技能。
这些技能都非常有用。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
^ff0000Heal^000000 is for the wounds, It is also used to attack undead with opposite attribute.
Increase the power related to ^ff0000speed^000000 and ^ff0000[Increase Agi]^000000 to increase  ^ff0000movement speed^000000
^ff0000[Blessing]^000000 can ^ff0000enhance^000000 ^ff0000STR, INT, DEX^000000 at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
^ff0000治愈术^000000用于治疗伤口，也可用于攻击具有相反属性的不死系魔物。
提高与^ff0000速度^000000和^ff0000[增加AGI]^000000相关的属性，可以增加^ff0000移动速度^000000。
^ff0000[天使之赐福]^000000可以同时^ff0000增强^000000^ff0000STR、INT、DEX^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
^ff0000[Teleport]^000000 is to ^ff0000move^000000 to other places.
^ff0000[Warp Portal]^000000 can open a gate to the ^ff0000Places saved in memory^000000.
There are still more skills as well.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
^ff0000[瞬间移动]^000000用于^ff0000移动^000000到其他地点。
^ff0000[传送之阵]^000000可以打开通往^ff0000记忆中保存的地点^000000的大门。
此外还有更多技能。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Ask ^ff0000if you want to experience skills of an Acolyte, ask the sister next to you^000000.
Now I am reading an introductory skill.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
^ff0000如果您想体验服事的技能，请询问您旁边的修女^000000。
我现在正在阅读入门技能介绍。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
oh my!
So.. you decided to be an Acolyte?
Odin welcomes you.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
哎呀！
那么...您决定成为服事了？
奥丁欢迎您。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Do you truly wish to become a servant of God?
Let's see whether you are ready for it or not... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
您真的希望成为神的侍从吗？
让我看看您是否准备好了...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Please visit ^ff0000Father Mareusis^000000 at the church in the ^ff0000northeast corner^000000 of ^ff0000Prontera.^000000
At ^ff0000Job Level 10^000000 you can join the ministry.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
请前往^ff0000普隆德拉^000000^ff0000东北角^000000的教堂，拜访^ff0000马鲁西斯神父^000000。
在^ff0000职业等级10^000000时，您可以加入教会。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Oh my?! You haven't accomplished the basic practice yet?! You have long way to go! Come again after increasing your job level!
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
哎呀？您还没有完成基础练习吗？！您还有很长的路要走！提高您的职业等级后再来吧！

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Wonderful! I'll transfer you to the local ministry at Prontera.
^ff0000Please visit Father Mareusis at the church in the northeast corner of Prontera.^000000
At ^ff0000Job Level 10^000000 you can join the ministry.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
太好了！我会将您转介到普隆德拉的当地教会。
^ff0000请前往普隆德拉东北角的教堂拜访马鲁西斯神父。^000000
在^ff0000职业等级10^000000时，您可以加入教会。

scripts.text: Go to the field south of Prontera
scripts.translation: 前往普隆德拉南方的野外

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Ask me anything if you have more questions.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
如果您还有更多问题，尽管问我。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Good, I wish you luck~
Let's go~
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
很好，祝您好运~
我们出发吧~

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Ask me anything if you have more questions.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
如果您还有更多问题，尽管问我。

scripts.text:
[A nun]
Wow... this academy is amazing?
It was not like this when I used to train in the past.
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
哇...这所学院真令人惊叹？
不像我过去训练时那样。

scripts.text:
[A nun]
Wow... this academy is amazing?
It was not like this when I used to train in the past.
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
哇...这所学院真令人惊叹？
不像我过去训练时那样。

scripts.text:
[A nun]
You can ^ff0000register^000000 at the ^ff0000information center of the Criatura Academy^000000, it will be a great help.
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
您可以在^ff0000克里阿图拉学院资讯中心^000000^ff0000登记^000000，这会很有帮助。

scripts.text:
[A nun]
Ahem..~
Who are you?
Are you interested in this ^ff0000introductory course^000000?
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
咳咳..~
您是谁？
您对这门^ff0000入门课程^000000感兴趣吗？

scripts.text:
[A nun]
This introductory manual is mysterious! It enables the ^ff0000use a couple of an Acolyte's skill^000000.
Will you borrow it?
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
这本入门手册很神秘！它允许^ff0000使用几个服事的技能^000000。
您要借用它吗？

scripts.text: Take the Acolyte Course.
scripts.translation: 参加服事课程

scripts.text: Stop.

scripts.text:

Well.. if you are not interested.. fine.
murmuring
scripts.translation:

既然...您不感兴趣...那好吧。
（低声嘟囔）

scripts.text:
[A nun]
You already have one.
We do not give two.
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
您已经有一本了。
我们不会发放两本。

[A nun]
Then, use it for good.
^ff0000Equip (double click or drag to equipment window)^000000 and open the ^ff0000skill window(Alt+S)^000000 to see the skills in manual.
scripts.translation:

那么，请善用它。
^ff0000装备（双击或拖拽至装备栏）^000000，并打开^ff0000技能窗口（Alt+S）^000000查看手册中的技能。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I do not wish to speak to you. Leave now...
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
我不想和你说话。现在离开...

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
If you want to be trained as a Ninja, just visit Hono O, who is at the room next to where you upgraded.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
如果你想接受忍者训练，去拜访Hono O吧，他就在你升级的那个房间的隔壁。

scripts.text:
[Ko Ori]
If you want to be trained as a Ninja, just visit Hono O, who is at the room next to where you upgraded.
scripts.translation:
[小织]
如果你想接受忍者训练，去拜访Hono O吧，他就在你升级的那个房间的隔壁。

scripts.text:
[Ko Ori]
How was it?
Although he is very blunt, he does care very deeply about newcomers.
scripts.translation:
[小织]
感觉如何？
虽然他说话很直，但他其实非常关心新人。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I am the guide to the way of the Ninja for newcomers.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
我是为新人指引忍者之道的向导。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I am not interested in the people who are already on their path.
Take your leave now...
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
我对已经踏上这条道路的人不感兴趣。
请离开...

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
A child cannot accept the life of the Ninja.
It is not easy to qualify for such a life, so do not feel sorry...
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
孩子无法承受忍者的生活。
获得这种生活的资格并不容易，所以不要感到遗憾...

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
First of all, you must enroll in the Academy and visit me again.
Everything has to follow the correct procedures and being clumsy is no excuse.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
首先，你必须注册学院，然后再来找我。
一切都要遵循正确的程序，笨拙不是借口。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Hmmm. So a new beginner has come eh?
Why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
嗯。看来来了个新初学者？
你来这里做什么？

scripts.text: Explanation about the Ninja.
scripts.translation: 关于忍者的说明

scripts.text: I decided to be a Ninja.
scripts.translation: 我决定成为忍者

scripts.text: I don't have any business here.
scripts.translation: 我没什么事

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
A beginner wishing to be a Ninja....
Ask me what you are curious about.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
想成为忍者的初学者...
问问你好奇的事情吧。

scripts.text: What can I do if I become a Ninja?
scripts.translation: 成为忍者后能做什么？

scripts.text: What is required to become a Ninja?
scripts.translation: 成为忍者需要什么条件？

scripts.text: I want to experience Ninja skills.
scripts.translation: 我想体验忍者技能

scripts.text: I don't have any worries about Ninjas.
scripts.translation: 我对忍者没有疑问

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Ninja is a profession that allows you to attack while sneaking for maximum damage.
As Ninja has various kinds of deception skills, which is good for soloing.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
忍者是一种可以在潜行中发动攻击，以造成最大伤害的职业。
由于忍者拥有各种各样的幻术技能，因此非常适合单人作战。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Not only can you learn Ninja technique similarly as magic, you can also make direct attacks, deal critical damage or throw knives at enemies.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
你不仅可以像魔法一样学习忍术，还可以进行直接攻击、造成暴击伤害，或者向敌人投掷飞刀。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
But you can't do all of these things perfectly without sufficient equipment.
You will take more damage than others if you are hit.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
但是，如果没有足够的装备，你无法完美地做到这一切。
如果你被击中，受到的伤害会比其他人更多。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Therefore, if the person who is not completely weary of this world chooses this job, with no discretion, they will not fail.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
因此，如果一个人没有完全厌倦这个世界，并且不加选择地选择了这个职业，他绝不会失败。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Ninja can be trained in a variety of courses.
Everything has both one merit and one demerit.
You would better make your own decision after profound consideration.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
忍者可以接受多种课程的训练。
每样东西都有其优点和缺点。
你最好在深思熟虑后做出自己的决定。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
There are two major status which affect the degree of damages.
One is ^ff0000Power^000000, the other is ^ff0000Intelligence^000000,
Power affects the damages by^8E2323 physical attacks^000000 and^8E2323 throwing attacks^000000.
Intelligence affects the damage by ^8E2323Ninja's skill ^000000
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
有两个主要属性会影响伤害程度。
一个是^ff0000力量^000000，另一个是^ff0000智力^000000。
力量影响^8E2323物理攻击^000000和^8E2323投掷攻击^000000的伤害。
智力影响^8E2323忍者技能^000000的伤害

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
In addition to these, you can learn
other statuses not from the professional trainers like us
but from the trainers teaching the basic skills for battle.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
除了这些，你还可以学习其他属性，
这些属性不是从像我们这样的专业训练师那里学到的，
而是从教授战斗基本技能的训练师那里学到的。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
For example, to raise up the hit rate,
What should you do?
To raise the defense, what do you wear? Etc...
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
例如，要提高命中率，
你应该怎么做？
要提高防御力，你应该穿什么？等等...

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
You can equip this manual to experience some skills.
Open up your skill window by pressing <Alt+S> and find the skills in the Misc TAB.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
你可以装备这本手册来体验一些技能。
按下<Alt+S>打开技能窗口，并在“杂项”选项卡中找到这些技能。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
The Academy has a trainer downstairs who will give you battle field training. Meet him and train your skills.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
学院楼下有一位训练师，他会给你进行战场训练。去见他并训练你的技能吧。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
He will give you some quests to complete. Use the Manual to help you in battle.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
他会给你一些需要完成的任务。在战斗中，使用手册来帮助你。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Make every useful moment count.
You can equip this manual to experience some skills.
Open up your skill window by pressing <Alt+S> and find the skills in the Misc TAB.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
充分利用每一个有用的时刻。
你可以装备这本手册来体验一些技能。
按下<Alt+S>打开技能窗口，并在“杂项”选项卡中找到这些技能。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
The Academy has a trainer downstairs who will give you battle field training. Meet him and train your skills.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
学院楼下有一位训练师，他会给你进行战场训练。去见他并训练你的技能吧。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
He will give you some quests to complete. Use the Manual to help you in battle.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
他会给你一些需要完成的任务。在战斗中，使用手册来帮助你。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Do you understand everything I told you?
That's all... You don't have any questions?
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
你明白我告诉你的所有事情了吗？
就这些...你没有任何问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I appreciate your braveness but, first of all, you have to be familiar with the current profession.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
我很欣赏你的勇气，但首先，你必须熟悉当前的职业。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Before you decide to become a Ninja,
you need to come back after reaching the novice's job level 9. Then, I will accept you.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
在你决定成为忍者之前，
你需要在达到初心者职业等级9之后回来。然后，我会接受你。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
This may be your last warning.
Becoming a Ninja means leading a difficult life.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
这可能是我最后的警告。
成为忍者意味着过一种艰难的生活。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
As Ninja don't belong to a guild, it is easily obtainable to Novices.
Make sure your decision is final!
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
由于忍者不属于公会，因此对初心者来说很容易获得。
请确保你的决定是最终的！

scripts.text: I will reconsider.
scripts.translation: 我再考虑一下。

scripts.text: I already made up my mind.
scripts.translation: 我已经下定决心了。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Well thought actions can often bring good results.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
深思熟虑的行动往往能带来好的结果。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
If you're so assertive, I have no choice but to guide you there.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
既然你如此坚决，我也只能带你去那里了。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I will send you close to where you can change your job.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
我会把你送到可以转职的地方附近。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I will give you a special hint.
Amatsu town is where you are going to arrive. Find the hidden tunnel in a vacant house.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
我给你一个特别的提示。
你将到达樱花城。在一栋空房子里找到隐藏的隧道。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
There you will meet a person who will guide you to becoming a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
在那里，你会遇到一位能引导你成为忍者的人。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
If you get lost in the town, well there is no way... Being ninja requires a level of observation power.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
如果你在城里迷路了，那就没办法了...成为忍者需要具备一定的观察力。

scripts.text: -Select ^ff0000Confirm^000000 to go to Amatsu.
scripts.translation: -选择 ^ff0000确认^000000 前往樱花城。

scripts.text: Confirm
scripts.translation: 确认

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
............

[Ninja Guide]
......

[Ninja Guide]
I have no words to say, if you don't have any business with me.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
如果你没有事找我，我无话可说。

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with the dialogue because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续对话。 -

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Hello? My name is Han to lead the next generation of refining culture in Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
你好？我是韩，致力于引领卢恩·米德加兹下一代的精炼文化。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Entering this market lately, if I don't have old customers, it is not easy to operate. So, I do the advertising by myself.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
最近进入这个市场，如果没有老顾客，经营起来并不容易。所以，我自己来做宣传。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Are you interested in ^3E86C3refining^000000 to make your items strong?
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
你对 ^3E86C3精炼^000000 感兴趣吗？它可以强化你的物品。

scripts.text: I have no interest.
scripts.translation: 我不感兴趣。

scripts.text: refining? Is it edible?
scripts.translation: 精炼？能吃吗？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Ah, I am sorry. I caught a busy man.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
啊，抱歉。我打扰到一位忙碌的人了。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Refining means to strenghthen your equipments with  ^3E86C3rare metal^000000 obtainable from monsters and so on.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
精炼是指使用从魔物等处获得的 ^3E86C3稀有金属^000000 来强化你的装备。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
If weapons are refined, their attacking power increases. If shields are refined, their defensive power increasesand helps to reduce pain against monster's hits on you.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
如果武器经过精炼，攻击力会增加。如果盾牌经过精炼，防御力会增加，并有助于减轻魔物攻击带来的伤害。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
So you kind of get the jist of it right?
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
所以，你大概明白其中的道理了吧？

scripts.text: Oh... refining...

[Refinery Owner Han]
Yes, that's it. Refining is good but it can get addicting.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
没错，就是这样。精炼虽然好，但很容易让人上瘾。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I don't usually do it, but will give you a special chance to experience refining.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
我平时不这么做，但这次给你个特别机会，让你体验一下精炼。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Whatever 1st level weapon level can be used it doesn't matter! If you use the ^3E86C3refining machine Wagjak^000000 over there!!
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
无论是一级还是其他等级的武器，都可以使用！只要用那边的^3E86C3精炼机 瓦格杰克^000000就行！！

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
^I will give you ^FD4F02just! one refining service free of charge.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
^我会给你^FD4F02一次！免费的精炼服务。^000000

scripts.text: Only once?
scripts.translation: 只有一次？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Hey I need to make a living you know! Don't go telling everyone I'm doing this for free ok?
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
喂，我也得谋生啊！别到处去说我是免费做的，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
You haven't used the refining machine Wagjak.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
你还没有使用过精炼机 瓦格杰克。

scripts.text: Refining Machine Wagjak
scripts.translation: 精炼机 瓦格杰克

scripts.text: Why is it called Wagjak?
scripts.translation: 为什么叫瓦格杰克？

scripts.text: Anything else I should know?
scripts.translation: 还有什么我该知道的吗？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
The refining machine Wagjak is a machine I made after 8 years of research.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
这台精炼机 瓦格杰克是我经过8年研究制造出来的机器。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I made it for more precious refining. It is my personal refining machine. Well, thanks to it, I have made several contracts.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
我制造它是为了更珍贵的精炼。这是我的私人精炼机。多亏了它，我签订了好几份契约。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
The name doesn't mean anything it's just a name. Wagjak! What a weird name right?
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
这个名字没什么特别含义，只是个名字而已。瓦格杰克！是不是很奇怪的名字？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Absolutely!
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
绝对没错！

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
But I subscribe to the idea that seeing is believing... You know what I mean? Try it out yourself instead of asking questions.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
但我相信眼见为实...你懂我意思吧？与其问东问西，不如亲自去试试。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Ohoh... as you don't have a service coupon.. You may have already used Wagjak...
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
哦哦...既然你没有服务券...你可能已经用过瓦格杰克了...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I hope you have a brief understanding of refining.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
我希望你对精炼有初步的了解。

scripts.text: Anything else I should know?
scripts.translation: 还有什么我该知道的吗？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Yes, yes, we have... Safety refining indications and refining price... such small things...
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
是的，是的，我们有...安全精炼说明和精炼价格...这类小事...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
For an explanation ^3E86C3weapon levels^000000 & ^3E86C3safety refining^000000...
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
关于^3E86C3武器等级^000000和^3E86C3安全精炼^000000的说明...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
You can learn from ^3E86C3Mr. Taddae^000000 selling Phracon and Emveteracon
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
你可以向出售强化武器金属-级数一和Emveteracon的^3E86C3塔达埃先生^000000学习。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I recommend you visit and listen to Mr. Tadde about weapon levels and safe refining.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
我建议你去找塔德先生，听听他关于武器等级和安全精炼的讲解。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Did you get a good lesson? Did he explain it well enough?
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
你听得懂吗？他讲得清楚吗？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Just between us, there is a rumor that lots of employees complain about me.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
悄悄告诉你，有很多员工都在背后抱怨我。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I sent you there to monitor the situation.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
我派你去那里，就是为了让你监视一下情况。

scripts.text: So?
scripts.translation: 然后呢？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I will adopt it in the performance rating. By the way, how was Mr. Tadde's lesson?
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
我会把它计入绩效考核的。顺便问一下，塔德先生的课讲得怎么样？

scripts.text: It was excellent.
scripts.translation: 非常棒。

scripts.text: It was just OK.
scripts.translation: 还行吧。

scripts.text: It was so-so.
scripts.translation: 一般般。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
He did a good job...
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
他做得不错...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]

scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
如果你收集到5个从某些魔物身上掉落的神之金属原石，我可以将它们精炼成1个神之金属。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Refining level 4 weapons requires ^3E86C3Oridecon and 20,000 zeny.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
精炼4级武器需要^3E86C3神之金属和20,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Elunium is as rare a metal as Oridecon, like Oridecon, if you bring me 5 Rough Elunium obtainable from some monsters, I will refine them to make a Elunium for you.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
铝和神之金属一样稀有。如果你给我5个从某些魔物身上掉落的铝原石，我会将它们精炼成1个铝。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Refining the Armor requires ^3E86C3Elunium and 20000 zeny.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
精炼防具需要^3E86C3铝和20,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Elunium is as rare a metal as Oridecon, like Oridecon, if you bring me 5 Rough Elunium obtainable from some monsters, I will refine them to make a Elunium for you.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
铝和神之金属一样稀有。如果你给我5个从某些魔物身上掉落的铝原石，我会将它们精炼成1个铝。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
You look like you've had enough explanations about the refining prices.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
看来你对精炼价格已经了解得差不多了。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
As I think it would be better for you to experience the effect of refining rather than explantion, I really give you a brief explanation about it.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
我觉得让你亲自体验精炼的效果比听我解释更好，所以我只做简要说明。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Let's start from level 1 weapon.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
让我们从1级武器开始吧。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
1 level weapon has ^A20B09the attacking power increased 2^000000 by each +1 refining. Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
1级武器每次+1精炼，攻击力提升^A20B09 2 ^000000。你明白了吗？

scripts.text: Well???

[Locas]
I thought my explanations to you were easy, but it wasn't...
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
我以为我的解释很简单，看来并不是这样...

scripts.text:
[Locas]
So, if you refine a knife with 17 attacking power and by +1, it will become 19 attacking power.. Like this.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
所以，如果你把一把攻击力为17的刀精炼+1，它的攻击力就会变成19。就是这样。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
In fact, there is no need to talk too much here. You just experience it later.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
其实，这里不需要说太多。你之后亲自体验一下就知道了。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Level 2 weapon will add ^A20B093^000000 to the attacking power per each refining level.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
2级武器每次精炼，攻击力提升^A20B09 3 ^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Level 3 weapon will add ^A20B095^000000 to the attacking power per each refining level.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
3级武器每次精炼，攻击力提升^A20B09 5 ^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Lastly, level 4 weapon will add ^A20B097^000000 to the attacking power per each refining level.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
最后，4级武器每次精炼，攻击力提升^A20B09 7 ^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Ah, I missed the Armor. The Armor can be add ^A20B091^000000 to the defense power per each refining level.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
啊，我忘了说防具。防具每次精炼，防御力提升^A20B09 1 ^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Well, by now the explanations were only for the effect of the safe refining....
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
好了，到目前为止，我只解释了安全精炼的效果...

scripts.text:
[Locas]
You would better learn yourself ^A20B09the effect of over refining^000000 regardless of potential risk.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
关于^A20B09过度精炼的效果^000000，无论风险如何，你最好自己亲自去了解一下。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
If I tell you all the details, it is likely you start reading an epic novel of 10,000 pages, I'll tell you the ending of it.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
如果我告诉你所有细节，那就像让你读一本一万页的史诗小说一样。我就直接告诉你结局吧。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
One thing to be clear is you should be careful about destroying your equipment if you get over-eager.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
有一点必须明确：如果你过于急切，要小心不要弄坏你的装备。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Thank you for your listening to a long story. This is all I can explain you.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
感谢您耐心听我讲完这个长故事。这就是我能告诉您的全部了。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Regarding the levels of weapons and safety refining, consult with Mr. Tadde. He will kindly answer to you.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
关于武器等级和安全精炼的问题，请咨询塔德先生。他会乐意为您解答。

scripts.text: - As you have too many items in your inventory, Quest can't be continued -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏已满，无法继续任务 -

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Welcome. Welcome to the enchant association. I am ^142CEBMounds^000000- head of Izlude branch of the Enchant association.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
欢迎光临。欢迎来到附魔协会。我是^142CEB蒙兹^000000——附魔协会依斯鲁得岛分部的负责人。

scripts.text: Oh... a cat can speak???
scripts.translation: 噢...猫会说话？？？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Have you never seen a talking cat?
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
您从没见过会说话的猫吗？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
There is an island called ^FD4F02Malangdo^000000 where only cats live and I am from there.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
有一个叫^FD4F02马拉格多^000000的岛屿，那里只有猫居住，我就来自那里。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
There are cats like me who can speak the human language very well, but some cats speaking human and cat language are a mess.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
像我这样能流利说人类语言的猫是有的，但也有些猫说话时人类语和猫语混在一起，乱七八糟的。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Well, that can be checked in Malangdo later are you interested in ^FD4F02Enchantments^000000?
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
嗯，这些以后去马拉格多岛就能确认了。您对^FD4F02附魔^000000感兴趣吗？

scripts.text: Enchant Association?
scripts.translation: 附魔协会？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
The Enchant Association is the group made by those of us who can enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
附魔协会是由我们这些能进行附魔的人组成的团体。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
This association is composed of two divisions of ^FD4F02the socket enchant division^000000 and ^FD4F02the hidden enchant division^000000.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
这个协会由两个部门组成：^FD4F02插槽附魔部^000000和^FD4F02隐藏附魔部^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Maybe, are you curious about each division?
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
您是不是对这两个部门都感到好奇？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Maybe, are you curious about each division?
[Mounds]
You don't have any further questions.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
您是不是对这两个部门都感到好奇？
[蒙兹]
您没有其他问题了。

scripts.text: Socket Enchant?
scripts.translation: 插槽附魔？

scripts.text: Hidden Enchant
scripts.translation: 隐藏附魔

scripts.text: Question finished
scripts.translation: 结束提问

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
You are curious about the socket enchant.. Here is the explantion.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
您对插槽附魔很好奇... 这里是相关说明。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
From unknown reason, There has been existing ^FD4F02card slots^000000 on the equipments obtainable from monsters.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
出于未知的原因，从魔物身上获得的装备上一直存在^FD4F02卡片插槽^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
People started to question, 'Can we make a device to insert cards to these?'
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
人们开始质疑：“我们能制造出一种装置，把卡片插进去吗？”

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
At last, one day a man called ^142CEBSeyablem^000000 showed up with the technology of socket enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
终于有一天，一位名叫^142CEB塞亚布勒姆^000000的人带着插槽附魔的技术出现了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Nobody knew how he got the technology....
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
没人知道他是怎么获得这项技术的....

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Someday later, a younger brother of Seyablem called ^142CEBLeyablem^000000 introduced a different device from his brother to socket enchant other equipments.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
后来有一天，塞亚布勒姆的弟弟^142CEB雷亚布勒姆^000000出现，他带来了一种与哥哥不同的装置，用于为其他装备进行插槽附魔。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Many people using the brothers' socket enchanting services, they stole the technology
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
许多使用兄弟俩插槽附魔服务的人，偷走了这项技术。

scripts.text: Ok seems simple enough...
scripts.translation: 嗯，听起来挺简单的...

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
The brothers happened to join the enchant association. And from time to time, they teach the technology to us in Malangdo.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
兄弟俩恰好加入了附魔协会。时不时地，他们会把这项技术传授给我们在马拉格多的人。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Learning the technology diligently, some day will come when others can do socket enchants.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
只要认真学习这项技术，总有一天，其他人也能进行插槽附魔。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Ah, my story went off topic.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
啊，我的故事跑题了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Well, conclusion is this, socket enchant means to add a card socket to the common equipment being sold at any shops.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
总之，结论就是，插槽附魔是指在商店出售的普通装备上添加一个卡片插槽。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
It is called socket enchant. Are you curious about the other division?
[Mounds]
You don't have any further questions.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
这就叫插槽附魔。你对其他分支好奇吗？
[蒙兹]
你没有更多问题了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Ah ! Are you curious about the hidden enchant?
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
啊！你是对隐藏附魔好奇吗？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
OK. First, I have to let you know how the hidden enchnat skill was born.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
好的。首先，我得告诉你隐藏附魔这项技能是如何诞生的。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
The original inventor was looking for a way to unlock the 4th slot of a 3 slotted weapon.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
最初的发明者一直在寻找一种方法，来解锁3插槽武器的第4个插槽。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
So he studied the technology to make use of the remaining slot.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
于是，他研究了如何利用剩余插槽的技术。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
When the study was finally successful he taught it to his apprentices and was never heard from again.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
当研究最终成功时，他把技术传授给了学徒，然后便杳无音讯了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
His technology reinforced the equipment with a gem that had special properties similar to monster cards.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
他的技术是用具有类似魔物卡片特殊属性的宝石来强化装备。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
That technology has been developed and improved to make the current ^FD4F02Enchant association ^000000
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
这项技术经过开发和改进，形成了现在的^FD4F02附魔协会^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Briefly speaking, to make a stronger equipment with a special enchantment is the hidden enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
简而言之，通过特殊附魔来制作更强大的装备，就是隐藏附魔。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Are you curious about the other division?
[Mounds]
You don't have any further questions.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
你对其他分支好奇吗？
[蒙兹]
你没有更多问题了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
You don't have any further questions.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
你没有更多问题了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Later, if you want to experience the hidden enchant or socket enchant, I will give you a hand.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
以后，如果你想体验隐藏附魔或插槽附魔，我会帮你的。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Come to me anytime.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Welcome.. Ah, we've met before right?
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
欢迎...啊，我们以前见过，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Are you coming to experience the hidden enchant or the socket enchant?
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
你是来体验隐藏附魔，还是插槽附魔？

scripts.text: I am just passing by.
scripts.translation: 只是路过

scripts.text: Came to experience it.
scripts.translation: 来体验一下

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
You may be on the way to Prontera. Be careful and come back.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
你可能是要去普隆德拉吧。路上小心，欢迎回来。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
You want an experience.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
你想体验一下。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
The experience course starts from the experience of the simple socket enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
体验课程将从简单的插槽附魔开始。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
For this, you need material. Will you buy a cotton shirt at Izlude Armor shop?
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
为此，你需要材料。你会去依斯鲁得岛的防具店买一件棉衬衫吗？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
When you bring the cotton shirt, we will immediately start ^FD4F02the socket enchnat experience^000000 course.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
当你带来棉衬衫时，我们将立即开始^FD4F02插槽附魔体验^000000课程。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Oh this is a socketed shirt already!
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
哦，这件衬衫已经有插槽了！

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
It must be a plain cotton shirt.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
必须是一件普通的棉衬衫。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
When you bring the plain cotton shirt from the Armor shop, we will start the socket enchant experience.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
当你从防具店带来一件普通的棉衬衫时，我们将开始插槽附魔体验。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Bring us the normal shirt without holes.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
请带来一件没有孔洞的普通衬衫。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Not like all other enchants, the socket enchant is being worked without items installed.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
与其他附魔不同，插槽附魔是在未镶嵌任何物品时进行的。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Then, let's start the socket enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
那么，让我们开始插槽附魔吧。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
One!
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
一！

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
One! Two!
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
一！二！

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
One! Two! Three!
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
一！二！三！

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
You have suceeded in socket enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
你成功完成了插槽附魔。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Have you checked the equipment? It now has an empty slot in it.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
你检查过装备了吗？现在它上面有一个空的插槽。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
But, like this time the success rate is not always ^FD4F02100%^000000 as you are still in the studying phase.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
不过，就像这次一样，成功率并不总是^FD4F02100%^000000，因为你仍处于学习阶段。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Please keep in mind that there always risks of failure and if failed, the equipment will be broken.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
请记住，失败的风险始终存在，如果失败，装备将会损坏。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
If you want to know more about the socket enchant, go and consult with Leyablem or Seyablem who are working at Prontera or Payon.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
如果你想了解更多关于插槽附魔的信息，可以去普隆德拉或斐扬咨询正在那里工作的蕾亚布姆或塞亚布姆。

scripts.text: I see.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Now it's time for your experiencing the hidden enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
现在，是时候体验隐藏附魔了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Equipped with the just socket enchanted cotton shirt, get the hidden enchant from
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
穿上刚刚完成插槽附魔的棉衬衫，去那里找负责隐藏附魔的猫阿尔蒙德 J 进行隐藏附魔。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Almond J, the cat in charge with the hidden enchant over there.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
阿尔蒙德 J 是负责隐藏附魔的猫，就在那边。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Get the hidden enchant from Almond J with wearing the cotton shirt socket enchanted.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
穿着完成插槽附魔的棉衬衫，去找阿尔蒙德 J 进行隐藏附魔。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Eh? You came earlier than expected? I though it might take time after listening to all the explanations.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
咦？你来得比预期早啊？我以为听完所有解释后，你会花点时间呢。

scripts.text: Explain about the situation.
scripts.translation: 解释一下情况

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Keuh~~ It happened....
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
咳~~ 发生了...意外...

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
I should beware of you, when you were making a big noise to do the hidden enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
我本该提防你的，当你大声喧哗着要做隐藏附魔的时候。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Anyway, I am sorry.. Though it is short, I will make the explanation for you.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
总之，我很抱歉...虽然时间很短，但我会为你做个简短的说明。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Have you checked the hidden enchant?
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
你检查过隐藏附魔了吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I have.
scripts.translation: 是的，我听过。

scripts.text: No. I haven't.
scripts.translation: 没有，我还没检查

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
As you have checked it already, my explanation became easy.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
既然你已经检查过了，我的说明就简单多了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Hmmm. Recommend you examine the condition of your cotton shirt, opening item window.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
嗯。建议你打开物品窗口，检查一下你的棉衬衫的状态。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
As you have checked it already, my explanation became easy.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
既然你已经检查过了，我的说明就简单多了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
As I explained you just before, the hidden enchant is the work to insert to weapoon or Armor a gem with a special option into the equipment.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
正如我刚才解释的，隐藏附魔是将带有特殊选项的宝石插入武器或防具的操作。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
As you know it, if you checked, you may notice something new was at the no. 3 and 4 slots at the bottom of item information window.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
如果你检查了，可能会注意到物品信息窗口底部的第3和第4插槽出现了新的变化。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Hidden enchant is being proceeded with the similar equipment worn as Almond J's.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
隐藏附魔的过程与阿尔蒙德 J 使用的类似装备的操作方式相同。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Of course, there are some other places to do the hidden enchants.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
当然，还有其他地方可以进行隐藏附魔。

scripts.text: Satisfied.
scripts.translation: 满意

scripts.text: A little short.
scripts.translation: 有点短

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
It is fortunate. Do you have any experience to be added? If so, please write it to me.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
真是幸运。您有什么经验想要补充吗？如果有，请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Experience seems not be satisfactory with you. Can you write me what was it?
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
看来您对经验值不太满意。能告诉我具体是什么问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
I will refer it for planning the next experience.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
我会参考您的意见，以便规划下一次的体验。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Thank you for your valuable advice.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
感谢您宝贵的建议。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Thank you for your patience listening to my boring explanation.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
感谢您耐心听我这些枯燥的解释。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
This is a small gift hoping your continuous support for our enchant association.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
这是一份小礼物，希望您能继续支持我们的附魔协会。

scripts.text: Received the explanation about the enchants, some experience and Kafra storage free coupon.
scripts.translation: 收到了关于附魔的说明、一些经验值和卡普拉仓库免费券。

scripts.text: Received the explanation and Kafra free storage coupon.
scripts.translation: 收到了说明和卡普拉仓库免费券。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Then, I will see you later.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
那么，我们下次再见。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Welcome to the enchant association. I am Mounds - head of Izlude branch of Enchant association.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
欢迎来到附魔协会。我是蒙兹——附魔协会依斯鲁得岛分部的负责人。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Eh? Your appreance is familiar. Have we met before?
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
咦？你的样子很眼熟。我们以前见过吗？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
As I can't remember all the people I met as they are too many, strangely you have a face not to forget.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
我见过的人太多，记不全所有面孔，但奇怪的是，你的脸让我很难忘记。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Perhaps, are you here to learn about enchanting? I will kindly explain you about it.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
也许，你是来了解附魔的？我很乐意为你解释一下。

scripts.text: Socket enchant
scripts.translation: 插槽附魔

scripts.text: Hidden enchant
scripts.translation: 隐藏附魔

scripts.text: Give regards
scripts.translation: 致意

scripts.text: No questions at all.
scripts.translation: 没有问题了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Socket enchant is the skill to make card slots appear in Weapon or Armor.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
插槽附魔是一种让武器或防具出现卡片插槽的技能。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
When you meet the Seyablem and Leyablem brothers around the towns of Rune-Midgarts they can help you with this service.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
当你在卢恩·米德加兹的城镇中遇到塞亚贝尔姆和莱亚贝尔姆兄弟时，他们可以为你提供服务。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
If they fail to put a new slot in your item say farewell to it...
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
如果没能成功添加新的插槽，那就只能和它说再见了...

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
It's usually a good idea to have more than 1 item to add a slot to because it can fail a lot sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
通常建议准备多于一件要添加插槽的物品，因为有时候失败率很高。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Hidden enchant means to put enchanted gems into the hidden slots of an item.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
隐藏附魔是指将附魔宝石镶嵌到物品的隐藏插槽中。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
You have to be wearing the item that is being enchanted as it uses the wearers fortune as the success rate.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
你必须穿戴着要附魔的物品，因为成功率取决于穿戴者的运气。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Many places are providing the various hidden enchant service in different ways, if you have time, please visit one of them.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
许多地方都以不同的方式提供隐藏附魔服务，如果您有时间，请去其中一家看看。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
News? Enchant association doesn't have a big issue going on.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
新闻？附魔协会目前没有发生什么大事。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Ah!! I remember that Almond J sent with me from Izlude branch wanted to do advertising...
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
啊！！我想起来了，阿尔蒙德 J 从依斯鲁得岛分部派来的人想做广告...

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
He drafted the initiative for the free service of hidden enchant to the beginner's weapons. I approved it as it looked a good idea.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
他起草了为新手武器提供免费隐藏附魔服务的提案。我觉得这是个好主意，所以批准了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
What? If you have a beginners weapon, it may not hurt to try it.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
什么？如果你有一件新手武器，不妨试试。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Come to me whenever you have a question about the enchant association.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
如果您有关于附魔协会的任何问题，随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Any other questions?
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
还有其他问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Something strange must've happened. If this continues, please contact customer service.
scripts.translation:
[蒙兹]
一定发生了什么奇怪的事情。如果这种情况持续下去，请联系客服。

scripts.text: - As you have too many items in your inventory, Quest can't be continued -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏已满，无法继续任务 -

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Hello, I am Almon J of the enchant association.~
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
你好，我是附魔协会的阿尔蒙德 J。~

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
If you have anything to do with the enchant association, please consult with Mounds inside.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
如果您有关于附魔协会的事情，请咨询里面的蒙兹。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Welcome.. I have been waiting for you. Are you coming for the hidden enchant service on your cotton shirt?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
欢迎...我一直在等您。您是来为您的棉衬衫做隐藏附魔服务的吗？

scripts.text: Ench? Whatis?
scripts.translation: 附魔？什么？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Eummm?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
嗯？

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Oh... finally you came...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
哦...您终于来了...

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Has your ^142cebCotton Shirt[1]^000000 been equipped? Shall we start now? Ready?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
您的^142ceb棉衬衫[1]^000000装备好了吗？我们现在开始吗？准备好了吗？

scripts.text: You look excited.
scripts.translation: 你看起来很兴奋。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Heh... is that so? Frankly, it is my first time... I am really excited.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
嘿嘿...是吗？说实话，这是我第一次...我真的好兴奋。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Are you ready? Yes? Do it now. Now!!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
准备好了吗？是的？那就开始吧。现在！！

scripts.text: Hidden enchant start!!
scripts.translation: 开始隐藏强化！！

scripts.text: Wait for a while.
scripts.translation: 稍等一下。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Heh? Eh? Hik?! Come here quick.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
嘿？啊？什么？！快过来。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Please come back after you have equipped the Cotton Shirt.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
请先装备好棉衬衫再回来。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Hing, it is not a normal Cotton Shirt.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
听好了，这不是普通的棉衬衫。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Now!! Start the first hidden enchant!! Start!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
现在！！开始第一次隐藏强化！！开始！！！！

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Zzazanzn!! Completed!!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
滋啦滋啦！！完成了！！

scripts.text: Wow, that was quick.
scripts.translation: 哇，好快。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
How about it? Don't you think the hidden enchant is great? Any chance to do another hidden enchant?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
怎么样？你不觉得隐藏强化很棒吗？要不要再来一次隐藏强化？

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
It's fun. I want to do it again. Hey, another trial Ok? Aaaaa!!! I want to do the hidden enchant again.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
真好玩。我想再来一次。嘿，再试一次好吗？啊啊啊！！我想再做一次隐藏强化。

scripts.text: Gradually you are getting into your own world. You better go back to Mounds.
scripts.translation: 你渐渐沉浸在自己的世界里了。你最好回到蒙兹那里去。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
How about it? Don't you think the hidden enchant is great? Any chance to do another hidden enchant?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
怎么样？你不觉得隐藏强化很棒吗？要不要再来一次隐藏强化？

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
It's fun. I want to do it again. Hey, another trial Ok? Aaaaa!!! I want to do the hidden enchant again.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
真好玩。我想再来一次。嘿，再试一次好吗？啊啊啊！！我想再做一次隐藏强化。

scripts.text: Gradually you are getting into your own world. You better go back to Mounds.
scripts.translation: 你渐渐沉浸在自己的世界里了。你最好回到蒙兹那里去。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Heh heh... how are you? I am doing a ^142CEBservice of free hidden enchant for the beginner's weapon to advertise the enchant association.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
嘿嘿嘿...你好吗？我正在为新手武器提供^142CEB免费隐藏强化服务，以宣传强化协会。^000000

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Something strange must've happened. If this continues, please contact customer service.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
一定发生了什么奇怪的事情。如果这种情况持续下去，请联系客服。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
As you are still a beginner, you don't have a very, very, very functional jewelry, but soon you will have.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
既然你还是个新手，你还没有非常、非常、非常强力的首饰，但很快你就会有的。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
How about it? Will you try the hidden enchant for the beginner's weapon free of charge?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
怎么样？要不要免费尝试新手武器的隐藏强化？

scripts.text: Hidden enchant start!!
scripts.translation: 开始隐藏强化！！

scripts.text: What weapons are you enchanting?
scripts.translation: 你在强化什么武器？

scripts.text: Just passing by.
scripts.translation: 只是路过。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Ah!! Weapons? Hehehe.. I didn't explain it to you enough.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
啊！！武器？嘿嘿嘿...我好像没跟你解释清楚。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
The weapon to be serviced with the free hidden enchant has the ^FD4F02Novice^000000 name in front of the weapon.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
享受免费隐藏强化的武器，其名称前会有^FD4F02初心者^000000的标识。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
^FD4F02For Novices-
Cutter, Mace, Rod, Axe, Etc.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
^FD4F02适合初心者-
短剑、钝器、法杖、斧头等。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Ye?!?!?!?!?!
Where are you going? You should do the hidden enchant before going.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
耶？？？？？？？！
你要去哪？你应该先做完隐藏强化再走啊。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Hehehe... hidden enchant makes me excited. But you should come back with your weapon armed.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
嘿嘿嘿...隐藏强化让我很兴奋。但你得带着武器回来才行。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
It is!! ^142cebthe Novice Knife^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
没错！！^142ceb初心者短剑^000000。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
It is!! The ^142ceb{0}^000000.

[Almond J]
Ehee.. It is not a Novice Weapon. Leaving this expensive weapon to us and if broken... I'm not taking that chance.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
呃...这不是初心者武器。把这么贵的武器交给我们，万一坏了...我可不敢冒这个险。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
But this weapon might be strange to add a hidden enchant? Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
但这把武器可能不适合加隐藏强化？抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
It is a good weapon Then!! Let's start the hidden enchant!!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
这是一把好武器！那么！！开始隐藏强化！！

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Zzazanzn!! Completed!!
As I'm too excited, I can't check the options. Please check it yourself.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒙德 J]
滋啦滋啦！！完成了！！
我太兴奋了，没法检查选项。请你自己检查一下。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
Repairing broken equipment!! If you have broken equipment, bring it to me anytime.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
修理破损的装备！！如果你有破损的装备，随时可以拿来给我。

scripts.text: Repair it.
scripts.translation: 修理它。

scripts.text: Nothing to be repaired now.
scripts.translation: 现在没有需要修理的。

scripts.text: What is repairing?
scripts.translation: 什么是修理？

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
You must treat your equipment carefully... as you don't have anything to be repaired.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
你必须小心对待你的装备...因为你没有需要修理的东西。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
Hmmm... let's see... oh.. hmm...
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
嗯...让我看看...哦...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
------------------------
Damaged Equipment Estimate
Damaged Equipment: ^FF0000{0}^000000
Fee: ^0000FF{1} Zeny^000000
------------------------
Would you like to proceed with the repair?
Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
Well, I don't care. After all, it's not my equipment. However, leaving equipment unchecked is not a wise choice.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
好吧，我不在乎。反正又不是我的装备。不过，让装备保持破损状态可不是明智之举。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
The repair cost is 5000 Zeny per damaged equipment. You do not have enough money.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
修理费用是每件破损装备5000 Zeny。您的钱不够。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
The repair has been completed. Be sure to take good care of your equipment.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
修理已完成。请务必好好保养您的装备。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
If you don't have any equipment to be repaired, you may not have something to talk with me about.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
如果您没有需要修理的装备，那您可能没什么事要找我。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
A specific skill or boss monster could break your equipment frequently.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
某些特定的技能或Boss魔物可能会频繁损坏您的装备。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
This doesn't mean that your equipment is gone forever like what happens during refining.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
这并不意味着您的装备会像精炼失败那样永远消失。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
When your item breaks this way, they won't perform normally...
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
当您的装备以这种方式损坏时，它们将无法正常使用...

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
In this case, bring it to me, and I will repair it back to new at the cost of 5000 zeny for each equipment.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
在这种情况下，请把它带给我，我会以每件5000 Zeny的费用将其修复如新。

scripts.text:
[Training Instructor]
The training grounds have been revised.
I will send you to Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[训练指导员]
训练场已经翻新。
我将送您去依斯鲁得岛。
